title: Project Program Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Yahhvi – EV Charging is dedicated to accelerating India’s transition to clean mobility by building a sustainable, reliable, and future-ready EV charging ecosystem for commercial and heavy-duty vehicles. The company focuses on infrastructure that supports rapid electrification and strengthens the broader EV ecosystem through innovation, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships. Yahhvi’s vision is to power the electrification of India’s freight economy by creating backbone charging infrastructure that connects warehouses, logistics hubs, and freight corridors. The mission centers on deploying high-performance charging hubs for electric fleets using strategic location planning, demand-controlled energy distribution, and integrated fleet partnerships. Yahhvi aims to deliver reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient charging solutions for commercial trucks and fleet operators.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Project Program Manager role based in Gurgaon. The Project Program Manager will oversee end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of eMHEV charging infrastructure projects, coordinating cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and external partners. Daily responsibilities include managing project timelines and budgets, tracking milestones, mitigating risks, and ensuring regulatory and safety compliance across all sites. The role involves stakeholder management with internal leadership, fleet partners, vendors, and logistics providers, as well as preparing status reports and presenting project updates. The Project Program Manager will also contribute to process improvement, standardisation of project management practices, and scaling of charging hub deployment across new locations.

**Qualifications**

* 3-4 Years of relevant experience in EV infrastructure project management
* Strong project and program management skills with experience in planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management for EV infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and cross-functional collaboration, including working with engineering, operations, and external partners.
* Knowledge of EV charging, renewable energy, logistics, or related domains, with an understanding of commercial fleet operations and industrial safety standards.
* Comfort with data analysis, reporting tools, and project management software to track KPIs, timelines, and resource utilization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear documentation, dashboards, and executive-level presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to work on-site, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and make decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Management, Operations, or a related field; a postgraduate degree or PMP/Prince2 certification is an advantage.
* Experience in large-scale infrastructure deployment, energy, transportation, or logistics sectors is highly beneficial.

title: Global Project Manager – Corporate Real Estate, IT Infrastructure & Procurement
description:
**Global Project Manager – Corporate Real Estate, IT Infrastructure & Procurement**

**Location:**
Gurgaon, Bangalore, and Mumbai, India

**Experience:**
(3–8 years of relevant experience)

**About the Company**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action-oriented professionals who solve complex client problems through hands-on execution. Its culture values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. Established in 2023, A&M’s India Global Capability Center (GCC) partners with leadership across business units and geographies to scale client delivery, accelerate execution, improve pricing, and apply automation. Unlike a traditional back-office center, the GCC supports end-to-end case delivery and thought leadership across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The 900+ member team serves sectors including Consumer & Retail, Healthcare, Software & Technology, Automotive & Industrials, Hospitality & Leisure, Energy & Natural Resources, and Financial Services. Nearly 90% of consultants hold advanced degrees, while its leadership team brings more than 1,000 years of combined experience. GESS is a strategic partner supporting technology, marketing, information security, knowledge management, corporate real estate, human resources, and operations.

**About the Role**

As Global Project Manager, you will own cross-regional IT infrastructure and Corporate Real Estate initiatives from planning through completion. You will coordinate office build-outs, relocations, decommissioning, site readiness, procurement, vendor execution, and IT asset lifecycle activities. The role connects architecture frameworks, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, office space networking, software-led infrastructure delivery, Facilities, Security, IT, CRE, and regional stakeholders. Success means delivering compliant projects on schedule, within approved budgets, and aligned with business requirements. You will manage multiple workstreams, maintain executive visibility, and improve the systems and processes that make global project delivery predictable. Candidates must hold a PMP certification and demonstrate flexibility to relocate to Gurgaon, where the majority of the global IT team is based.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own global IT infrastructure and CRE project plans for office build-outs, relocations, and decommissioning, using schedules, milestones, dependencies, and risk controls to deliver predictable outcomes.
* Translate architecture frameworks and software-led infrastructure requirements across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and office networking into coordinated site-readiness plans with IT, CRE, Facilities, Security, and regional teams.
* Control procurement execution for equipment, infrastructure, and project services by managing vendors, contracts, purchase orders, delivery schedules, invoices, and spend against approved budgets.
* Govern stakeholder communication through concise status reporting, decision logs, escalation paths, and leadership updates that keep global teams aligned on scope, timing, risks, and business impact.
* Own IT asset lifecycle coordination across deployment, redeployment, inventory, audits, and disposition, maintaining accurate records in IT Asset Management systems such as ServiceNow.
* Improve project, procurement, and asset-management workflows through standardization, vendor performance management, cost-saving opportunities, and compliance with corporate financial and procurement policies.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* PMP certification is mandatory, supported by 3–8 years of experience in project management, corporate real estate, IT infrastructure, procurement, or a closely related field.
* Proven experience delivering global or multi-site projects, including office build-outs, relocations, site readiness, infrastructure deployments, and coordination across international stakeholders.
* Strong capability with software-led infrastructure concepts, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, office networking, vendor management, budget tracking, Microsoft Office, project tracking tools, and ITAM platforms such as ServiceNow.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience partnering with Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, Security, IT operations, architecture, or workplace technology teams in large enterprise or global environments.
* Experience managing IT equipment deployment, inventory planning, lifecycle controls, audits, and disposition across multiple locations and regional operating models.
* Familiarity with procurement standardization, contract execution, project financial controls, and identifying measurable vendor savings or process efficiencies.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring structured ownership of complex, multi-region programs and can turn ambiguous requirements into sequenced plans, clear accountabilities, controlled risks, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* You combine corporate real estate awareness with practical IT infrastructure understanding, especially architecture frameworks, LAN/WAN/SD-WAN, office space networking, and software-led delivery environments.
* You are commercially disciplined, able to connect procurement decisions, vendor performance, purchase orders, invoices, asset records, and budget variance to sound financial governance.
* You communicate confidently with leadership, vendors, technical teams, Facilities, CRE, Security, and regional stakeholders, adapting detail and escalation to the decision required.
* You are organized across competing priorities, solve problems without losing momentum, and use systems, reporting, and standardization to improve operational reliability.
* You hold a PMP certification and are willing to relocate to Gurgaon if required, recognizing that most of the global IT team is based there.

**Why Join Us**

At A&M, your work will shape how a rapidly growing global capability center delivers technology-enabled workplaces and supports international consulting teams. You will own visible projects that connect corporate real estate, IT infrastructure, procurement, and asset operations across multiple regions. The role offers exposure to global stakeholders, varied industries, and the full lifecycle of complex workplace and infrastructure initiatives rather than a narrow administrative remit. You will join GESS, a strategic business partner whose work enables client service delivery, go-to-market execution, risk management, and firm growth. A&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives capable professionals room to make decisions, challenge conventional approaches, and create practical improvements. Your impact will be visible through faster site readiness, stronger governance, better vendor outcomes, accurate asset control, and reliable delivery against business commitments. The firm supports continued growth through merit-based development, training, on-the-job learning, well-being resources, and opportunities to build specialized expertise in a global environment.

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where independent thinkers can influence global projects, improve operating models, and see the business impact of their work.
* Continuous learning through formal training, on-the-job development, performance feedback, and exposure to senior stakeholders across regions and functions.
* A people-focused experience with merit-based growth opportunities, benefits, and well-being resources supporting professional development and personal success.

title: Project Leader - Mergers & Acquisitions CoE
description:
**About Us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, cross-industry capabilities, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

 

**About M&A CoE**

* M&A Center of Excellence (CoE) at BCN is a new CoE being established to support Bain’s capabilities for
  **M&A And Divestitures practice**
* **Bain’s M&A CoE offerings will include offerings across Growth and M&A Strategy, Deal Sourcing and Screening, Corporate Due Diligence (Integration thesis and Synergies modules) , Merger Integration, Divestiture and Separation. The CoE will play a crucial role in improving and further differentiating Bain’s approach across these offerings.**
* The M&A CoE will actively support Bain Partners/ Global Case teams across and Client Cases/ Client development efforts
* Additionally, the CoE will also work closely with M&A and Divestitures practice/solution leadership in building new IP/ Products/ Tools etc.
* CoE scope and scale is expected to evolve over time to more deeper domain expertise, broader scope and end-to-end offerings. Plan is to also expand the CoE to BCN Mexico in future.

**About You**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with strong academic background
* 4-6 years of prior domain experience/ relevant expertise e,g. Synergy analysis (and/or cost diagnostics), Due Diligence (M&A or Private Equity), Merger Integration, Divestiture strategy, etc
* Strong analytical skills with proven ability of leveraging/ embracing automation / AI to drive efficiency across products/ offerings.
* High-level competence in core analytical tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Hands-on skills in research and analytics are required, along with significant exposure to key secondary data sources. A robust consulting and problem-solving skill set tied with a background in marketing analytics is also necessary
* Fundamental skills include excellent work planning, communication, and team leading abilities. Relevant experience with data analytics, project and team management, coaching, and mentoring is also required

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead a team of Associates /Analysts to produce client-ready products and analysis, generating strong business insights and understanding implications
* Works under the guidance of the COE Manager/Senior Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer, final materials, client communication, work planning, and team management. Brainstorming with the Manager on various aspects for IP development, CD, case work as needed
* Works with project/case teams across geographies and industries; however, they focus almost exclusively M&A related projects/ cases
* Ensure timely, high quality, error-free research, analysis and output produced by the analysts/associates. Driving insights through data analysis – Story-lining the deliverable to prove/disprove hypotheses
* Brings to the table various cutting-edge technologies and best practices in a productized delivery model; adoption of AI/ agentic tools for driving efficiency
* Communicate effectively and clearly explain insights and implications for the client
* Openness to transfer to Mexico / help set-up M&A in Mexico will be an added advantage

  

**What makes us a great place to work**

We are proud to be
consistently recognized
as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for
diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents
.

title: Senior Manager - Strategy and Process Governance
description:
**About the Role**

The role is responsible for supporting the Head of Group Sourcing - Clothing in facilitating through leading the implementation of long-term strategic roadmaps across the regional sourcing hubs. They will establish and maintain standardized operational frameworks to ensure consistency and efficiency and managing cross-functional projects designed to modernize our sourcing workflows and digital integration across Asia sourcing offices.

Meanwhile, this is a role will also play an important part in designing and executing sourcing strategies to meet long-term commercial objectives and scale the Own Brand business. A key priority is leading our operating model transformation—optimizing processes, aligning systems, and standardizing 'ways of working'. This role is the key to unlock OB growth potentials across the group.

**What You'll Do**

The scope of the role will include, but not limited to the following main areas:

* **Strategy & Delivery:**
  Lead the end to end design, planning and execution of Sourcing Strategy (including strategic partnership, SRM, Risk Management, Diversification) to deliver category growth, Own Brand ambitions and optimize COGS benefits
* **Operating Model Transformation:**
  Lead the end-to-end mapping of global sourcing operations to identify and drive process optimizations including but not limited to develop and implement standardised procedures, best practices, and guidelines. You will ensure organizational alignment, integrate systems and tools, and manage the end-to-end change process to deliver a highly efficient and effective global sourcing function
* **Strategic Insights**
  : Consolidate and analyze internal and external data to identify emerging trends, commercial risks, and white-space opportunities. Translate these insights into executive-level narratives and actionable recommendations that influence long-term strategy
* **Project Management:**
  Lead the execution of high-priority strategic projects (team level or Group level) from inception to completion. Establish project governance, track milestones, and manage cross-functional dependencies to ensure initiatives are delivered on time
* **AOP Planning:**
  Orchestrate the annual planning cycle for Asia Sourcing team, translating multi year strategies into actionable targets - defining budget requirements, resource allocation and KPIs that ensure the Group’s commercial and operation goals are met
* **Thought Leadership:**
  Act as a subject matter expert on strategic framework designs, global sourcing trends, emerging technologies, and geopolitical shifts. You will proactively identify industry best practices and innovative sourcing models to challenge the status quo, ensuring the Group remains competitive and resilient in a changing global market.
* **Collaboration Facilitation:**
  Build communication and internal collaboration within the Sourcing and Asia teams and between the Australian business commercial teams. Identify opportunities and ensure teams are working towards common goals.
* **Stakeholder Engagement and Management:**
  Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the Group commercial and enablement teams and within sourcing teams to understand their needs and align sourcing strategies and strategic initiatives accordingly

**What You'll Bring**

***Personal Characteristics***

* Influence, adaptability, judgment, collaboration, managerial skills, interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Horizontal Leadership capabilities and the ability to work well in a pressured situation
* Ability to influence, establish and maintain strong relationships with senior management.

***Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities***

* 10+ years of relevant retail / industry experience necessary.
* Proven experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management. Project management experience is an added advantage.
* Strong business acumen analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good understanding of retail operations, industry trends, supply chain and AI Integration.
* Track record of managing and delivering change as well as results
* Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of relevant sourcing tools and buying processes & systems.

**What you’ll experience**

* Be a part of Australia’s largest retailer
* Constant mentoring and training provided
* Generous performance based bonus
* 20 days annual leave
* A flexible approach to work

title: Transformation Leader-Master Black Belt
description:
The Transformation Leader (Insurance) is responsible for driving end-to-end operational transformation across Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance carrier & broker operations. The role focuses on improving efficiency, scalability, service quality, and profitability through process redesign, digitization, operating model changes, and data-driven decision making.

The role would be responsible for the effective delivery of the Transformation Roadmaps and projects for the clients with a distinctive focus on deploying digital technologies like Robotics, Machine Learning, Intelligent automations, Generative AI, etc. by working with cross-functional global teams to favourably impact to the business outcomes of the customer.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Operational Transformation**

• Lead large-scale transformation initiatives across core broker operations, including:

• Policy placement & renewals

• Endorsements & mid-term adjustments

• New business onboarding

• Claims coordination & servicing

• Carrier interactions and compliance

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and cost drivers; redesign processes using Lean / Six Sigma principles.

• Standardize workflows across lines of business, geographies, and acquired broker entities.

**2. Digital & Automation Enablement**

• Drive adoption of digital tools, workflow platforms, and automation (RPA, OCR, straight-through processing).

• Partner with IT, vendors, and Insurtech to modernize broker management systems (BMS), CRM, and document management.

• Enable data integration between carriers, brokers, and internal systems.

**3. Operating Model & Organization Design**

• Define target operating models aligned to growth, M&A, and client segmentation strategies.

• Optimize role clarity, spans of control, and sourcing models (onshore/offshore/shared services).

• Support post-merger integration for acquired brokerages.

**4. Performance & Analytics**

• Establish operational KPIs and dashboards (e.g., turnaround time, hit ratios, cost per policy, error rates).

• Embed performance management routines and continuous improvement culture.

• Use data to drive prioritization of transformation initiatives.

**5. Change & Stakeholder Management**

• Lead change management across frontline teams, leaders, and partners.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

• Communicate vision, progress, and impact clearly and consistently.

**Skillset**

* 12–18+ years of experience in insurance, with deep exposure to P&C broker or carrier operations
* Proven track record leading large-scale transformation or operational excellence programs
* Strong understanding of broker workflows, carrier interactions, and regulatory requirements
* Experience working with senior executives and cross-functional teams
* Experience in setting up process measurement systems with advance visualization tools to implement real time monitoring frameworks and platforms
* Proficiency in data and analytical tools like control charts, descriptive statistics, box charts, hypothesis testing etc
* Certifications in Project Management, Automation, Design Thinking will be preferred.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and risk-taking abilities.
* Strong Quantitative and problem-solving ability: Ability to conceptualize complex problems and develop an Analytical Road map for them
* Experience of leading and driving strategic initiatives for COO, CFO and CIO personas
* Proven experience in driving continuous improvements across teams using Lean Six Sigma, Design Thinking, Digital and Automation Solutions, Advanced Analytics and GenAI
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management with ability to work in diverse teams and with multiple stakeholders
* Facilitative Leadership skills – Influencing skills, mentoring and coaching – to be able to drive change

* **Qualifications**
* MBA / Post Graduation in any discipline
* Certified Project Manager/ Master Black Belt
* Certified in RPA/Digital
* Certified Design Thinking

**Location:**
Delhi NCR

title: Project Manager

**Technical/Professional Skills & Competencies**

title: Transformation Delivery Consultant - LifeSciences
description:
**About Inizio Ignite:**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health.
  
  
**Company Descriptor**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health. Our Research Partnership healthcare market research team provides research and insights to inform and power healthcare decisions. Serving a variety of clients across the lifecycle, our expertise includes data, research & insights (proprietary syndicated and custom research) and brand tracking (ATU). Proudly part of Inizio – the market-leading commercialization partner for health and life sciences. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver High-Impact Solutions: Create and deliver high-quality project outcomes that align with client objectives, incorporating life science consulting principles to promote business excellence and scientific advancement.
* Project & Risk Management: Lead project plans or workstreams, proactively resolving issues, mitigating risks, and escalating concerns when necessary to ensure project success.
* Strategic Analysis & Recommendations: Systematically gather, analyze, and interpret scientific and business information, using a life science consulting lens to make confident, data-driven recommendations with urgency.
* Contribute to Vynamic's Growth: Dedicate time to enhancing Vynamic’s competencies by sharing life science consulting insights and contributing to the firm’s knowledge base and brand.
* Brand Representation: Act as a Vynamic brand ambassador, demonstrating a strong commitment to company values both internally and externally.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build authentic, trust-based relationships with stakeholders through partnership, effective communication, and delivering outcomes that exceed expectations.
* Team Development: Support team growth by identifying learning opportunities, mentoring colleagues, and integrating life science consulting practices into daily operations to achieve collective goals.
* Collaborative Leadership: Work closely with Navigators, Go-Tos, Account Managers, and self-selected Counselors to support personal and professional development journeys within Vynamic.
* Continuous Feedback & Growth: Proactively seek feedback, develop actionable personal growth plans, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
* Inclusive Leadership: Recognize and celebrate diverse perspectives, experiences, and cultures, ensuring all voices are heard and valued in decision-making processes.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of experience in life science consulting, advanced degree (MS, MBA, PhD) preferred.
* Proven track record of managing collaborative teams or projects within dynamic, fast-paced environments.
* Strong understanding of relationship management principles, with a focus on fostering genuine connections within the life sciences ecosystem.
* Experience applying project management methodologies to oversee workstreams and complex initiatives.
* Familiarity with Vynamic’s sectors, services, and unique value proposition (preferred but not required).
* Strong presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively through written and verbal channels to diverse audiences, including scientific and executive stakeholders.
* Growth-oriented mindset, embracing challenges as opportunities for learning and personal development.

**Ideal candidate should be**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

***Artificial Intelligence***
*Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices. Don't meet every requirement? That's okay! We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

  

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. CRM is a key tool for the firm’s frontline leaders in pursuing commercial objectives, including relationship cultivation, opportunity management, and account plan execution. The CRM Team enables this pursuit by enhancing the platform, processes, analytics, and user experience that support effective commercial decision-making.

Under the direction of the CRM Senior Manager, the
**Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation**
owns core workstreams within the team, driving projects and initiatives across CRM optimization, innovation, analytics, and automation. The role collaborates with senior stakeholders around the globe and independently leads meetings to build alignment, communicate recommendations, and secure buy-in. The role is responsible for owning and executing end-to-end projects focused on process optimization, automation, advanced analytics, and CRM innovation. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Oversee day-to-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity
* Daily task oversight and addressing queries as needs arise with a team of 1-3 direct reports. Provides daily direction as well as ongoing coaching and evaluation of team, including yearly performance reviews and professional development plans.
* Responsible for overseeing the quality of output of the team members. Identifies areas for operational improvement. Proactively resolve problems and escalate issues to the senior leadership, as necessary.
* Leads team in accordance with Bain’s operating principles encouraging optimum performance and an unwavering focus on results. Maintains transparent two-way communication.
* Plans required staffing levels to maintain required processes and procedures. Teams with HR and senior leadership to recruit, interview and hire employees.
* Demonstrated ability to understand company policies/practices and be able to explain this information and advice and influence an audience that is not knowledgeable in this area of the business

  

**Qualification**
**Education**
 Required 

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is required

Preferred

* Master’s degree in business administration - Computer Science, Data Science or a related field is highly preferred

  

**Experience**
 Required

* Salesforce experience
* Project management experience is desired, and a formal certification will be an added advantage
* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems

Preferred

* Overall 10+ years of solid prior experience in enterprise database/information systems from a professional services environment

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

Required

* Experience with:
  + Salesforce / CRM
  + Advanced SQL
  + Advanced Alteryx
  + Python / ML

+ AI / Custom GPT / Agentic AI

* Data Analysis

+ Data Research
+ Data Integrity
+ Data Visualization
+ Automation
+ Project Management
+ Team Leadership

* Able to work closely with teams in other parts of the world, which will require flexible hours.
* Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written language. The candidate must communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and possess a natural intellectual curiosity about Bain’s business.
* Excellent customer management skills to work with internal global clients. We should work with flawless customer service, diligence, and collaboration across internal teams.
* A strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Analyzes trends and monitors problem areas to identify areas for operational improvement.
* Reliable, consistent and mature and able to work independently with a positive attitude.
* Ability to calmly multitask, and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and develop sustainable solutions to deliver practical results
* Should deepen understanding and knowledge of the consulting industry
* Consistent alignment with Bain’s Operating Principles
* Skilled with advanced Excel and PowerPoint

  

Preferred

* Experience with:

* ServiceNow
* Coaching
* Mentoring
* Training
* Advanced Tableau
* Helpdesk support (email, live user training)

title: Service Delivery Manager, gTech Ads Customer Experience
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross-functional teams to drive these changes.
* 7 years of experience in a customer or client-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Demonstrated expertise in spreadsheet-based financial modeling, resource planning, and building multi-variable operational scenarios.
* Experience collaborating with and presenting to technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineers, and Executive leaders), including the ability to influence roadmap decisions and hold technical teams accountable to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with managing large-scale global vendor operations, outsourced partner networks, or shared services environments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational metrics (e.g., Customer Handling Time, deflection, reopen rates, accuracy) to extract actionable insights.

**About the job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
  
  
This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real-world performance metrics.
  
  
Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well-being, Google provides support for any non-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the end-to-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Required Senior Project Manager**

**Location : New Delhi**

**Experience : 8–12 years**

**Role Summary**

The Senior Project Manager will lead end-to-end execution of commercial office interior fit-out projects, ensuring timely delivery, cost control, quality, and client satisfaction. The role involves overseeing project teams, managing contractors and vendors, coordinating with design and procurement teams, and driving project performance, profitability, and compliance across multiple project sites.

Job Responsibilities

1. Project Planning & Governance

* Lead end-to-end project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution in alignment with client expectations and organisational objectives.
* Establish project milestones, resource plans, performance indicators, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Ensure adherence to project timelines, budgets, quality standards, and safety regulations.
* Identify execution risks and implement corrective measures to minimise delays and cost overruns.

2. Project Execution & Team Management

* Oversee on-site execution of civil, carpentry, finishing, and interior fit-out works, excluding MEP scope.
* Manage multiple project teams, contractors, vendors, and specialist agencies to ensure timely and quality delivery.
* Monitor project progress, construction sequencing, manpower deployment, and material availability.
* Coordinate with design, procurement, and commercial teams to resolve site-level challenges and ensure smooth execution.

title: Product Executive
description:
* **Company Description**
  NFX Digital is a data-driven digital marketing company transforming the consumer and marketing research landscape in India. Through its flagship platform Adytude.com, NFX Digital blends traditional research instruments with innovative, digital-first methodologies to deliver fast, cost-effective, and statistically robust insights

**About the Role**

* **Experience:**

  1–2 years
* **Work Mode:**

  Full-time, Work from Office

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.

title: Founder's Office
description:
Full-time · Some travel

Antahā

Antahā is a global movement creating micro-communities across major cities to address loneliness at scale. Built on three core values: Compassion, Connection, Community.

The ambition is large. The method is intimate. Loneliness is not solved by reach alone, by digital tools, or by any system that removes the human from the centre. It is solved by people who actually show up — for one another, for an evening, for a quiet space to belong in.

**About the Work**

Sitender Sehrawat is a teacher shaped by years of monastic living in the Himalayas. His work spans teaching, hosting signature events and intimate gatherings, and private one-on-one consulting. The work is active across Europe, the US, and the Gulf, and it is scaling fast across cities and continents.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Founder's Office Manager to be the operational spine of everything Sitender does. The bridge between Sitender and the world— the person who holds the whole picture, ensures nothing is dropped, and protects the founder's time for the work only he can do: teaching, hosting, and building.

You will run the day-to-day across event logistics, the founder's speaking and teaching calendar, marketing, and social media — the full surface area of a founder's office. This role suits someone equal parts organised and intuitive: capable of managing a tour spreadsheet down to the last detail and sensing what a moment, a room, or a relationship needs. You will work closely with a distributed team across India, Europe, and the US.

**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end event logistics — venues, vendors, travel, run-of-show, and on-ground coordination for events, gatherings, and retreats
* Manage the founder's speaking and teaching calendar — inbound requests, scheduling, preparation, and follow-up
* Drive marketing execution across channels — campaigns, partner briefs, content scheduling, and asset coordination
* Run social media end-to-end — posting, community engagement, growth, and maintaining a consistent voice and aesthetic
* Coordinate across a distributed team and external collaborators spanning multiple time zones
* Keep the office of the founder moving — inbox triage, prioritisation, and ensuring projects don't stall
* Anticipate needs before they arise, so the founder can stay present to the work

**Who You Are**

*Essential*

* 3+ years in operations, executive support, chief-of-staff, or founder's office roles
* Exceptional organiser who thrives across many moving parts without losing the details
* Strong written communicator with a feel for brand voice and visual consistency
* Comfortable owning social media and marketing execution
* Calm under pressure, discreet, and self-directed — you don't need to be managed
* Drawn to the work of stillness and inner growth, and at ease in a space that values presence over noise

*Preferred*

* Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing figure
* Background in events, hospitality, or a fast-moving operation with many moving parts
* A personal practice in meditation, somatic work, or related modalities
* Multilingual (Italian, Arabic, or others a plus)

**Personal Qualities**

* You hold complexity calmly — many threads at once, nothing dropped
* Quiet confidence and sound judgement; people trust you with what matters
* Discretion, depth, and integrity in all things
* A genuine desire to grow through this work, inwardly as well as professionally

**What You Receive**

* Competitive compensation, with structure and benefits discussed directly based on experience and location
* A rare seat at the centre of a growing body of work — teaching, events, and a movement being planted across cities worldwide
* Direct collaboration with the founder and a depth of perspective few roles offer
* Access to all events and sessions as a participant — your own growth is part of the role
* Room to grow as the work expands across the US, Europe, the Gulf, and beyond

**Education & Background**

We don't pay much attention to where you went to school — or whether you did. A degree is welcome but not necessary. What matters is capability, character, and care. We're looking for the kind of person whose reliability and judgement have shaped the path they've walked, however unconventional that path has been.

**Compensation & Onboarding**

This role begins with an 8-week probation period. During these first eight weeks, you'll be paid a mutually agreed figure while we both find our rhythm and see the work in motion. On successful completion — based on performance and delivery — you'll step into the role permanently, with a full CTC
upwards
of 6 LPA, commensurate with experience and growing as the work expands across cities.

**To Apply**

Send a personal note to hello@antaha.org — not just a CV. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this work, and why this role calls to you. We won't respond to generic applications; we're looking for a specific kind of human being, and we'll know when we find them.

www.antaha.org

title: Assistant-Program
description:
**Overview**
Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
  
  
Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems. Jhpiego currently works in over 14 states of India, focusing on women’s health — including maternal, reproductive, and women’s cancers — and provides technical assistance to governments on health systems, human resources, quality of care, health surveillance, digital health, and primary health care.
  
  
SAAKSHI (Strengthening Access to Affordable and Quality Healthcare for Worker Communities through Awareness, Prevention, and Public Health Linkages) is a three-year initiative supported by the H&M Foundation, working in Panipat’s textile recycling ecosystem. The project will strengthen health, hygiene, and workforce stability for 1,500 migrant workers and their families by establishing integrated, community-owned primary healthcare access systems; strengthening preventive and occupational health practices at the workplace and in the community; and driving behaviour change and facilitation support to increase uptake of Government health and social protection schemes, including PM-JAY and ESIC.
  
  
The project is organised around three sub-goals: (1) improving sustained access to preventive, occupational, and primary healthcare; (2) enabling behaviour change and community ownership for long-term outcomes; and (3) strengthening local systems, governance, and frontline capacity to sustain impact.
  
  
The Senior Assistant- Program will support the implementation of community-based project activities and work closely with migrant worker communities, public health systems, employers, frontline health workers, and community leaders. The role requires strong field coordination, community engagement, and stakeholder management skills to ensure effective delivery of project interventions
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support implementation of community outreach, health promotion, and occupational health activities.
* Mobilize communities for health camps, screenings, awareness sessions, and enrolment drives.
* Facilitate access to government health and social protection schemes, including PM-JAY, ESIC, and other welfare programs.
* Coordinate with ASHAs, ANMs, public health facilities, hospitals, employers, and community stakeholders.
* Support identification and capacity building of community champions and peer leaders.
* Assist in establishing and strengthening workplace health and safety committees.
* Maintain project records, beneficiary databases, activity reports, and referral tracking systems.

Contribute to data collection, monitoring, reporting, and project review processes
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in development studies, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in public health, community development, social protection, or related programs.
* Experience in community mobilization, behavior change communication, and stakeholder engagement.
* Familiarity with government health systems and social welfare schemes is desirable.
* Experience working with migrant populations, urban health, or occupational health programs will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong community mobilization and facilitation abilities.
* Good documentation, reporting, and data management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and digital data collection tools.
* Ability to work independently in field settings and manage multiple priorities.
* Fluency in Hindi; working knowledge of English preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Panipat and surrounding areas.

title: Associate Fire Engineer
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
  
  
We are an independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants and technical specialists offering a broad range of professional services. Through our work, we make a positive difference in the world.
  
  
As an Associate Fire Engineer you will be working with a creative, innovative, multi-cultural and self-motivated team of fire safety consultants in India, the wider UKIMEA region and globally. The successful candidate will complement our fire safety consultants by assisting with the implementation of fire engineering solutions and fire strategies across our projects. Due to our geographic location, we are very well positioned to work closely with our fire teams globally. It's an exciting time to be a part of our growth in India.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The successful candidate will form part of the project team on a range of different projects, managing junior engineers, and being supported by the wider team as necessary. The role will involve interactive and collaborative working with our fire engineers and with colleagues throughout the multidisciplinary teams at Arup. The projects will be diverse, exciting and range from conceptual fire strategy and masterplan developments through to detailed design and handing over landmark projects.
  
  
Our Fire Engineering team takes a particularly active role in the development of our people and routinely provide opportunities to attend appropriate training and development courses. Also, because of the developing nature of fire engineering, employees are encouraged to attend annual conferences and CPD events (both internal and external). Once you have demonstrated a suitable skill level in fire engineering and delivery of projects there will be a number of opportunities to advance your career.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is technically excellent and capable of delivering quality fire safety solutions on time and on budget. A proven track record of gaining agreement for prescriptive and performance-based design solutions from approving authorities is also essential.
  
  
As a senior member of the Fire team, you will have strong communication and negotiating skills and experience of leading project teams. You will be a team player capable of imparting knowledge and experience to other members of the team to grow and develop them under your support.
  
  
You should have strong commercial and client facing skills and be able to represent Arup externally with minimal supervision. An existing portfolio of clients / contacts in the industry would be of benefit.
  
  
Experience in the principles of smoke control and means of escape are essential and knowledge of fire safety codes, standards and guidance associated with the industry is also important.
  
  
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
  
  
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
  
  
**Is this role right for you?**
**We Are Looking For Candidates With**

* A minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant degree subject (fire engineering, other types of engineering, or architecture related degree).
* Chartered status with a relevant institution such as the Institution of Fire Engineers or be close to gaining Chartered Engineer status or equivalent (e.g. Professional Engineer in USA).
* 7+ years’ experience in a consultancy or similar environment with at least 3 years in a similar senior position. Extensive experience in delivering fire engineered solutions.
* Awareness of industry challenges and code changes and experience in implementation in projects as well as discussing/presenting to clients and stakeholders on the topic.
* Knowledge of IBC and NFPA codes and standards would be a benefit but not essential.
* Be familiar with RIBA stages of design or other design frameworks and understand the total fire concept: from the client brief through to construction and operation, the fire engineering challenges relevant to different design stages and the level/type of fire engineering input required to progress the design and contribute to completion.
* Experience in managing other engineers in the development and implementation of fire strategies, projects, and research initiatives.
* Experience in managing financial performance on projects.
* Experience in negotiation and agreement of scope, fee, contractual terms and conditions with clients. Understand and manage the scope and relevant programme constraints of projects, experience in project changes management.
* Experience in presenting and discussing design solutions, including fire engineering assessments, to approving authorities and other stakeholders.
* Experience in teaching, mentoring and supporting junior engineers in their career development.
* Excellent report writing, presentation and communication skills, be collaborative, be creative and engaging.
* Experience in business development activities and establishing a network of clients / colleagues inside and outside Arup.

**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance
  
  
**Different people, shared values**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**
If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
  
  
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

title: Interior Design Project Manager
description:
Job Summary

Epic Studio is seeking an experienced interior design project manager to plan, manage, and deliver interior projects from initiation through handover. The ideal candidate will oversee project schedules, budgets, site execution, contractor performance, procurement, and quality control while ensuring projects are completed on time and within approved costs.

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)1. Project Planning & Scheduling

· Develop project execution plans, timelines, milestones, and resource plans.

· Coordinate design approvals, procurement schedules, and site activities.

· Monitor progress against the project program and resolve delays.

2. Budget & Cost Management

· Prepare and monitor project budgets, estimates, and cost plans.

· Track expenses, variations, purchase orders, and contractor bills.

· Control project costs while maintaining quality standards.

· Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising design intent.

3. Site Execution & Coordination

· Manage day-to-day site execution and coordinate contractors, supervisors, and vendors.

· Coordinate civil, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, ceiling, flooring, and finishing works.

· Resolve site issues, drawing conflicts and execution bottlenecks.

· Conduct regular site inspections and progress reviews.

4. Procurement & Vendor Management

· Coordinate material procurement, delivery schedules, and installation.

· Evaluate vendor quotations, contractor capabilities, and work quality.

· Monitor material availability and prevent procurement-related delays.

· Ensure compliance with approved specifications.

5. Quality, Safety & Compliance

· Establish quality-check procedures and inspection milestones.

· Ensure work follows approved drawings, specifications, and applicable safety requirements.

· Maintain snag lists and track corrective actions until closure.

· Ensure proper documentation and approvals.

6. Client & Stakeholder Management

· Conduct progress meetings and communicate project status to clients.

· Manage client expectations, changes, and approvals.

· Coordinate between design teams, site teams, consultants, vendors, and management.

7. Project Closure & Handover

· Conduct final inspections and ensure snag rectification.

· Coordinate testing, commissioning, cleaning, and handover documentation.

· Obtain client sign-off and review project performance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·        On-time project completion.

·        Actual cost versus approved budget.

·        Quality inspection pass rate and rework costs.

·        Procurement and material delivery adherence.

·        Site productivity and issue-resolution time.

·        Client satisfaction and successful project handover.

Required Skills & Qualifications

· Degree or diploma in interior design, civil engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.

· 6–10 years of experience in interior fit-outs or turnkey interior projects.

· Strong understanding of BOQs, estimates, schedules, contractor billing, and procurement.

· Experience with MS Project, Excel, AutoCAD, or similar project management tools.

· Strong leadership, negotiation, planning, and communication skills.
