SE/HSD Department of Health Systems Development
  
  
**Schedule**
Full-time
**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**
Please note that the deadline for receipt of applications indicated above reflects your personal device's system settings.
  
  
**Area of expertise**
Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance and/or laboratory strengthening for AMR
  
  
**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia is establishing a roster of qualified consultants who may be engaged for specific assignments to strengthen national and regional AMR surveillance, clinical microbiology services and laboratory systems. Assignments may cover surveillance design and assessment; implementation and reporting through the Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS); bacteriology and mycology capacity; diagnostic stewardship; laboratory networks and quality systems; data quality, analysis, interpretation and visualization; One Health and genomic surveillance; capacity development; operational research; and translation of surveillance evidence into policy and programme action.
  
  
Depending on the individual Terms of Reference, consultants will provide technical assistance for planning, implementation, analysis and reporting using WHO tools, standards and recommendations. They may also contribute to evidence-based technical guidance, protocols, standard operating procedures, training packages and implementation tools.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance is a major public health and development challenge in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Member States need timely, representative and quality-assured data on resistance patterns and antimicrobial use to guide national action plans, clinical and public health interventions, laboratory strategies, stewardship, infection prevention and control, and resource allocation.
  
  
Reliable laboratory systems are essential for effective AMR surveillance, including accurate bacterial and fungal identification, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, diagnostic stewardship, specimen referral, quality management and standardized data flows. WHO supports Member States, country offices and partners to strengthen sustainable surveillance and laboratory systems aligned with WHO standards and GLASS. This roster will help WHO SEARO identify specialists for time-bound regional or country assignments based on emerging needs.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under The Overall Guidance Of WHO Technical Unit, Consultants May Be Requested To Perform One Or More Of The Following Assignments (a More Specific Terms Of Reference (TORs), Including The Exact Deliverables, Duration Of Assignment And Place Of Assignment Will Be Shared With The Selected Candidate At The Time Of Hiring For a Specific Assignment):
  
  
****Deliverable 1: Surveillance and laboratory assessment.****
Conduct desk or country assessment of AMR surveillance systems, data flows, governance arrangements, indicators, data quality, bacteriology and mycology capacity, laboratory networks, diagnostic stewardship and reporting processes, with prioritized and feasible recommendations
  
  
****Deliverable 2: Technical products and implementation tools.****
Design assignment-specific protocols, standard operating procedures, data dictionaries, validation checklists, surveillance tools, indicator frameworks, laboratory-strengthening plans, survey materials, diagnostic-stewardship tools, guidance documents or One Health implementation products
  
  
****Deliverable 3: Data and analytical outputs.****
Develop cleaned or validated datasets; statistical, microbiological or genomic analyses; reproducible code or pipelines; tables, figures, maps, dashboards or visualization specifications; interpretation notes; and quality documentation, as applicable
  
  
****Deliverable 4: Laboratory and diagnostic products.****
Adapt guidance documents, training packages and tools for clinical bacteriology and mycology; laboratory quality management; antimicrobial susceptibility testing; external quality assurance; specimen referral; laboratory networks; and diagnostic stewardship.
  
  
****Deliverable 5: Capacity-development package.****
Develop training needs findings, curricula, presentations, exercises, job aids, workshop or webinar facilitation, mentoring records and a brief evaluation of learning and follow-up needs.
  
  
****Deliverable 6: Reporting and knowledge products.****
Prepare GLASS submission-related outputs, national or regional surveillance reports, laboratory-capacity reports, policy briefs, technical reports, manuscripts, systematic reviews, presentations or other communication products.
  
  
****Educational Qualifications****
**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**
**Essential:**
**Band level B:**
A first university degree or medical degree in epidemiology, public health, medicine, clinical microbiology, laboratory sciences, biostatistics, statistics, mathematical modelling, health informatics, data science, computer science, bioinformatics, veterinary public health, environmental health, pharmacy, health economics or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Band level C:**
An advanced university degree or medical degree with postgraduate specialization in one of the fields listed above or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
Desirable: Additional postgraduate training, specialization or professional certification relevant to the technical profile, such as clinical microbiology, bacteriology, mycology, field epidemiology, laboratory quality management, diagnostic stewardship, data analytics, geographic information systems, genomic epidemiology, health information systems, monitoring and evaluation, or adult learning.
  
  
****Experience****
Essential
  
  
Band level B: At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the technical profiles advertised.
  
  
**Band Level C:**

* At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the advertised technical profiles.
* Demonstrated experience producing high-quality, assignment-relevant outputs such as surveillance assessments, protocols, analytical products, laboratory tools, technical reports, training packages, dashboards, scientific publications or policy products.
* For laboratory-focused assignments, essential experience may include one or more of the following:
* Implementation of recognized antimicrobial susceptibility testing standards, such as CLSI or EUCAST.
* Microbiological proficiency testing or external quality-assurance programmes.
* Bacteriology or mycology laboratory assessments and laboratory-system strengthening.
* Mycological diagnosis, diagnostic stewardship or laboratory quality management.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with AMR surveillance and GLASS-related methods, tools or reporting.
* Experience working with ministries of health, national AMR programmes, public health institutes, reference laboratories, academic institutions or One Health coordination mechanisms.
* Experience in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in the WHO South-East Asia Region.
* Experience with WHO, another United Nations entity or an international public health organization.
* Experience facilitating multidisciplinary or multisectoral work and transferring skills to national teams.
* Experience implementing infectious-disease surveys or clinical research studies in accordance with good clinical and data-management practices.
* A publication record in peer-reviewed journals or authorship of technical guidance, national reports, research proposals, systematic reviews or evidence-synthesis products.
* Experience developing and applying bioinformatics pipelines, where relevant to the assignment.

**Essential**
**Skills and knowledge**

* Advanced knowledge and competence in at least one advertised technical profile, with a sound understanding of public health surveillance or laboratory-system principles relevant to the assignment.
* Ability to apply relevant WHO standards, methods and tools to national or regional contexts.
* Ability to analyse complex information, assure data or laboratory quality, interpret findings and formulate practical recommendations.
* Excellent technical writing, presentation and communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and policy audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in multicultural and multidisciplinary settings and to deliver quality outputs within agreed timelines.
* For laboratory-focused assignments, essential competencies may include quality-assured microbiological testing, assessment of bacteriology or mycology laboratories, and design or implementation of external quality-assurance programmes.

Desirable
  
  

* Knowledge of GLASS, national AMR surveillance systems, One Health surveillance and relevant laboratory standards.
* Knowledge of laboratory networks and specimen-referral systems in resource-limited settings and associated challenges.
* Proficiency in one or more relevant platforms or languages, such as R, R Markdown, R Shiny, Python, SQL, Power BI, DHIS2, geographic information systems, statistical software, laboratory information systems, web technologies or bioinformatics tools.
* Knowledge of data governance, privacy, security, interoperability and reproducible analytical practices.
* Knowledge of adult learning, training design, facilitation and mentoring approaches.

****Languages And Level Required****
Essential: Expert knowledge of English.
  
  
Desirable: Intermediate or expert knowledge of another official United Nations language or a language used in a WHO South-East Asia Region Member State, where relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Location**
Consultancies may be: Home-based, Country-based, Regional Office-based, or a combination of remote and in-country support. The duty arrangement for each consultancy will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference.
  
  
**Travel**
The consultant may be expected to travel to one or more WHO South-East Asia Region Member States for country assessments, laboratory assessments, technical consultations, training or other assignment-related activities. Travel dates, locations and purpose will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference and arranged in accordance with applicable WHO policies.
  
  
**Remuneration and budget (travel costs are excluded)**
**Remuneration:**
Band level B and/or Band level C, as applicable to the assignment. The daily or monthly rate will be established in accordance with the applicable WHO consultant remuneration guidance and stated in the individual Terms of Reference.
  
  
**Living expenses:**
Not applicable for home-based work. When an assignment requires on-site presence or travel, applicable travel and subsistence arrangements will be specified separately in accordance with WHO policies.
  
  
**Expected duration of contract**
: Roster assignments may range from short inputs to several months, up to a maximum of 11 months per calendar year. Each individual Terms of Reference will specify the contract duration, number of working days and, for part-time assignments, the expected percentage or level of effort.

title: Senior Network Service Implementation (NSI) Manager
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior NSI Manager, you will drive international network migration projects that enhance scalability, optimize network performance, and deliver high operational standards with adept project management and cultural insight.
  
  

* Lead and manage the implementation and deployment of network migration projects to enhance optimization and scalability within the global enterprise network.
* Oversee multiple operations within the portfolio to ensure deployments are completed on time and meet quality standards.
* Perform technical and economic analyses to identify optimal solutions while ensuring compliance with engineering, business, environmental, and safety standards.
* Validate and verify documentation and compliance of studies conducted by external service providers.
* Coordinate stakeholder agreements and manage ordering processes to promote smooth operations.
* Conduct site visits and autonomously manage complex network operations, providing clear and detailed reporting.
* Implement cross-business and operational improvement plans to enhance deployment strategies continuously.
* Deploy network hardware such as routers, switches, and firewalls efficiently during greenfield and brownfield migration projects, ensuring operational readiness.
* Configure and test network equipment in staging environments prior to field shipment to ensure optimal performance and minimize deployment issues.
* Develop and implement comprehensive Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for high-risk network changes to minimize downtime and maintain service continuity.
* Supervise physical layer tasks including cable patching and labeling to uphold data center standards and facilitate maintenance.
* Conduct thorough post-deployment validation to verify adherence to design specifications and operational effectiveness.
* Produce detailed As-Built documentation and updated network diagrams to support seamless transition to network operations teams.

**About You**
You demonstrate hands-on proficiency with Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista platforms, ensuring comprehensive hardware deployment. Your strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs supports robust network configuration and operation. Skilled in scripting languages like Python and Bash along with automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform, you enable scalable deployment processes. Your experience with hybrid cloud connectivity involving AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute is strong. You also maintain detail-oriented execution of technical procedures to ensure reliability. With over 8-10 years in network engineering and deployment-focused roles, along with CCNA or CompTIA Network+ certification (CCNP or JNCIP preferred), your methodical approach and communication skills enable alignment across stakeholders during complex network migrations.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Demonstrates proficient hands-on expertise with network hardware platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista to facilitate comprehensive deployments.
* Possesses a thorough understanding of network protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs, enabling stable network configuration and operation.
* Utilizes scripting languages like Python and Bash alongside automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform to promote scalable, efficient deployment processes.
* Applies practical know-how in establishing hybrid cloud interconnections like AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute to improve network connectivity.
* Maintains strong attention to detail, rigorously performing technical procedures to minimize errors and ensure process reliability.

**Your soft skills:**

* Exhibits adaptability and resilience, maintaining composure while addressing unforeseen challenges during network deployment activities.
* Communicates complex technical information clearly to align all stakeholders during maintenance and migration phases.
* Employs excellent time management skills to ensure network deployment projects meet established schedules and deadlines.
* Approaches problem resolution through logical analysis and systematic isolation of faults, avoiding assumptions.
* Supports clients thoughtfully throughout network transitions, fostering trust and confidence during change processes.

Join Orange to bring your expertise to large-scale network projects in a collaborative environment that values precision, cultural awareness, and continuous improvement. As a Senior NSI Manager, you will shape the future of global network deployment by leading efficient initiatives that enhance connectivity and operational excellence.
  
  
**What We Offer**

You’ll own what happens after a customer signs — getting them live, keeping them healthy, and helping them grow.

**Run the implementations**

You’ve done this before — carried customers from signed to live to growing, and you’ve done it for more than one at a time without losing the thread.

* Salary + Bonus + Equity

Ready to build in the next dimension? We're not looking for someone to maintain a project. We're looking for someone to define the future of patient & practice experiences. Apply to join our mission!

title: Head - NPL
description:
**Job Description**
**JoJob Description / Area of Responsibility**

* Lead the end-to-end Operations workstream for the development and flawless launch of advanced, safety-critical automotive mechatronic systems across two focus factories. Integrate mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software disciplines; align worldwide stakeholders, customers and suppliers; and deliver industrialization, quality, cost, timing, capacity and ramp-up targets. Provide decisive, hands-on leadership in a highly dynamic environment and coach launch teams.
* Support quotations and business cases with operations feasibility, industrial concepts, footprint and capacity scenarios, investment estimates, launch timing and risk assessment for complex mechatronic products. Ensure assumptions cover both focus factories and the required revenue-growth roadmap.
* Define Operations targets for safety, quality, cost, timing, scope, capacity and launch maturity across both focus factories. Establish project governance, decision rights, integrated master plan, gate deliverables, cadence, documentation and escalation paths.
* Build and lead the global launch team; secure resources and ownership with line management. Drive early risk management, manufacturing concept selection, make-or-buy inputs and work-package definition.
* Align factory readiness and industrialization strategy with the growth path from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue. Lead operations delivery for the complete mechatronic system, integrating mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces.
* Translate product requirements into robust manufacturing, assembly, testing, traceability and end-of-line concepts. Drive DfM/DfA, design reviews, process validation, equipment implementation, supplier readiness and capacity installation.
* Staff, direct and coach the two-factory launch team; resolve cross-functional dependencies and resource conflicts. Ensure all deliverables meet customer, regulatory, safety, cost, quality and timing requirements. Control the integrated plan and recover deviations through clear owners, countermeasures and escalation.
* Manage capital expenditure, tooling, launch costs, labor, ramp-up cost and obsolete-material exposure against approvals. Lead APQP, FMEA, control-plan, capability, test-coverage, traceability, line-release, PPAP and safe-launch readiness.
* Coordinate equipment, process, component, logistics and software-release maturity across both factories. Run risk-based launch reviews and drive rapid problem solving to achieve a stable, flawless ramp-up.
* Maintain one transparent, fact-based status for both factories covering milestones, budget, quality, capacity, resources, risks and decisions. Report gate maturity and forecast to Project Management, Operations leadership, plant management and executive steering committees.
* Escalate product, process, supplier, customer or safety-critical issues early, with impact, containment, recovery plan and required decision. Track actions to closure and ensure disciplined change control.
* Capture lessons learned and standardize reusable launch methods, equipment concepts, controls and best practices across both factories. Drive continuous improvement in yield, cycle time, scrap, reliability, test coverage and launch efficiency. Support warranty, 0-km, field and supplier-quality containment and root-cause resolution. Optimize capacity and requalification throughout the product lifecycle.
* Represent Operations and both focus factories on project, customer, supplier and executive meetings worldwide. Build alignment among diverse stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly, directly and early. Lead feasibility, change and problem-resolution discussions using timing, cost, quality, safety and risk evidence. Maintain a strong customer focus while protecting operational readiness and launch integrity.
* Own the transition from launch through stable serial production and formal handover at both factories. Monitor ramp-up performance, capacity, yield, quality, delivery and cost until agreed exit criteria are achieved.
* Coordinate product maintenance, engineering changes, non-conformance resolution and requalification. Lead capacity adaptations and phase-out preparation in line with business and customer requirements.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, electronics, mechatronics, manufacturing, industrial engineering or a related technical field. At least 15 plus years of progressive experience in automotive or another safety-critical, high-volume industry, including complex mechatronic product development, manufacturing industrialization and launch. Experience across multiple functions or factories is required.
  
  
Demonstrated successful delivery of at least three new-product launches, including a complex multi-site or safety-critical mechatronic program. Strong competence in APQP/PPAP, industrialization, launch planning, risk management, budget control, capacity planning, supplier readiness and structured problem solving.
  
  
At least 5 years as a Launch Manager, Operations Project Manager or comparable cross-functional leader. Proven ability to lead international matrix teams, steer two factories, make timely decisions, escalate effectively and deliver under high pressure.
  
  
Proven leadership of worldwide, multicultural stakeholders across functions, factories, customers and suppliers. Fluent business English is required; additional languages are advantageous. Strong intercultural sensitivity, executive communication and willingness to travel are expected.
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Global Customer, Business Unit and Operations Governance: Expert knowledge of matrix decision-making, escalation paths and stakeholder management across factories and functions. Ability to establish clear governance, accountability and communication in a worldwide project environment
* New Product Launch and Product Lifecycle Management: Expert application of NPL processes, gate reviews, industrialization planning, launch readiness and serial-life handover. Strong command of multi-site launch governance and operational deliverables
* Safety-Critical Quality in Launches: APQP, PPAP, safe launch, line release, control plans, process capability, test coverage and end-to-end traceability. FMEA-based risk prevention and awareness of functional-safety implications for manufacturing and validation
* Operations Program Control and Reporting: Integrated planning, milestone and gate control, resource steering, risk and opportunity management, change control and executive reporting. Rapid problem resolution, disciplined escalation and recovery planning across two factories.
* Manufacturing and Launch Financials: Business-case understanding and management of Capex, tooling, launch cost, labor, ramp-up cost, capacity and obsolete-material exposure. Ability to align industrial investment with growth from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue.
* Advanced Mechatronic Product and Manufacturing Knowledge: Strong system-level understanding of mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces. Manufacturing, assembly, testing, calibration, traceability, software-release and configuration-control concepts
* Customer and Supplier Management: Customer-specific milestones, audits, PPAP, capability and drawing requirements. Executive-level communication, negotiation, expectation management and recovery alignment with customers and suppliers
* Matrix Team Leadership: Lead, motivate and coach international cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority. Delegate outcomes, resolve conflict, manage performance input and create ownership across both focus factories
* Change Management and Complex Problem Resolution: Evaluate changes across system interfaces and quantify impact on safety, quality, timing, cost, capacity and industrial readiness. Drive fast, structured decisions and implementation while keeping worldwide stakeholders aligned.
* Front Loading and Industrial Strategy: Lead early feasibility, manufacturing concept, footprint, capacity, investment and timing assessments for large, complex programs. Challenge assumptions early and convert lessons learned into robust launch concepts

title: Senior Manager
description:

The role will drive digital transformation initiatives, establish enterprise-wide reporting standards, manage PMIS platforms, and lead multidisciplinary teams delivering reporting, analytics, automation, and project controls solutions for business stakeholders and clients.
  
  
Your role
  
  
*PIMS, Platforms & Systems Delivery*

* Manage workflows, integrations, data structures, permissions, user access, and system administration across project environments.

*Reporting, Analytics & Business Intelligence*

* Develop Power BI dashboards, automated reports, KPI scorecards, and performance monitoring solutions for schedule, cost, risk, commercial, resource, and portfolio performance.

* Identify and implement automation opportunities using Power Automate, Power Platform, workflow tools, and AI-enabled reporting capabilities.
* Apply predictive analytics, advanced dashboards, and digital workflows to improve efficiency, data quality, and project outcomes.

* Define and deliver enterprise AI solutions using Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents, and action agents to support project management use cases such as schedule and cost intelligence, risk monitoring, progress tracking, document workflows, decision support, and automated follow-up actions.

* Define data standards, validation checks, access controls, and information management protocols across project systems.
* Improve data integrity, reporting accuracy, audit readiness, and consistency across platforms and dashboards.
* Translate business and project requirements into practical digital, reporting, and data management solutions.

* Experience implementing Microsoft Fabric reporting platforms and Fabric Apps, enterprise AI and agentic solutions, and integrated project or construction management technology stacks; experience with Octave tools is desirable.

* Power BI and other Business Intelligence tool
* Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, semantic models, governance, and Fabric Apps

* Microsoft Power Platforms
* Smartsheet
* Advanced Excel

*Leadership Skills*

* Stakeholder Management
* Team Development
* Digital Transformation
* Change Management
* Client Relationship Management
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement

As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.

* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.

title: Founders’ Office ( Growth & Strategy )
description:
**Founder's Office | Growth Valley Community**

Gurugram (in-office) | Full-time | 1-5 years experience | Reports directly to the Founder

Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred.

Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A
**consistent**
growth story will be awarded.

**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.**

**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.**

**About GVC.**

Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.

Product-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.

**The role.**

You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.

This is the highest-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.

**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment engine.**
  Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.

* **Admissions product.**
  We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.

* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1.**
  A new one-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.

* **Partnerships.**
  Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.

* **The numbers.**
  Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.

**How we will measure you.**

Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.

**Who fits.**

* Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.

**Who should not apply.**

If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.

**Compensation.**

fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG-level.

**Growth path.**

This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.

**How to apply.**

Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com

1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.

Subject line: FO | Your Name | College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

title: Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Trialion AI is an AI-native eClinical suite built on a single continuous data model, unifying EDC, ePRO/eCOA, RTSM, eConsent, medical coding, and site CTMS into one product. Every module reads and writes the same records under a single immutable audit trail, eliminating system reconciliation, connector validation, and data migration during protocol amendments. The platform is designed for rapid study build, live deployment of amendments, and data quality at the point of entry, with AI-assisted workflows always overseen and approved by qualified clinical data professionals. Trialion AI is architected to meet global regulatory standards including 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ICH E6(R3), CDSCO Schedule Y, and the DPDP Act 2023. Built by clinical data and engineering leaders from IQVIA, Vidia, and Aerial Borne, it serves agile CROs, mid-market biopharma, and medical device companies running trials across India and APAC.

**Role Description**
The Clinical Trials Operations & Product Strategy Consultant is a full-time, hybrid role based in Gurugram, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role focuses on shaping product strategy for Trialion’s eClinical platform while ensuring that clinical trial operations are efficient, compliant, and aligned with sponsor and CRO needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include translating trial workflows and regulatory requirements into product features, collaborating with product managers and engineers on study build and data lifecycle design, and conducting operational analyses to improve site and sponsor experiences. The consultant will engage with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, prioritize product enhancements, and support the design and rollout of new modules and capabilities. The role also involves preparing documentation and operational playbooks, contributing to go-to-market activities, and supporting cross-functional teams in India and APAC.

**Qualifications**

* Strong product strategy and product management skills, with the ability to define vision, roadmap, and use cases for eClinical solutions.
* Excellent analytical skills and research capabilities to evaluate clinical operations, user needs, and market trends.
* Experience in product development within clinical trials or healthcare technology, including collaboration with engineering and design teams.
* Solid understanding of clinical trial operations, data management, and regulatory frameworks such as ICH-GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.
* Prior experience working with CROs, biopharma, or medical device organizations, ideally in India or APAC, US markets.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and operational concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
* Demonstrated capability to work in a hybrid environment, managing onsite collaboration in Gurugram and remote responsibilities independently.

* Share project status, timelines, approvals and important updates.

* Take complete ownership of projects from order confirmation to completion.

* Build strong delivery relationships with resources across the company.

**Project Delivery**

* Draft a Project Management Plan/Project Execution Plan and review with Partner in Charge (PIC) and Project Manager (PM).
* Support the development of project schedule.
* Conduct project status check-ins, weekly finance reviews, and share insights with PM for monthly PIC/PM reviews.
* Identify and record out-of-scope work in a Management of Change register.
* Collaborate with PIC and PM to identify and create change orders for additional scope.
* Support engagement of subcontractors and bill contractors ahead of time to reduce project cash flow restrictions.
* Facilitate technical reviews, project updates, and final delivery to meet client expectations.
* Lead the preparation of invoicing per schedule and track payments, following up on payment issues if required.
* Confirm client receipt and approval of invoices and escalate issues to the PIC and PM as needed.
* Build trust through accurate, timely support and transparent communication.
* Facilitate internal and/or client kick-off meetings, distribute team briefs, and maintain channels of communication between Project Leadership and team.
* Ensure all governance approvals and accurate project system set up.
* Support Risk Management processes and execution through preparation, review, and maintenance of a risk register.
* Complete change management and support risk assessments (Project Risk Reviews [PRR]).

title: Program Coordinator/Research Associate
description:
**Number of Position:**
One (1)
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi
  
  
**Organization Name:**
Centre for Chronic Disease Control (CCDC)
  
  
**Organization Profile:**
Centre for Chronic Disease Control (CCDC) is a not-for-profit research organization engaged in knowledge generation and knowledge translation for the prevention and control of non- communicable (chronic) diseases in varied settings of developing countries. CCDC has been recognized as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO) by Department of Scientific & Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. CCDC also holds recognition as a WHO Collaborating Centre for Surveillance, Capacity Building and Translational Research in Cardio-metabolic diseases and is an ICMR Collaborating Centre of Excellence.
  
  
**Project Brief:**
The project aims to improve early detection, referral, management, and follow-up of common chronic health conditions, including hypertension, diabetes and other common chronic conditions, through household-based care, community health camps, digital health technologies, and telemedicine-enabled primary healthcare services.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Program Coordinator/Research Associate will lead the implementation of this project at the site level and serve as the primary liaison between the community, PHC, and central project team. The role involves supervising frontline health workers, coordinating community health camps, supporting teleconsultations, overseeing participant screening and referral processes, and ensuring effective use of DigiSetu, eCDSS, and point-of-care diagnostic technologies. The Program Coordinator/Research Associate will also be responsible for maintaining service quality, monitoring project activities, ensuring protocol compliance, and facilitating continuity of care for study participants.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Site Coordination and Team Supervision
* Lead and coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities at the site.
* Supervise frontline health workers and ensure timely completion of screening, referral, follow-up, and data collection activities.
* Act as the primary point of communication between the study site, healthcare providers, and the central project team.
* Community Health Camps and Service Delivery
* Plan, organize, and oversee community health camps and outreach activities.
* Ensure quality screening, participant registration, counselling, and referral services during camps.
* Support community mobilization and facilitate participant engagement across intervention activities.
* Digital Health and Clinical Coordination
* Coordinate assisted teleconsultations and ensure smooth patient flow through DigiSetu-enabled services.
* Oversee implementation of eCDSS, electronic health records, and digital referral pathways.
* Ensure readiness and appropriate use of point-of-care diagnostic devices and telemedicine equipment.
* Referral Management and Continuity of Care
* Monitor referral completion, teleconsultation uptake, and follow-up care of moderate- and high-risk participants.
* Coordinate with Medical Officers and specialists to facilitate timely clinical evaluation and management.
* Support continuity of care through tracking, documentation, and follow-up mechanisms.
* Quality Assurance, Monitoring, and Reporting
* Monitor adherence to study protocols, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.
* Review and validate screening, referral, teleconsultation, and data records for completeness and accuracy.
* Prepare site reports, participate in review meetings, and provide regular progress updates to the project team.
* Any Other Duties as assigned, based on emerging needs.

**Essential**
Responsibilities and Requirements
  
  

* Master’s degree in public health or an equivalent relevant discipline from recognised institution.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in community health, primary healthcare, public health programmes, outreach activities, or clinical service delivery.
* Experience in coordinating field teams, health camps, community-based screening programmes, or implementation of health projects.
* Familiarity with telemedicine platforms, electronic health records, digital health applications, and point-of- care diagnostic devices.
* Strong communication, leadership, interpersonal, and team management skills.
* Ability to coordinate with healthcare providers, community stakeholders, and project teams.
* Proficiency in the local language (Hindi as applicable) and basic English.
* Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, Zoom, PowerPoint, and digital reporting systems.

**Desirable**

* Experience with government health systems, Primary health centres
* Ability to work independently and manage field responsibilities with minimal supervision
* Join immediately

**Reporting**
The Program Coordinator/Research Associate will report to the Site Investigator and designated central project team member.

title: Head of Operations - Scaffolding & Painting
description:
**Company Description**
Indian Trade Links is a rapidly growing provider of mechanical and industrial services, specializing in industrial scaffolding, piping, civil, mechanical, and painting solutions. With thousands of completed projects across India, the company is recognized as a trusted construction partner delivering safe and cost-effective services. Its diverse, high-quality product range and strong network of reliable vendors support stringent quality standards and competitive pricing. A focus on expertise, ethical business practices, and continuous improvement has positioned Indian Trade Links as a market leader. Candidates can learn more about the company at www.indiantradelinks.in or by contacting info@indiantradelinks.in.

Head of Operations – Scaffolding & Industrial Services

**Company:**
Indian Trade Links

**Position:**
Head of Operations

**Department:**
Operations

**Industry:**
Scaffolding / Industrial Services / Projects

**Location:**
India, with travel to project sites as required

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Level:**
Senior Management

1. Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced and commercially aware
**Head of Operations**
to lead and control our scaffolding and industrial project operations across multiple sites.

The ideal candidate must possess
**strong practical knowledge of scaffolding operations**
, including planning, erection, modification, dismantling, material management, manpower productivity, safety compliance, measurement and billing coordination.

The position will be responsible for ensuring that projects are executed
**safely, efficiently, on schedule and within approved budgets**
, while maintaining strong client relationships.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Scaffolding Operations

* Lead and monitor scaffolding activities across all project sites.
* Have sound knowledge of
  **scaffolding erection, alteration/modification and dismantling**
  .
* Understand different scaffolding systems such as:
* Tube and coupler scaffolding
* Cup-lock/system scaffolding
* Ring-lock/system scaffolding
* Mobile scaffolds
* Birdcage scaffolds
* Suspended and cantilever arrangements, where applicable
* Review scaffolding requirements based on site conditions, work fronts, access requirements and project schedules.
* Ensure proper planning for scaffolding material, manpower and equipment.
* Monitor erected quantity versus dismantled quantity and material utilization.
* Control excessive material consumption, unnecessary scaffolding retention and material losses.

B. Project & Site Management

* Take overall responsibility for operational performance of all active projects.
* Prepare and monitor project mobilization and execution plans.
* Conduct regular reviews with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, Safety personnel and commercial teams.
* Monitor:
* Daily progress
* Planned vs. actual work
* Productivity
* Manpower deployment
* Material availability
* Site constraints
* Client priorities
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action before they affect project commitments.
* Coordinate shutdown, maintenance and high-priority activities with site teams and clients.

C. Manpower & Productivity Management

* Plan manpower requirements project-wise.
* Ensure optimum deployment of scaffolders, helpers, supervisors, engineers and other operational personnel.
* Closely monitor
  **manpower productivity against actual work output**
  .
* Prevent unnecessary overtime and idle manpower.
* Coordinate mobilization and demobilization according to workload.
* Develop capable site supervisors and project leadership teams.

D. Safety & Quality

The Head of Operations must establish a strong safety culture, particularly because scaffolding is a safety-critical activity.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure scaffolding work is executed according to approved procedures, drawings and applicable client/site requirements.
* Ensure inspection and tagging systems are properly followed.
* Ensure use of appropriate fall-protection and personal protective equipment.
* Work closely with the safety team on risk assessments, job safety analysis, toolbox talks and corrective actions.
* Review accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and serious safety observations.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Participate in client safety audits and operational reviews.
* Ensure defective scaffolding material is identified, segregated and prevented from use.

E. Material & Inventory Control

* Monitor scaffolding inventory across stores and project locations.
* Review material requirements before approving additional movement or procurement.
* Control:
* Material shortages
* Excess stock
* Damage
* Loss/theft
* Inter-site transfers
* Return of dismantled material
* Ensure proper reconciliation of scaffolding material at project completion.
* Improve material utilization and reduce unnecessary rental or procurement costs.

F. Commercial & Cost Control

The role should have strong commercial awareness, not only technical knowledge.

* Monitor project budget versus actual expenditure.
* Review manpower, material, equipment and subcontracting costs.
* Support measurement and certification of completed work.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Commercial teams for timely client billing.
* Monitor unbilled work and operational issues delaying certification.
* Understand the commercial implications of additional work and scope changes.
* Support variation/change-order documentation before additional work becomes a commercial dispute.
* Drive improvement in project profitability through productivity and cost control.

G. Client Management

* Act as a senior operational contact for key clients.
* Attend project review meetings with clients.
* Handle operational escalations professionally and promptly.
* Ensure client complaints are closed with proper corrective action.
* Maintain good relationships with client Operations, Projects, Safety, Maintenance and Commercial teams.
* Protect the company's reputation through disciplined and professional site execution.

H. Reporting & Management Review

Prepare/review weekly and monthly operational dashboards covering:

* Project-wise progress
* Scaffolding quantities
* Manpower deployment
* Productivity
* Safety performance
* Material utilization
* Billing status
* Cost performance
* Major site constraints
* Client issues
* Pending decisions
* Recovery/action plans

Escalate critical issues to management with
**clear facts, financial/operational impact and recommended action**
.

3. Required Experience

* Preferably
  **10+ years of experience**
  in industrial/project operations, with substantial experience in scaffolding operations.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of scaffolding erection and dismantling activities.
* Experience managing
  **multiple industrial project sites**
  is highly desirable.
* Experience dealing with large industrial clients, EPC contractors, steel plants, power plants, refineries or similar facilities is preferred.
* Experience managing large site manpower and supervisory teams.
* Good understanding of project costing, productivity and commercial controls.

4. Educational Qualification

Preferred:

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in
  **Mechanical, Civil, Industrial or a related engineering discipline**
  .

Relevant scaffolding, safety or project-management certifications will be an advantage.

For an exceptionally experienced scaffolding operations professional,
**strong practical project experience may be considered alongside formal qualifications**
.

5. Essential Scaffolding Knowledge

The candidate should be able to confidently discuss and review:

* Scaffold types and their applications
* Erection and dismantling sequence
* Working platforms and access
* Guardrails and toe boards
* Bracing, ties and stability
* Base arrangements and foundations
* Loading considerations
* Inspection and tagging
* Work-at-height controls
* Material identification
* Scaffolding quantity measurement
* Material reconciliation
* Manpower productivity
* Safe modification of existing scaffolds
* Planning for shutdown and maintenance scaffolding

6. Key Skills

* Strong leadership and decision-making
* Excellent scaffolding operational knowledge
* Multi-site project management
* Manpower planning
* Cost and budget control
* Client management
* Safety leadership
* Material management
* Problem solving
* Negotiation
* Commercial awareness
* Strong communication and reporting skills
* Ability to work under pressure and manage urgent site requirements

7. Key Performance Indicators

Performance of the Head of Operations should be measured using objective business and project metrics such as:

* Safety compliance
* Project schedule adherence
* Scaffolding productivity
* Manpower utilization
* Material utilization and recovery
* Reduction in material loss/damage
* Project cost versus budget
* Billing and measurement readiness
* Client issue closure
* Rework reduction
* Timely mobilization/demobilization
* Project close-out performance

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a
**strong operations leader who understands scaffolding from the ground level and can also manage the commercial side of projects**
.

* The candidate should be comfortable moving between a project site, a client review meeting and a management profitability review. This is
  **not purely an office-based managerial position**
  . Regular involvement with project sites and operational teams will be essential.

title: Associate-Delivery Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed, by supporting the delivery and operations of technology capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, the team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for external customers and internal colleagues. It also encompasses product management for core enterprise platforms, as well as technology risk and information security; enterprise data governance and platforms; digital product and design; and enterprise AI platforms across American Express.
  
  
We provide technology delivery leadership that turns complex enterprise priorities into execution, connecting strategy, teams, dependencies and governance to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The Associate, Delivery Management supports the execution of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives across Project Diamond and Customer Trust. Reporting to the Director of Technology Delivery, this role works across Technology, Product, and Business teams to help move delivery forward—maintaining clear plans, surfacing risks and dependencies early, driving follow-through on commitments, and ensuring leaders have an accurate view of progress and areas requiring attention.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who is highly organized, curious, and comfortable working through ambiguity. The successful candidate will be able to get into the details of an issue, understand what is preventing progress, connect dependencies across teams, and translate complex technical discussions into clear actions and delivery implications.
  
  
The Associate will also use AI-enabled tools and automation to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of delivery management, reporting, documentation, and follow-through
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Execution:**

* Support day-to-day execution of technology initiatives across Project Diamond and Customer Trust, from planning through implementation.
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestones, commitments, dependencies, and critical dates across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Track work through key delivery stages and maintain a clear view of what is complete, what remains, and what is required to reach the next milestone.
* Identify deviations from plan early, understand the underlying cause and delivery impact, and drive appropriate follow-up with accountable owners.
* Coordinate cross-team activities required to resolve blockers, close dependencies, and maintain delivery momentum.
* Support implementation readiness, including tracking required testing, approvals, sign-offs, deployment dependencies, contingency plans, and other exit criteria.
* Support change management when scope, timing, dependencies, or delivery assumptions change.

**Risk, Dependency & Decision Management**

* Maintain clear visibility into risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions across assigned initiatives.
* Go beyond documenting blockers by helping establish the path to resolution: what needs to happen, who owns it, by when, and when escalation is required.
* Identify upstream and downstream dependencies across applications, platforms, teams, and initiatives and assess their impact on delivery plans.
* Track open decisions and ensure unresolved items are surfaced to the appropriate decision-makers with the context needed to act.
* Escalate material risks and issues early, with a clear articulation of impact, actions underway, and leadership support required.
* Drive actions and commitments through closure and ensure outcomes are reflected in the overall delivery plan.

**Governance & Executive Communication**

* Facilitate working sessions, checkpoints, and governance forums focused on execution, decisions, risks, dependencies, and next steps.
* Prepare concise, fact-based status updates that clearly communicate what changed, what is at risk, the path forward, and where leadership intervention is required.
* Maintain accurate program-level reporting across milestones, delivery health, risks, dependencies, and commitments.
* Support Program Increment (PI) planning and PI closeout, including scope, commitments, carryover, dependencies, delivery forecasts, and outcomes.
* Help ensure governance forums are decision- and action-oriented rather than primarily status-reporting exercises.

**Technical & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Technology, Product, Business, and other delivery teams to understand execution plans and cross-functional dependencies.
* Participate in technical discussions involving APIs, application integrations, data flows, environments, testing, deployment, and system dependencies.
* Develop sufficient technical understanding to ask effective questions, identify delivery implications, and recognize when additional technical expertise or escalation is needed.
* Translate technical discussions into clear business and delivery terms, including decisions, actions, risks, dependencies, owners, and timing.
* Connect related issues across teams and workstreams to help identify potential downstream impacts before they affect delivery.

**AI-Enabled Delivery**

* Use AI-enabled tools to improve project tracking, meeting synthesis, status reporting, risk and action management, documentation, and follow-through.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, appropriate context, and alignment with source information before use.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive delivery-management activities and improve the timeliness and consistency of program information.
* Help establish practical, responsible ways to incorporate AI into day-to-day delivery-management workflows.

**Qualifications**

* 5 Years of experience.
* Experience in technology delivery, program/project management, technology operations, or a related discipline.
* Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, dependencies, and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to track complex work, identify gaps or risks, and drive actions through completion.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to move from a reported issue to an understanding of root cause, impact, and path to resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise updates for different audiences, including senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of technology delivery concepts such as APIs, system integrations, data flows, testing environments, application dependencies, release management, and production implementation.
* Ability to work effectively across Technology, Product, and Business teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* High attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of broader program objectives and critical priorities.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans may change.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, business processes, and AI-enabled tools.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
description:
**Position Title:**
AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43595
  
  
**Overview**
Our Digital Technology team's goal is to leverage technology and data to drive profitable growth, enhance customer experience, and further our purpose of celebrating real connections through delicious, planet-friendly food.
  
  
McCain has embarked on an ambitious digital transformation across our business, from Agriculture and Manufacturing to Commercial and Corporate Functions. As part of this transformation, we are making significant investments in digital capabilities, data, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
  
  
The AI Deployment & Enablement Lead plays a critical role in helping McCain realize value from AI investments by driving successful deployment, adoption, and business enablement of AI solutions across the enterprise. This role serves as the bridge between AI product teams, technology teams, business stakeholders, and end users to ensure AI capabilities are effectively implemented, embraced, and sustained.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong project execution, stakeholder management, change leadership, and business acumen to accelerate adoption of AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, decision making, employee experience, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Reporting to the AI Deployment & Enablement Manager, the AI Deployment & Enablement Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the deployment and adoption of AI solutions across McCain.
  
  
This role partners closely with product owners, AI engineers, business teams, functional leaders, and change management partners to ensure AI capabilities are successfully launched, effectively utilized, and continuously improved. The role focuses on driving business readiness, user adoption, training, communications, stakeholder engagement, value realization, and operational enablement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilites**
**AI Deployment & Implementation**

* Lead deployment planning and execution for AI products, tools, and capabilities.
* Coordinate implementation activities across business, technology, and external partners.
* Ensure deployment plans are aligned to business priorities, timelines, and operational readiness requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation activities.
* Support pilot programs, proof-of-concepts, and scaled enterprise rollouts.

**Adoption & Enablement**

* Develop strategies to drive successful adoption of AI solutions across functions and regions.
* Create adoption roadmaps and sustainment plans that encourage long-term utilization.
* Identify adoption barriers and implement actions to improve user engagement and effectiveness.
* Measure user adoption, engagement, and business outcomes associated with deployed AI solutions.
* Share best practices and success stories to accelerate enterprise-wide AI maturity.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product teams, and technology teams.
* Translate technical AI concepts into language that is understandable and actionable for business stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment among cross-functional teams throughout deployment initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor supporting business readiness and organizational adoption.

**Change Management & Communications**

* Partner with change management and communications teams to create deployment and adoption strategies.
* Design and execute communication plans to support awareness, understanding, and adoption.
* Assess organizational impacts and help stakeholders prepare for new ways of working.
* Support leaders in effectively communicating AI initiatives and benefits to their teams.

**Training & Learning**

* Identify capability and skill development needs associated with AI adoption.
* Develop and coordinate training materials, learning resources, workshops, and enablement sessions.
* Support the creation of role-based learning pathways for employees and leaders.
* Foster a culture of responsible AI usage and continuous learning.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure deployments align with McCain's AI governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Gather user feedback and deployment insights to inform future product improvements.
* Track key success metrics and provide reporting on adoption, value realization, and business impact.
* Recommend opportunities to improve deployment methodologies and enablement approaches.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS**
**AI Adoption**

* Adoption targets achieved for deployed AI solutions.
* Growth in active users and sustained utilization over time.
* Positive user experience and satisfaction scores.

**Business Value**

* Demonstrated business outcomes resulting from AI deployments.
* Improvement in productivity, efficiency, decision quality, or user experience.
* Improved realization of expected benefits from AI investments.

**Stakeholder Satisfaction**

* Positive feedback from business leaders and stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and partnership effectiveness.
* Successful management of deployment timelines and expectations.

**Delivery Excellence**

* AI deployments delivered on schedule and within agreed scope.
* Risks and issues identified and managed effectively.
* Consistent application of deployment and enablement standards.

**Job Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Information Systems, Change Management, Organizational Development, or equivalent experience.
* 5-8 years of experience in technology delivery, product deployment, digital transformation, change management, enablement, or related fields.

title: Manager – ERP Implementation/Transformation Readiness, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
  
  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

**How You Will Contribute**
We are seeking an experienced Manager – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation. The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Expertise across one or more of the following areas
  
  

* FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment
* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
* Finance Process Readiness
* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
* Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness
* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data. Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
* Functional Readiness
* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
* Data Migration Readiness
* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
* Integration & Technology Readiness
* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with: MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
* Reporting & Management Information Readiness
* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
* Controls & Compliance Readiness
* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
* Stakeholder & Program Leadership
* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
* Team Leadership
* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

**Qualifications**

* 6–11 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enablement.
* Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts, financial master data, organizational structures, reporting, controls, and data migration.
* Experience working with Finance leadership and senior business stakeholders.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and complex transformation workstreams.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

**Qualifications**
