title: Associate, Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead poisoning is one of India's most significant and most solvable public health challenges. India bears the world's highest burden of childhood lead poisoning, with over 275 million children carry blood lead levels above 5 µg/dL; the national average is 6.2 µg/dL and 23 States exceed the threshold (NITI Aayog and CSIR review, 2022). Lead exposure causes irreversible neurological damage in children, contributes to an estimated one million cardiovascular deaths annually in adults (Larsen et al., 2023), and generates compounding intergenerational risks.
  
  
National Center for Disease Control, as the designated national focal agency under MoHFW, is establishing the National Biomonitoring Programme for Chemical Toxicants (NBPCT). WJCF is embedding a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to serve as the coordination backbone for India's lead mitigation response. This embedded model builds directly on WJCF's track record of high-impact TSU engagements across TB, vector-borne diseases, oxygen, surveillance, and health insurance.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and analytically rigorous individual to serve as a core member of WJCF's embedded TSU. The incumbent will provide day-to-day technical, coordination, and secretariat support to government counterparts translating high-level intent into structured operational workplans, facilitating inter-ministerial coordination, and helping anchor governance architecture that outlasts individual donor cycles.
  
  
The role demands both policy acumen to navigate a complex multi-stakeholder environment and operational discipline to ensure consistent follow-through. The incumbent will report to the TSU Lead and will function under the programmatic guidance of NCDC for TSU activities.
  
  
**Location**
New Delhi (embedded at NCDC / MoHFW)
  
  
**Travel**
Domestic travel to programme states as required
  
  
TSU Secretariat and Programme Operations

title: Associate (Procurement) - Performance Improvement CoE
description:
**About Us**
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Performance Improvement Centre of Expertise (PI CoE). The PI CoE plays a crucial role in assisting case teams in India and abroad with various cost reduction/optimization activities by offering a range of solutions, including Procurement (e.g., Spend cube, analytics, maturity assessment, vendor strategy), Zero-based budgeting (e.g., Cost visibility, Budgeting, Initiative tracking, client training), Supply Chain (e.g., Inventory Diagnostics, Inventory Optimization, Network Optimization, Manufacturing Diagnostics, Integrated Business Planning), as well as cost diagnostics (e.g., Value Calculator, Net Working Capital), savings, and PMI Analysis. The CoE conducts complex and advanced data analysis to analyze clients' data and generate critical insights to help achieve cost objectives. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and employ powerful, dynamic visualizations/charts on various platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to showcase our results. The PI CoE is also involved in the creation of critical intellectual property (IP) that is valuable for new performance improvement cases globally at Bain.

+ Procurement function, process, sourcing and Category specific experience is a Plus.

You will also help in developing intellectual property (IP), go-to-market materials, pitch documents and publications. The position reports into a Manager.
  
  

* Own end to end case delivery of Performance Improvement projects related to Procurement / Cost Transformation. This includes the following:

+ Assist case teams across Bain’s ecosystem to analyze the problem and deploy the most appropriate tool/solution.
+ Understand client’s data using P&L, ERP Systems, budgeting systems, supplier databases and purchase order systems to design the solution.
+ Deliver procurement solutions across multiple fronts including spend analytics, savings lever design, supplier analysis, strategic sourcing, savings initiative design, among others.

* Utilize appropriate research sources and analytical tools to identify and employ relevant data-driven insights for effective decision-making.
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract information.

* Effectively communicate with BCN leadership/case teams/end clients and manage relationships.
* Demonstrate a strong ability to quickly grasp various business domains, conducting research and analysis across diverse geographies and industries with agility and efficiency.
* Engage and ideate in developing new products/IP
* Deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Lead individual project work streams with the help of 1-2 directly aligned team members (analysts)

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
**About Voy**
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India.
  
  
Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. Earlyfit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP-1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioural support into one seamless experience.
  
  
**About The Space**
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also...) means there is a unique opportunity to category- create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 brining monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.
  
  
**Strategy & Operations - Role Overview**
The S&O (Strategy & operations) role offers an opportunity to join the founding team of Voy India (formerly Earlyfit) in building 1-10. We’re scaling aggressively with the full backing of a tech, clinical and patient ops powerhouse that has 7+ years’ experience serving 2mn+ customers globally across not just weight loss but also hair loss, TRT, HRT, dermatology and more.
  
  
This role is a generalist that will be thrown at many business problems over their time here – some big, some small, some that will take a few weeks and IC laser focus and some that will take months and a team of 50. The role needs a high-ownership executor with a strategic mind and a builder mindset. Somebody not afraid to take risks, test and fail fast and then pivot quickly. We throw you at any business problem whether that’s in Acquisitions/Growth, Partnerships or Patient Experience/Retention - you take the problem head on, lead discovery, run 2-3 quick pilots, tell us what you want to bet on and then take all the resources you need to execute and scale. Hire, train, standardize/set SOPs, use product teams, and work cross functionally. And finally, work yourself out of the project so it continues to thrive and grow while you move to your next business problem.
  
  
**If this sounds like you, and you have**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles.
* Proven ability to execute and lead cross-functional initiatives and teams
* A burning desire to come to Delhi and build from scratch and get your hands dirty and point to something super impactful and say ‘Hey, I made that happen'

Then let’s chat!

title: Supplier Administrator IV
description:
Indian Ministry of Defence (IMoD) has an enduring requirement for airborne ISR platforms using MQ-9B aircraft, purchased from GA-ASI. The IMoD will rely on General Atomics Global India Pvt Ltd., (GAGIPL) to develop the infrastructure for Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) required to operate and sustain the Indian MQ-9B aircraft. To fulfill this requirement GAGIPL is hiring additional Indian-national support personnel.
  
  
Under general direction, this position is responsible for developing and managing the local supply base and supply chain infrastructure in India for GAGIPL ensuring compliance with both local Indian regulations and GA corporate policies. This individual will report to Director (India Ops) through the Head of Technical Operations.
  
  
Areas of responsibility include supplier identification, evaluation, localization, qualification, on boarding, and performance management. Contract and purchase order execution will be performed primarily by US-based counterparts. This role will collaborate closely with those teams to ensure alignment of sourcing strategies and supplier readiness. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Supply Chain & Supplier Development
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and develop potential suppliers and subcontractors in the Indian market ensuring alignment with GAGIPL and GA corporate policies
* Conduct supplier capability assessments, including quality systems, capacity, financial stability, and compliance with applicable regulations
* Support source selection decisions by providing supplier assessments, risk analyses, and total cost of ownership evaluations to US-based procurement teams
* Work with suppliers to improve performance in quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness, including development of corrective and preventive action plans
* Support localization and indigenization initiatives in line with program and regulatory requirements
* Support US-based procurement teams with local market intelligence, supplier data, and cost inputs in support of purchase order and subcontract awards
* Support the administration of subcontracts from a performance and supplier management perspective, including monitoring delivery, quality, and adherence to program requirements

Supplier Relations & Evaluation
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and qualify potential suppliers and subcontractors in the Indian market, with a focus on building a robust local supply base
* Conduct supplier assessments and maintain approved vendor lists, and drive supplier development plans to close capability gaps where needed
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers to ensure quality, adherence to delivery timelines and cost objectives
* Act as a primary local interface to suppliers for operational and performance issues, escalating commercial or contractual matters to US-based procurement teams as needed
* Negotiation & Problem Resolution
* Support price and commercial analyses and provide negotiation inputs to US-based procurement teams to help achieve optimal value
* Participate in discussions with suppliers to clarify technical and commercial requirements, and support negotiation of standard and non-standard subcontract provisions
* Identify supply chain and supplier performance issues and works collaboratively to develop practical solutions
* Lead local resolution of supplier performance issues and disputes in coordination with US-based procurement and program management as appropriate.

Compliance & Documentation
  
  

* Ensure all supply chain development and supplier management activities comply with Indian legal and regulatory requirements, including GST, customs regulations, and import/export controls
* Comply with Foreign Exchange Maintenance Act (FEMA) obligations in consultation with GAGIPL consultant company
* Support the review of non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), teaming agreements, and other documents from a business and risk perspective, while formal legal and contractual approval is obtained through GA’s US-based legal and contracts teams
* Screen suppliers and subcontractors for export control compliance and entity eligibility against denied parties lists (Indian and U.S.)
* Stay current on regulatory changes affecting supply chain, procurement, and subcontracting activities
* Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
* Serve as the primary local supply chain contact for assigned suppliers and subcontracts
* Advise internal stakeholders on supplier capabilities, supply chain risks, and mitigation strategies
* Prepare reports and presentations on supply chain development activities, cost savings, localization/indigenization progress, and supplier performance
* Coordinate with GA’s US-based procurement and supply chain teams to ensure alignment and knowledge sharing

Process Improvement & Training
  
  

* Contribute to the development and improvement of supply chain and supplier management processes and procedures

title: Senior Learning and Development Specialist
description:

Senior Learning & Development Specialist
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon (supporting L.E.K.'s Australia practice)

HR Manager, Australia
  
  
**Working model:**
Hybrid
  
  
**Company Profile**
L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.
  
  
How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Senior Learning and Development Specialist will support talent operations in addition to the design, coordination and delivery of professional development programs and learning initiatives for L.E.K.'s Australia practice, based in our Gurgaon office.
  
  
This role combines learning strategy and content design, program facilitation support, and operational coordination, working closely with the HR Manager, Australia leadership, global counterparts and external partners to deliver high-quality training and development across the practice.
  
  
The role requires an experienced Learning & Development practitioner who can work independently across time zones, manage multiple priorities, and operate confidently in a fast-paced professional services environment. The role also requires working experience in people operations and HR business Partnering support.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**
**Australia Learning & Development**
Learning Strategy & Program Design
  
  

* Contribute to the design and support implementation of the Australia multi-year learning strategy
* Re-design course content in conjunction with subject matter experts across the business
* Conduct training needs analysis during half-yearly performance reviews, identifying development gaps
* Coordinate the monthly Australia learning curriculum
* Support facilitation of learning programs across the Australia practice
* Develop on-demand content for orientation and key learning modules
* Continuously improve the Australia approach to learning and participant experience

Annual Professional Development (PD)
  
  

* Coordinate and manage the Australia Annual PD calendar and training roadmap
* Support planning and execution of Manager PD programs
* Coordinate Core Services Annual PD programs across offices
* Track Australia PD program participation, attendance and feedback
* Support promotion and visibility of quarterly training initiatives and learning campaigns

PD Administration & Logistics
  
  

* Manage monthly Consulting PD operations and logistics
* Coordinate training schedules, invitations and calendar management
* Track monthly training attendance and reporting
* Manage training feedback processes including communications, tracking and reminders

Training Coordination & Content Management
  
  

* Prepare training invitations, communication materials and flyers
* Partner with trainers and facilitators to update learning materials and presentation decks
* Maintain and update decks on the Global PD repository
* Attend Global PD community of practice calls and support follow-up actions where required
* Ensure learning materials and communications are accurate, updated and aligned globally

**Australia People & Talent Operations**
Performance Review Cycles
  
  

* Coordinate the end-to-end half-yearly performance review process requirements for the Australia practice
* Support calibration sessions and consolidate review outcomes for leadership
* Track completion rates and follow up with managers and employees on outstanding reviews
* Maintain performance review documentation and ensure data accuracy in HR systems
* Partner with the Learning and Inclusion Manager to translate review outcomes into development priorities

Talent Projects & Operations
  
  

* Support execution of Australia talent projects, including recruitment funnel tracking and reporting
* Support delivery of promotion and career progression processes

**Other Strategic Projects**

* Drive key strategic initiatives in support of the Australia practice's growth strategy
* Coordinate and support execution of regional PD projects and new learning program launches
* Contribute to continuous improvement of learning processes and participant experience
* Support the broader Talent team on other initiatives and business-as-usual activity

* Liaise with internal stakeholders including HRBPs, consulting leadership and program facilitators
* Support smooth delivery of learning sessions across multiple offices and time zones
* Build strong working relationships across the Australia leadership team

* Strong facilitation and content design skills, with the ability to lead learning sessions independently
* Excellent organisational and co-ordination skills with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across regions
* Proactive, collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced consulting environment
* Strong operational discipline and execution capability
* Genuine interest in learning and development, and people strategy
* Experience supporting performance review cycles, talent operations or broader people operations processes

* Prior experience designing and delivering learning programs, training operations or employee engagement initiatives

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook
* Experience managing training logistics, communications and stakeholder coordination
* Familiarity with learning platforms, survey tools or HR systems is an advantage
* Experience working across regional or multicultural teams, ideally supporting Australia or APAC, preferred

**Benefits And Perks Offered**

title: Analyst, TSG Product Management
description:
**Company Profile**
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
**What Makes Us Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**
**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required
* Independently makes complex manual updates based on incoming requests, applying sound judgment to optimize the product
* Runs periodic user surveys and forums to track satisfaction and identify areas for improvement
* Tracks and analyzes key metrics — including dashboards, usage, and adoption — summarizing insights and findings for stakeholders
* Tests routine updates and enhancements to validate functionality and ensure a user-friendly experience

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

* Elicits requirements on small-to-medium sized requests, working with users to translate use cases and pain points into underlying requirements and potential solutions
* Transforms these requests into actionable work via user stories, process flow diagrams, and other supporting documentation
* Works with appropriate technical teams and third parties to complete these items, prioritizing and communicating dependencies and tradeoffs with key stakeholders throughout

**Develop Domain Knowledge (10%)**

* Builds domain knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of relevant tools and platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Databricks or similar enterprise data platforms) to act more independently
* Stays up to date about emerging analytics technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve ways of working

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking
* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

**Experience**

* Experience supporting technology products, analytics platforms, or business systems, ideally in a product management, product operations, business analyst, or similar role. Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise data platforms is preferred
* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs
* Experience working in a corporate environment
* Experience solving basic issues in software tools and turning findings into actionable next steps
* Experience supporting users or customers with clear and helpful communication.
* Experience with support platforms like ServiceNow is preferred

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: Sr Business Process Project Management Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
The Mobile Surgical Skill Lab (MMSSL) is a national surgical education and training initiative designed to expand access to hands-on learning experiences for surgeons across India. The program delivers practical training on minimally invasive surgery technologies through a fully equipped mobile platform featuring laparoscopic training systems, electrosurgical technologies, surgical stapling solutions, and robotic-assisted surgery simulation capabilities.
  
  
This role is part of the Training & Education function and serves as the single point of ownership for national program planning, operational execution, stakeholder engagement, compliance oversight, and performance management of the Mobile Surgical Skill Lab.
  
  
The position is based in Gurgaon, India and follows a Flex work arrangement, combining office-based responsibilities with extensive field engagement. Travel of approximately 60-70% across India is required to support program deployment, stakeholder meetings, and training activities.
  
  
The Sr Business Process Project Specialist, Mobile Surgical Skill Lab, is responsible for leading the planning, deployment, and performance of a national mobile surgical training platform. The role partners with clinical, commercial, and external stakeholders to deliver surgical education programs, ensure operational excellence, maintain compliance requirements, and expand program reach across hospitals, medical colleges, and training institutions.
  
  
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly deployment plans for the Mobile Surgical Skill Lab across India.
* Identify and prioritize hospitals, medical colleges, residency programs, and training centers for program delivery.
* Lead scheduling, routing, logistics coordination, permits, site approvals, and operational readiness of the mobile training platform.
* Manage vendor partners supporting transportation, maintenance, logistics, fabrication, and field operations.
* Partner with key opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, and internal stakeholders to develop and deliver structured surgical training programs.
* Ensure equipment readiness, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting coordination, and adherence to safety standards during training activities.
* Monitor program performance through defined metrics, participant feedback, utilization data, and leadership dashboards.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and documentation standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.
* 214.2(h)( 4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience
* Experience in surgical education, clinical training, healthcare program management, or field-based operations.
* Experience managing multi-site programs, training initiatives, or large-scale field operations.
* Experience engaging surgeons, hospital administrators, medical colleges, and healthcare institutions.
* Experience in vendor management, budget tracking, and operational reporting.
* Ability to travel 60-70% across India, including occasional weekend program support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA in Healthcare Management or Business Administration.
* Experience supporting minimally invasive surgery, electrosurgical, surgical stapling, or robotic-assisted surgery platforms.
* Experience managing mobile training units, field activation programs, or healthcare outreach initiatives.
* Knowledge of medical device regulations, healthcare compliance requirements, and clinical education practices in India.
* Experience developing dashboards and program performance metrics.

title: Program Management Senior Specialist - Growth Lab - Email
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
Program Management Senior Specialist is the glue that keeps all the elements of an owned marketing channel campaign (i.e. email) project together. They are well organized project managers, excellent communicators, proactive problem solvers and technical subject matter experts well versed in growth marketing. They are the connective tissue between the business (product marketing managers), production project managers and development team. They ensure projects are well defined, and delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Partner with product marketing managers (PMMs) in campaign ideation and intake document formulation

+ Collaborate with PMMs during the campaign ideation stage, gather technical requirements, confirm feasibility of ideated campaign features, define potential execution timeline and the intricacies of email personalization and complex logic.
+ Provide strategic input on growth best practices, segmentation, and user journey optimization to help achieve campaign business goals.
+ Act as a consultative partner, advising PMMs on how to translate business objectives into effective owned channel (i.e. email) strategies.
+ Guide the PMM through the Campaign Requirement Document creation, ensure the intake documents are completed and comprehensive for the production team.

* Project manage campaign development and deployment

+ Kick off and strategically manage campaign development with offshore production team, provide guidance and answers to production team during the production process, manage production timelines.
+ Prepare work orders for the production team and create project estimations for the PMM, managing the approval process for these estimates.
+ Coordinate with Data Specialists to ensure that data requirements and inputs are fully aligned with HTML development and production process, as well as be a strategic partner between Data Specialists and offshore production team.
+ Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) reviews on all deliverables against client specifications before releasing to the PMM
+ Communicate production progress to PMM, facilitate approval of simulations, proofs and prototypes, ensure any changes are implemented after prototype and proof review.
+ Flag issues that arise during the production process and proactively seek solutions.

* Manage campaign deployment in Internal Growth tools, monitor campaign health

+ Actively manage the Internal growth tool (i.e..Gamma) campaign deployments and proactively manage the campaign lifecycle (pause, activate, launch Gamma campaigns). GAMMA is Google’s internal email marketing platform.
+ Be the expert on Gamma campaigns under their management.
+ Monitor campaign deployment health through Gamma reporting tools and internal tools. Where applicable, delegate monitoring to Data Specialists and email specialists acting as the accountable party for campaign health monitoring and error escalation.
+ Conduct post-launch campaign performance analysis to derive engagement insights and identify areas for future improvement.

* Troubleshoot and solve escalations

+ When issues arise on existing or newly deployed campaigns, proactively lead the resolution process by quickly identifying root causes, work closely with product marketing managers, production project managers, and the development team.
+ Document the issue in the form of a blameless post mortem, ensure alignment across stakeholders and facilitate process adjustments mitigating repetition of the issue in the future across the team.

* Keep things organized

+ Attend regular scrums and stand ups, provide updates on project status and act as a collaborative business partner to the PMM leading the scrum.
+ Effectively and proficiently communicate with the offshore production team by setting up and leading weekly calls. Maintain internal project status trackers and post launch quality control sheets.
+ Ensure accurate work progress tracking in Asana.

* Drive innovation and thrive for excellence
* Proactively look for ways to improve the process to drive efficiency and reduce risk such as through implementing AI tools in the email creative or production processes.

**Qualifications**
****Minimum Qualifications:****

* Overall 5+ years of experience in project management roles, coordinating projects across multiple organizations/cross functional teams.
* Complex Email Campaign Management: 2-3 years of proven ability to manage high-complexity, interdependent email campaigns, anticipating risks across multiple systems and stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment.
* Email Marketing Technology Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in primary email marketing technology tools (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua, Hubspot etc.) with the ability to learn and navigate independently across multiple platforms.
* Technical Proficiency (HTML): Basic understanding of web development, HTML/CSS & QA processes, with the ability to identify root causes, troubleshoot technical issues, and architect resilient solutions."
* Strategic Client Handling: Advanced client handling skills with a track record of acting as a strategic advisor, understanding scope and providing estimates that align with long-term business goals.
* Data Analysis: Proficiency in data analysis tools to interpret performance results and recommend strategic improvements to stakeholders.
* Communication: Strong, polished, and professional communication skills required for interacting with stakeholders and leading the production team.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Understanding of marketing operations, processes, business requirements.
* Proactive and curious attitude, strong problem solving skills.
* Familiarity using GenAI (generative AI) for email marketing content, production and optimization.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with rapidly changing priorities and a high volume of projects.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums

title: Senior Manager - Transformation Management Office
description:
Senior Manager- Transformation Management Office (TMO)
  
  
**About The Role**
The Transformation Management Office (TMO) is a dedicated enterprise transformation function within IndiGo's Strategy Office, responsible for driving and coordinating the organization's strategic transformation agenda.
  
  
The TMO serves as the central catalyst for execution, governance across cross-functional initiatives that are critical to IndiGo's long-term growth, operational resilience, and strategic priorities. The team works closely with senior leadership, functional heads, and initiative owners across the organization to accelerate delivery, resolve interdependencies, drive accountability, and ensure sustainable adoption of change.
  
  
This role offers significant exposure to leadership and opportunity to contribute to some of the most critical transformation programs across the airline.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise Transformation & Program Delivery
* Support the execution and delivery of strategic, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across multiple business functions
* Act as a thought partner to initiative owners by applying structured problem-solving and an outside-in perspective to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and strengthen project outcomes
* Track progress against plans, proactively identifying risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and resource constraints that may impact delivery
* Assess continuity post-implementation and monitor realization of planned benefits and business outcomes
* Governance & Performance Management
* Maintain a single source of truth for transformation initiatives through structured governance, reporting, and portfolio tracking
* Develop and manage dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and executive reporting mechanisms to monitor program performance
* Run periodic transformation review cadence with initiative owners and ensure timely escalation of risks and decisions
* Support governance forums including Transformation Steering Committee reviews, Executive Committee updates, and Board-level reporting
* Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
* Coordinate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Network Planning, Engineering, Commercial, Digital, Finance, HR, Customer Experience, Safety, and other business functions
* Facilitate workshops, reviews, decision forums, and governance meetings to drive alignment and execution
* Manage interdependencies across initiatives and support resolution of competing priorities and execution challenges
* Executive Reviews & Change Management
* Support preparation of leadership presentations, strategic reviews, and decision-making materials for senior executives
* Synthesize complex cross-functional inputs into concise, executive-ready recommendations and reporting
* Support change-management, communication, and stakeholder engagement activities necessary for successful transformation adoption
* Drive a culture of execution excellence, transparency, and continuous improvement across the transformation portfolio

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Aviation, Business, or a related discipline; MBA preferred
* 8-10 years of relevant professional experience
* Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, program management, or PMO/TMO environments preferred
* Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions
* Exposure to aviation or other complex, operations-intensive industries is advantageous
* Experience working with senior leadership in fast-paced, high-visibility environments

Functional Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability
* Strong business acumen with understanding of operational and commercial interdependencies
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Executive communication and presentation skills
* Governance, reporting, risk management, and project tracking expertise
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments while maintaining attention to detail and accountability

Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience with project management, reporting, and portfolio-tracking tools
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, MS Project, Power BI, or equivalent platforms is an advantage

Reporting Structure
  
  
The role will be part of the Transformation Management Office and report directly to the Head of TMO, who in turn reports to the Chief Strategy Officer. The position will work closely with initiative owners, functional leaders, and senior management across the organization, providing significant exposure to executive leadership and enterprise-wide strategic priorities
  
  
At IndiGo, we believe in the innate strength of an energetic, diverse, and inclusive workforce, where the viewpoints and life experiences of our employees help us foster strong connections with all our customers. Our diversity equity and inclusion efforts are designed to attract, nurture, and advance the lives of our employees and customers irrespective of their – but not limited to - gender, race, color, religion, caste, creed, ethnicity, origin, language, social and economic status, sexual orientation, differently-abled status, marital status, nationality, age, family status, and maternity status.

description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. **The Team**
We are looking for a seasoned consulting professional with experience in process transformation, operational excellence, and business change within the Financial Services sector. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record in leading complex transformation engagements, designing and implementing future-state operating models, and driving measurable impact through process re-engineering, digitization, and automation initiatives.
  
  
This role demands a blend of strategic problem-solving and operational rigor — someone who can partner with senior client stakeholders, translate business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, and lead high-performing consulting teams to deliver sustainable results.
  
  
Given our growth ambitions, we seek an individual who is entrepreneurial, outcome-oriented, hands-on, and comfortable operating with ambiguity while driving multiple priorities independently.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Lead Transformation Engagements: Lead and deliver end-to-end process and operations transformation programs across key areas such as retail banking, corporate banking, insurance, asset managers, payments.
* Drive initiatives in cost optimization, productivity improvement, process (re)design, operating model redesign, and digital enablement for financial services clients.
* Solution Design & Delivery: Develop holistic transformation solutions integrating process re-engineering, automation (RPA/AI), analytics, and technology enablement to address client pain points.
* Define target operating models, process KPIs, and performance dashboards to ensure measurable outcomes and long-term sustainability.
* Client Engagement & Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships with onshore teams, C-suite and senior stakeholders
* Advise clients on strategic transformation priorities, operating model evolution, and implementation roadmaps aligned to their business objectives.
* Program & Change Management: Oversee multi-stream transformation programs ensuring delivery excellence, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Drive change management initiatives to support adoption of new processes, systems, and behaviors.
* Practice Development & Thought Leadership: Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services consulting practice through solution development, go-to-market support, and client proposals.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building: Lead, coach, and mentor teams of consultants, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and performance excellence.
* Develop internal capabilities in process transformation frameworks, design thinking, and operational analytics.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 12–14 years of relevant experience in process transformation, operations consulting, or business change, preferably within top-tier consulting firms (including any with large financial institutions).

* Transformation Delivery: Proven experience leading transformation programs encompassing process re-design, automation, target operating models, and performance improvement.
* Client Leadership: Demonstrated ability to engage onshore teams and senior stakeholders, build trusted advisory relationships.
* Project & People Management: Track record of managing large, cross-functional teams and delivering projects on time, within scope, and to high quality standards.
* Communication: Excellent presentation, facilitation, and written communication skills.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Snr NSI Manager
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior NSI Manager, you will drive international network migration projects that enhance scalability, optimize network performance, and deliver high operational standards with adept project management and cultural insight.
  
  

* Lead and manage the implementation and deployment of network migration projects to enhance optimization and scalability within the global enterprise network.
* Oversee multiple operations within the portfolio to ensure deployments are completed on time and meet quality standards.
* Perform technical and economic analyses to identify optimal solutions while ensuring compliance with engineering, business, environmental, and safety standards.
* Validate and verify documentation and compliance of studies conducted by external service providers.
* Coordinate stakeholder agreements and manage ordering processes to promote smooth operations.
* Conduct site visits and autonomously manage complex network operations, providing clear and detailed reporting.
* Implement cross-business and operational improvement plans to enhance deployment strategies continuously.
* Deploy network hardware such as routers, switches, and firewalls efficiently during greenfield and brownfield migration projects, ensuring operational readiness.
* Configure and test network equipment in staging environments prior to field shipment to ensure optimal performance and minimize deployment issues.
* Develop and implement comprehensive Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for high-risk network changes to minimize downtime and maintain service continuity.
* Supervise physical layer tasks including cable patching and labeling to uphold data center standards and facilitate maintenance.
* Conduct thorough post-deployment validation to verify adherence to design specifications and operational effectiveness.
* Produce detailed As-Built documentation and updated network diagrams to support seamless transition to network operations teams.

**About You**
You demonstrate hands-on proficiency with Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista platforms, ensuring comprehensive hardware deployment. Your strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs supports robust network configuration and operation. Skilled in scripting languages like Python and Bash along with automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform, you enable scalable deployment processes. Your experience with hybrid cloud connectivity involving AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute is strong. You also maintain detail-oriented execution of technical procedures to ensure reliability. With over 8-10 years in network engineering and deployment-focused roles, along with CCNA or CompTIA Network+ certification (CCNP or JNCIP preferred), your methodical approach and communication skills enable alignment across stakeholders during complex network migrations.

* Demonstrates proficient hands-on expertise with network hardware platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, and Arista to facilitate comprehensive deployments.
* Possesses a thorough understanding of network protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and VLANs, enabling stable network configuration and operation.
* Utilizes scripting languages like Python and Bash alongside automation tools such as Ansible and Terraform to promote scalable, efficient deployment processes.
* Applies practical know-how in establishing hybrid cloud interconnections like AWS Direct Connect and Azure ExpressRoute to improve network connectivity.
* Maintains strong attention to detail, rigorously performing technical procedures to minimize errors and ensure process reliability.

**Your soft skills:**

* Exhibits adaptability and resilience, maintaining composure while addressing unforeseen challenges during network deployment activities.
* Communicates complex technical information clearly to align all stakeholders during maintenance and migration phases.
* Employs excellent time management skills to ensure network deployment projects meet established schedules and deadlines.
* Approaches problem resolution through logical analysis and systematic isolation of faults, avoiding assumptions.
* Supports clients thoughtfully throughout network transitions, fostering trust and confidence during change processes.

Join Orange to bring your expertise to large-scale network projects in a collaborative environment that values precision, cultural awareness, and continuous improvement. As a Senior NSI Manager, you will shape the future of global network deployment by leading efficient initiatives that enhance connectivity and operational excellence.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Program Manager (Faridabad)

**Organisation:**
Nimaya Foundation ( https://www.nimaya.in/ )

**Location:**
Faridabad

**Work Mode:**
Remote with occasional field visits,

**Full-time Pay:**
₹40,000 per month

**What’s exciting about this role?**

You’ll enable building India’s most future-facing development sector organisation; one that arms young women from underprivileged backgrounds with the tools, skills, and confidence to thrive in the AI-driven world of work.

Imagine helping a farmer’s daughter launch her own YouTube channel, or upskilling her to land a job in a futuristic start-up. That’s what Nimaya does.

**About Nimaya Foundation**

Co-founded in 2021 by social entrepreneurs - Navya Naveli Nanda and Samyak Chakrabarty, Nimaya is a not-for-profit career accelerator for women with big dreams.

**Our Guiding Question:**

Why can’t a rickshaw driver's daughter land a job at Google? Unlike traditional skill-building NGOs, Nimaya is laser-focused on preparing women for the AI-powered digital economy; not just with skills, but with aspiration and identity. To date, Nimaya has empowered 3,900+ Nimaya Naaris across Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Haryana through partnerships with UN Women, Mumbai Police, SEWA, FICCI-FLO, and more.

**Our Flagship Programs**

● GenAI Ready Naari: Teaching GenAI tools to graduates from underserved communities

● #CreatorNaari: Enabling women to build financial independence as content creators.

● Project Nimaya: Delivering digital and workplace training to daughters of farmers in rural Haryana.

**What We’re Looking For:**
Program Manager for ‘Project Nimaya’ (Faridabad)

**Mindset**

● Sees CSR not as charity, but as a nation-building investment.

● Obsessed with detail but driven by the big picture.

●
**Proactive Attitude:**
Willingness to take initiative and demonstrate adaptability.

●
**Passion for Empowerment:**
A strong desire to support and enable the success of young women from restrictive circumstances.

**Background**

● Minimum 2-5 years of experience in the education sector, NGO, service industry, client servicing, CSR program management, operations, or field partnerships.

● Passion for learning and helping others succeed, with strong interest and experience in operations.

● Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.

● Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to work collaboratively with learners, team members, and stakeholders.

● Highly organized with strong attention to detail; able to multitask, prioritize, and manage multiple learner cohorts in a fast-paced environment.

● Problem-solving mindset with the ability to make quick, independent decisions and proactively manage tasks.

● Flexible and adaptable to changing program needs; open to occasional travel.

● Proficient with Google Suite and other digital tools; experience with Canva is a plus.

**● Based in Faridabad, with willingness to travel to field locations.**

**Your Core Responsibilities**

●
**Cohort Building & Management:**
Design, build, and manage cohorts of ambitious young women from restrictive backgrounds to join training programs. Ensure their sustained engagement, progress, and success through proactive support and mentorship.

●
**Partnership Development:**
Build and manage strategic partnerships with NGOs, community organizations, and colleges. Lead partnership meetings with decision-makers to secure collaborations for Project Nimaya.

●
**Program Delivery Oversight:**
Build strong relationships with trainers, oversee high-quality program delivery, and ensure training content and facilitation meet learner needs and program goals.

●
**Learner Engagement & Support:**
Develop and implement learner engagement strategies, including direct communication (calls, meetings) to maintain active participation, monitor attendance, and address challenges promptly.

●
**Stakeholder & Founder Collaboration:**
Work closely with the founders for stakeholder engagement, donor relations, and strategic program discussions.

●
**Event & Activity Leadership:**
Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of learner events, workshops, and community activities to enhance learning and networking opportunities.

●
**Program Evaluation & Improvement:**
Continuously assess program effectiveness through learner feedback, testimonial collection, data tracking, and progress monitoring. Recommend and implement improvements to enhance impact.

●
**Data & Reporting:**
Maintain accurate program databases, track learner performance metrics, and prepare reports for internal review and external stakeholders.

●
**Administrative & Operational Leadership:**
Manage daily program operations, oversee administrative processes, and coordinate with the team to ensure smooth execution of all program elements.

●
**Problem-Solving & Decision-Making:**
Take ownership of resolving operational and learner-related challenges quickly and effectively, ensuring minimal disruption to program delivery. How to Apply If you're a self-motivated individual eager to contribute to a meaningful cause, we encourage you to apply.

Please send your CV to contact@nimaya.in. Join us at Nimaya and be part of a movement that's breaking barriers and building futures for young women with big dreams.

title: Project Manager – Early Childhood Education
description:
**About The Job Project Manager - Early Childhood Education**
**Job Title:**
Project Manager
  
  
**Team:**
Early Childhood Education (ECE)
  
  
**Reports to :**
Project Lead, ECE
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi (with ~30–40% travel to states)
  
  
**Experience Range:**
2–4 years
  
  
**About Central Square Foundation**
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working on the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We are driven by our mission to transform the school education system with a focus on improving children's learning outcomes, especially in low-income communities.
  
  
Learn more at the website.
  
  
**About The Position**
Early Childhood Education (ECE) refers to the pre-primary years, between the ages of 3 and 6, before a child enters Grade 1. Research across economics, neuroscience and education has shown that 90% of brain development happens before the age of 5, and that the quality of these years shapes a child’s schooling, health and income for life. The National Education Policy 2020 calls for three years of pre-primary education for every child.
  
  
CSF partners with state governments and academic bodies to support the institutionalisation of developmentally appropriate pre-primary education within government school systems through curriculum, teacher preparation, classroom resources and implementation support.
  
  
We work at scale in states including Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, and Telangana, and our work aims to create evidence and implementation playbooks to make quality pre-primary a regular part of the school system everywhere.
  
  
The Project Manager supports the Project Lead across the ECE workstream and owns defined pieces of work within it. The role offers early exposure to the full spectrum of the work, from policy-level engagement to what actually happens in classrooms, and involves working with state teams, partner organisations, government counterparts, and CSF’s research and fundraising teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Review on-ground implementation: Spend regular time in schools, teacher trainings, district meeting and reviews to assess how pre-primary classes are being set up and run against the programme design. Document what is working, what is not, and why.
* Create and improve the playbooks: Turn field learning into playbooks, setup guidelines and resource packages that a state can adopt, and keep them current as states adapt them.
* Run diagnostics and handhold states: Design and run diagnostic tools for states setting up pre-primary classes, and provide hands-on support to state teams and officials through rollout.
* Build the evidence base: Maintain structured field notes, case studies and implementation data that feed the research team, policy notes and funder proposals, and support pilots and studies on the ground.
* Coordinate partners and state teams: Run the day-to-day working rhythm with partner organisations and CSF’s state teams, including joint workplans, reviews and follow-through.
* Manage delivery: Own workplans and trackers for central ECE workstreams, manage consultants and vendors, and flag risks to ensure high quality delivery

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities**

* Relevant Experience (2–4 years) - Two to four years of strong performance in public policy, consulting, education or development, including through a structured fellowship. A Master’s in Education, Public Policy, Social Sciences or Management preferred.
* Synthesis and Communication - The ability to turn research, field observation and stakeholder input into clear, well-structured written drafts and presentations
* Fluency in English and Hindi - Both spoken and written, at a standard that supports drafting for government audiences and working with state teams.
* Exposure to Government - Some experience of working with government officials or department processes, through a fellowship, a PMU or a government-facing role will be an advantage
* Execution Discipline - A record of running workplans, tracking several pieces of work at once and coordinating people without losing detail.
* A Hands-On Temperament - Suited to a small organisation with shifting priorities and frequent travel, and comfortable operating without a settled plan.

Candidates with prior experience of teaching young children are encouraged to apply.
