title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**About Globeia**

Globeia is a bootstrapped global identity verification and document services company, serving clients across multiple countries. We are building a technology platform that turns a manual, paperwork-heavy industry into a software-driven experience. Our Gurugram office is the global hub where tech, design, QA and operations sit together.

**About the Role**

Our CEO is based in Washington DC. Our build team is in Gurugram. We need one person on the ground in Gurugram who owns delivery: someone who knows what every team is working on, what is due when, what is slipping, and why.

This is a program management role, not a product management role. You will not decide what we build. You will make sure that what we have committed to build ships on time, and that tech, design, QA and operations are working in step rather than waiting on each other.

**What You Will Do**

* Own delivery timelines across tech, design, QA and operations, with the product roadmap as your first priority.
* Turn the roadmap into clear plans with milestones, owners and dates, and keep those plans current.
* Run the delivery rhythm: sprint planning, standups, reviews and cross-team check-ins.
* Spot dependencies and blockers early, and resolve them before they cost us a deadline.
* Pressure-test estimates from engineering and design so the dates we commit to are realistic.
* Give the CEO a clear, honest weekly picture of what shipped, what is at risk and what needs a decision.
* Act as the bridge between the CEO and the Gurugram teams, so priorities are understood and nothing is lost across time zones.
* Build the tracking systems, dashboards and processes that keep the office running efficiently as we grow.
* Hold teams accountable to their commitments, and raise problems early rather than late.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 8 years of experience, with at least 2 years in technical program management, engineering project management or delivery management at a software company.
* A technical background: a degree in engineering or computer science, or earlier hands-on experience as a developer or QA engineer. You don't need to write code, but you do need to understand how software gets built.
* A track record of shipping products on schedule across engineering, design and QA.
* Strong working knowledge of agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Linear or ClickUp.
* Clear, direct written and verbal communication. You can summarize a messy situation in five lines.
* Comfort holding senior people accountable, including people who do not report to you.
* Experience working with a remote founder or leadership team across time zones is a strong plus.
* Startup experience is preferred. We are bootstrapped, we move fast, and there is no layer of management to hide behind.

**Why Join Us**

* You report directly to the founder and CEO.
* You are the person responsible for delivery in our largest office, with real authority to match.
* You will help build a product from scratch.
* There is room to grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales.

**Location and Hours**

This is a full time, on-site role in Gurugram. Some overlap with US Eastern time is expected for regular syncs with the CEO.

title: SPL – EdTech and AI (OBF)
description:
**About The Job SPL EdTech And AI (OBF)**
**Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI (OBF)**
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised five critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN); EdTech and AI; Early Childhood Education (ECE); Schools Governance; and High Potential Students (HPS).
  
  
Read more about our work at the CSF website: https://www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About EdTech And AI At CSF**
CSF's EdTech and AI initiative focuses on leveraging technology to enhance teaching and learning, both in classrooms and at home, through student-focused and teacher-directed interventions. Our goal is to improve foundational learning in primary grades and provide remediation support in middle school using evidence-based, scalable technology solutions.
  
  

* Since 2012, CSF has played a pivotal role in shaping India's EdTech ecosystem by bridging demand and supply, backed by rigorous research. We drive impact by:
* Supporting EdTech organisations to build contextually relevant, pedagogically sound products for low-income learners.
* Generating evidence on what works, how it works, and how to scale effective EdTech interventions.
* Partnering with governments to adopt and effectively implement evidence-backed EdTech solutions, strengthen the utilisation of public investments in technology, and influence policy and system priorities.
* Creating public goods to drive innovation and strengthen the broader ecosystem.
* In the last five years, CSF has collaborated with 15+ EdTech organisations, 11+ state governments, and leading academic institutions, reaching over 10 million learners across India.

**About The Project**
A proposed outcomes-based financing (OBF) platform is being developed by Central Square Foundation in partnership with a selected program partner, to improve foundational literacy and numeracy outcomes in government schools. The initiative aims to build a robust, evidence-based case for personalised adaptive learning (PAL) in Grades 1–5, while creating the delivery, financing and procurement pathways required for state governments to adopt and fund effective solutions over time.
  
  
The programme is currently in its design and preparation phase. This includes defining the outcomes and payment framework, selecting states and solution providers, designing implementation and governance structures, establishing independent verification arrangements, securing implementation funding, and engaging governments early so that evidence generated through the programme can translate into long-term public-system adoption.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Project Lead – EdTech and AI (OBF) will lead CSF's programme design and government adoption work for the project. This is a build-stage role suited to someone who can create structure in ambiguity, bring together diverse stakeholders, and design a programme that is rigorous enough for outcomes-based financing while remaining feasible and relevant for government systems.
  
  
The role will work closely with state governments, EdTech solution providers, funders, program partners, independent evaluators and internal CSF teams. A core mandate will be to ensure that government adoption is not treated as an end-stage activity: the Senior Project Lead will shape the programme from the outset around government priorities, implementation realities, evidence needs and eventual pathways for public financing and procurement.
  
  
The Senior Project Lead will report to the Associate Director/Senior Project Director – EdTech and AI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Programme Strategy, Design & Build
* Lead the end-to-end design of the OBF project from CSF's programme and government-adoption perspective, translating the concept into a clear operating model, implementation architecture, workplan and measurable outcomes.
* Define key design choices across target grades and geographies, student reach, school-level implementation, technology and infrastructure requirements, provider roles, sequencing and scale-up pathways.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify critical assumptions, risks and trade-offs, and translate them into testable design decisions and mitigation plans.
* Ensure the programme design balances learning impact, implementation feasibility, provider incentives, evidence requirements, cost-effectiveness and relevance to government systems.
* Outcomes-Based Financing & Performance Framework
* Work closely with a selected program partner, funders, providers and evaluators to shape an outcomes-based financing model that is credible, implementable and aligned to the programme's learning objectives.
* Contribute to the definition of outcome metrics and payment milestones across onboarding/readiness, product usage and learning gains, including thresholds, verification approaches and implications for provider incentives.
* Support the development of templates and approaches that can inform future outcomes-linked government procurement for PAL.
* Government Engagement, Salience & Adoption Pathway
* Lead early government engagement so that programme design reflects state priorities, FLN strategies, infrastructure constraints, implementation capacity and decision-making processes.
* Develop a deliberate government salience strategy: identify the evidence, experiences, champions, review forums and decision points required for PAL to become a credible part of the state's FLN agenda in the long term.
* Create a pathway from philanthropic financing to sustained government ownership, including potential budget heads, procurement models, institutional roles and transition milestones.
* Develop government-facing narratives and outputs such as concept notes, briefs, implementation frameworks, review materials and procurement-oriented documentation.
* Multi-Stakeholder Partnership & Programme Governance
* Serve as a key integrator across state governments, solution providers, selected program partner funders, independent evaluators and CSF teams, ensuring clarity of roles, dependencies and decision rights.
* Lead programme governance processes including workplans, design reviews, decision logs, risk registers, partner reviews and senior stakeholder updates.
* Anticipate and resolve cross-stakeholder bottlenecks while protecting the integrity of the programme's learning and adoption objectives.
* Implementation Readiness, Evidence & Learning
* Co-develop the learning agenda and define the conditions for PAL to deliver outcomes at scale in government primary schools, including implementation fidelity, cost, provider performance and system integration
* Work with Evidence/M&E teams and independent evaluators to ensure that the evaluation and verification framework answers both payment-related questions and the broader questions governments will need answered before adoption.
* Use implementation data and field insights to diagnose bottlenecks, drive course correction and strengthen the programme model over time.
* Knowledge, Scale Strategy & Institutionalisation
* Translate programme evidence and implementation learning into a compelling case for state adoption of PAL in primary grades.
* Develop practical public goods such as implementation playbooks, adoption frameworks, procurement templates, cost models, case studies and policy notes that can support replication beyond participating states.
* Contribute to CSF's broader thought leadership on evidence-backed EdTech, outcomes-based financing and sustainable public financing for technology-enabled learning.
* Team, Budget & Organisational Leadership
* Lead, coach and performance-manage a high-performing team while building ownership and execution capability.
* Own CSF-side programme planning, budgeting, resourcing, reporting and leadership decision materials for the OBF project.
* Coordinate closely with CSF's EdTech and AI, Evidence, State Reform, Finance, Legal, Communications and other relevant teams.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant work with Indian state and/or central government systems. Preference will be given to applicants from Education, EdTech, or adjacent sectors.
* Exposure to outcomes-based financing, results-based financing, impact bonds, performance-linked contracts or innovative procurement models
* Track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder programmes from design through implementation and institutionalisation.
* Experience managing portfolios, budgets, teams and external partners with strong execution discipline.
* Master's degree in business, public policy, education, engineering, development studies or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability and track record in building senior government relationships and translating evidence and programme insights into policy, strategy and system-level outcomes.

**Desired Qualities**

* Strong commitment to improving learning outcomes and equity through public education systems.
* Systems thinker who connects policy, programmes, implementation, evidence and government incentives while remaining execution-focused.
* Entrepreneurial, self-directed and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous and evolving environments.
* Strong influencing, relationship-building, judgement and prioritisation skills across diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent synthesis and communication skills, with curiosity about emerging technologies and their responsible application to education and government systems.

**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks, commensurate with experience.
  
  
**Application Process**
Interested candidates should submit a resume customized to role outlining relevant experience, a brief statement of interest outlining how your past experience and future aspirations connect to the role (max. 500 words), and two references through the CSF Careers Portal by
**30th September 2026**
.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can commit to at least a three-year journey to help materialise CSF's 2025–2028 EdTech and AI strategy. Shortlisted applicants will complete a case exercise and participate in 2 panel interviews and final leadership conversations. We will evaluate applications on a rolling basis and will close the application process once we find the right candidate.

title: Manager - Transformation Management Office
description:
**Job Description**
Manager- Transformation Management Office (TMO)
  
  
**About The Role**
The Transformation Management Office (TMO) is a dedicated enterprise transformation function within IndiGo's Strategy Office, responsible for driving and coordinating the organization's strategic transformation agenda.
  
  
The TMO serves as the central catalyst for execution, governance across cross-functional initiatives that are critical to IndiGo's long-term growth, operational resilience, and strategic priorities. The team works closely with senior leadership, functional heads, and initiative owners across the organization to accelerate delivery, resolve interdependencies, drive accountability, and ensure sustainable adoption of change.
  
  
This role offers significant exposure to leadership and opportunity to contribute to some of the most critical transformation programs across the airline.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise Transformation & Program Delivery
* Support the execution and delivery of strategic, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across multiple business functions
* Act as a thought partner to initiative owners by applying structured problem-solving and an outside-in perspective to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and strengthen project outcomes
* Track progress against plans, proactively identifying risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and resource constraints that may impact delivery
* Assess continuity post-implementation and monitor realization of planned benefits and business outcomes
* Governance & Performance Management
* Maintain a single source of truth for transformation initiatives through structured governance, reporting, and portfolio tracking
* Develop and manage dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and executive reporting mechanisms to monitor program performance
* Run periodic transformation review cadence with initiative owners and ensure timely escalation of risks and decisions
* Support governance forums including Transformation Steering Committee reviews, Executive Committee updates, and Board-level reporting
* Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
* Coordinate closely with stakeholders across Operations, Network Planning, Engineering, Commercial, Digital, Finance, HR, Customer Experience, Safety, and other business functions
* Facilitate workshops, reviews, decision forums, and governance meetings to drive alignment and execution
* Manage interdependencies across initiatives and support resolution of competing priorities and execution challenges
* Executive Reviews & Change Management
* Support preparation of leadership presentations, strategic reviews, and decision-making materials for senior executives
* Synthesize complex cross-functional inputs into concise, executive-ready recommendations and reporting
* Support change-management, communication, and stakeholder engagement activities necessary for successful transformation adoption
* Drive a culture of execution excellence, transparency, and continuous improvement across the transformation portfolio

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Economics, Aviation, Business, or a related discipline; MBA preferred
* 3-6 years of relevant professional experience
* Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, program management, or PMO/TMO environments preferred
* Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions
* Exposure to aviation or other complex, operations-intensive industries is advantageous
* Experience working with senior leadership in fast-paced, high-visibility environments

Functional Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability
* Strong business acumen with understanding of operational and commercial interdependencies
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Executive communication and presentation skills
* Governance, reporting, risk management, and project tracking expertise
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments while maintaining attention to detail and accountability

Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience with project management, reporting, and portfolio-tracking tools
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, MS Project, Power BI, or equivalent platforms is an advantage

Reporting Structure
  
  
The role will be part of the Transformation Management Office and report directly to the Head of TMO, who in turn reports to the Chief Strategy Officer. The position will work closely with initiative owners, functional leaders, and senior management across the organization, providing significant exposure to executive leadership and enterprise-wide strategic priorities
  
  
At IndiGo, we believe in the innate strength of an energetic, diverse, and inclusive workforce, where the viewpoints and life experiences of our employees help us foster strong connections with all our customers. Our diversity equity and inclusion efforts are designed to attract, nurture, and advance the lives of our employees and customers irrespective of their – but not limited to - gender, race, color, religion, caste, creed, ethnicity, origin, language, social and economic status, sexual orientation, differently-abled status, marital status, nationality, age, family status, and maternity status.

title: APAC CBD/CDD Product Launch & Market Readiness Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Agilent's Cell Analysis, Genomics and Pathology portfolio continues to expand across Asia Pacific, and bringing each new product to market means bringing together regulatory registration, technical enablement and a channel network ready to sell and support it — in every country, on a schedule.
  
  
This is a newly created regional position that owns exactly that. You will lead the country-level execution of new product introductions across APAC region: building the launch plan market by market, driving regulatory readiness with local Regulatory Affairs and specialist registration partners, and preparing our channel partners to demonstrate, sell and support new products from day one.
  
  
You will work across Global Product Launch, Regulatory Affairs, Regional Technical Solution Specialists, Country commercial teams and channel partners, coordinating a critical path that runs from global product readiness through to first customer adoption.
  
  
In this role you will:
  
  

* Manage the delivery of integrated, multi-country new product launch programs, from global product readiness through regulatory clearance, technical and channel readiness, market activation and first customer adoption.
* Determine the overall program plan, budget, structure, schedule and resourcing for each priority launch, market by market — registration route, licence holder or agent, documentation and localisation requirements, enablement, demo instruments and target activation dates.
* Drive and deliver results according to agreed project scope, cost, quality and timeline milestones.
* Take accountability for risk assessment, identifying critical-path dependencies early and communicating them clearly to stakeholders at country, regional and global level.
* Serve as the direct contact between channel partners, specialist regulatory partners and Agilent project stakeholders.
* Support channel partners in implementing launch readiness: product and application training, competency certification, demo instrument allocation and installation, ordering and inventory access, and target account planning.
* Identify, qualify, onboard and manage third-party regulatory and registration partners to agreed deliverables and service levels.
* Track program costs and expenses against defined metrics, communicate deviations, and monitor launch performance against the business case.
* Own the costing of country registration and readiness programs, including third-party scopes of work, and ensure delivery within approved budgets.
* Build and maintain relationships with channel partners, regulatory partners and country commercial organizations.
* Establish launch governance for the region: a single readiness view by product and country, with clear owners and escalation paths.

Partner contracts, pricing and commercial performance management remain with country commercial and channel management. Regulatory strategy, submissions and regulatory decisions remain with Regulatory Affairs. This position owns the program execution that brings these together.
  
  
The role requires approximately up to 40% travel across India and the broader APAC markets.
  
  
Must consent to participate and meet Agilent approved customer/vendor credentialing requirements necessary to gain access to customer sites. Requirements may include, but are not limited to, proof of identification, proof of certification to perform the work required, and customer health and safety requirements.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a life science, engineering or related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in product launch, commercial, channel partner management within medical diagnostics — in vitro diagnostics or laboratory instrumentation.
* Product launches owned end to end, from plan through to first sale.
* Strong project management discipline: critical paths, gates, dependency mapping and risk control. PMP, Lean or an equivalent structured methodology.
* Multi-country delivery experience across India and APAC markets, with the credibility to operate across distinct regulatory and commercial environments.
* Experience directing external vendors, consultants or agencies to deliverables and service levels.
* Willingness to travel approximately 40% within the region.

**Preferred**

* Experience with cell analysis, genomics or pathology product lines.
* Commercial enablement at scale: partner training, competency certification and demo fleet planning across an indirect channel.
* Working knowledge of diagnostic instrument regulatory pathways, including CDSCO and ASEAN regimes, as an informed program manager working alongside regulatory specialists.
* MBA from a leading business school, or a comparable postgraduate business qualification.

**Additional Details**
This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.
  
  
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. title: Project Manager/Senior Project Manager – School Governance
description: About the job Project Manager/ Senior Project Manager - School GovernanceOrganisation: Central Square FoundationTeam: School GovernanceLocation: Gandhinagar, Gujarat (travel within the state and periodic travel to Delhi)About Central Square FoundationCentral Square Foundation is a nonprofit organisation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. Since 2012, we have been partnering with the government and ecosystem stakeholders to improve the learning outcomes of children, especially from low-income communities. We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable, and effective, so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. CSF has prioritised 4 critical areas of work: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN) EdTech Early Childhood Education (ECE) School GovernanceLearn more about CSF on our website.About The TeamThe School Governance team at Central Square Foundation envisions a transformed school education delivery system that is principally accountable and transparent about its learning outcomes. It targets measuring and publicising the achievement of quality outcomes in public and private schools and establishing a State Schools Standards Authority to enable this reform.The ProblemDespite extensive efforts to increase access to education, learning outcomes have remained alarmingly stagnant in the current educational landscape. Major government initiatives have focused on expanding access and providing input to schools, but their impact on improving educational outcomes has been tenuous, at best. An absence of outcomes-oriented and evidence-based governance is aggravated by a regulatory system where the government runs its own schools and regulates all schools, posing a conflict of interest due to the operator being the regulator. Further, there is no way to reliably measure the learning attainment of schools, making it difficult to hold them accountable for results.The SolutionCSF's Schools Governance team acknowledges the pressing need for a systemic reform in education, which can be solved with a two-fold approach. The states need to: -Establish a robust and reliable learning outcome indicator at the school level by assessing student competencies through a competency-based census assessment (CCA). This will involve public disclosure of school data, while keeping the student data anonymous, to transparently show every school's quality and nudge them to make the necessary improvements.Create an independent school regulator, the State School Standards Authority (SSSA), which will operate outside the current Department of School Education. This body will focus on setting school standards and demand accountability from all schools, government or private.About The Work In GujaratCSF's School Governance team helps states move from input-based regulation to outcome-based regulation, in line with the National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020). In Gujarat this means three connected pieces of work: building a reliable, school-level learning indicator through a Competency-based Census Assessment (CCA); enabling public disclosure of school quality while keeping student data anonymous; and supporting the State School Standards Authority (SSSA) as a regulator. Gujarat already runs a school quality programme, Gunotsav, which this work seeks to strengthen and align to outcomes.Position SummaryYou will run CSF's day-to-day execution of this programme in Gujarat. You are the single point of accountability who keeps government partners, technology vendors, and the internal team moving together. You are stepping into a live programme with existing relationships, an in-progress portal build, and a current roadmap, so the first priority is to absorb context quickly and hold continuity, not to rebuild from scratch.Key Responsibilities Programme executionOwn the Gujarat workplan, timelines, and deliverables for the SSSA programme, covering the CCA, public disclosure, and the supporting portal systems.Keep the programme on track against milestones, surface risks early, and drive decisions to closure. Government and stakeholder managementBe CSF's primary working contact for the state education department, GCERT (Gujarat Council of Educational Research and Training), the SSSA body, and data or hosting agencies.Build trust at both the official and field level, manage approvals and clearances, and turn CSF's recommendations into actions the government can adopt. Quality assurance and GunotsavDevelop a clear view of where Gunotsav helps and where it falls short against the outcome-based intent of NEP 2020, keeping students and parents as the test of value.Work with the state to improve how assessment is done, how results are disclosed, and how findings feed back into teaching and school improvement. Product, portal, and vendor coordinationTranslate ground realities into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the school quality and assessment portals.Manage technology vendors on scope, delivery, quality, and timelines, and steer the path to production readiness across security, performance, scale, data privacy, and hosting.Coordinate integrations where needed, for example with UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus). Monitoring and continuityTrack adoption and usage, and share regular dashboards and honest progress updates with the state team and leadership.Keep clean documentation, decision logs, and a current handover record so the programme never depends on one person's memory.Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities4 to 7 years of experience delivering complex programmes or technology-enabled projects, ideally in government, public systems, or the social sector.A graduate or postgraduate degree in any discipline.A track record of managing external vendors on time and quality.Strong stakeholder management, structured problem-solving, and clear written communication.Comfort working with data and digital platforms, including requirements, quality assurance, and releases. You do not need to write code, but you must be able to hold vendors to account on it.Fluent in English. Working Gujarati is a strong advantage for the field and government interface.Willing to be based in Gandhinagar and travel within the state.Familiarity with the Indian school education landscape and state-level systems. (preferred)Exposure to GovTech or large public sector platforms, and to government hosting and compliance, for example NIC hosting, security audits, and data protection. (preferred)Experience taking a product or programme from pilot to stable operation at scale. (preferred)Other DetailsRemuneration competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales, based on experience.Start date: Immediate.

title: Manager, Program Development, India
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
  
  
**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
Direct Reports:
  
  
MD, Country Delivery - India
  
  
None
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
The Program Development Manager role will support initiatives focused on emerging renewable energy solutions as part of the sustainable energy transition in India. In this mission-driven role, this role will work at the intersection of technical innovation, stakeholder engagement, and policy advocacy, driving impactful solutions that empower communities and promote clean energy access. The Program Development Manager will work closely with the India Country Delivery team and with the Country Delivery teams from other regions to share learning points and expertise.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
**Program Designing:**

* Understand the rural livelihood sector and identify areas which needs intervention
* Scope the market to quantify level of opportunity and size of opportunity. Establish potential to scale.
* Develop sustainable and commercially viable business models for all stake holders.
* Based on primary & secondary research and considering the market gaps & business model, create program design for efficient implementation.
* Develop detailed project plans, including resource allocation, risk management, and performance tracking.
* Work closely with the program and impact team to estimate on ground social impacts.

**Project Management**

* Identification of partnerships required for efficient implementation.
* On boarding of partners – developers, financial institutes, implementation partners, etc.
* Establish well defined milestones with quantifiable outcomes.
* Ensuring timely implementation
* Tracking and monitoring of program implementation indicators – timelines, budgets and outcomes.
* Monitor and evaluate project performance, documenting lessons learned and sharing insights for continuous improvement.

**Knowledge Products & Alliancing**

* Develop tools, templates, and resources to standardize and improve project management processes in India.
* Create case studies and white paper based on learnings from the project.
* Identify potential funders with common priorities & mandate.
* Create fund raising pitch documents to initiate funder conversations.
* Represent the organization in discussions with sectoral experts, partners, and funders, providing updates on project progress and learnings.
* Develop decks, write ups and reports on potential roadmap for scale.

**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**

* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start-Up Philosophy.’

**Required Experience**
The ideal candidate would be a self-starter with positive intent and common sense. They will be willing to “roll up their sleeves” to adapt to working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Recognising GEA’s unique position and its stage of organisational life, the ideal candidate would be interested in contributing to and building a strong, enduring organisation.
  
  
**Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience Include**

* Qualifications: Degree or post graduate qualifications; engineering, renewable energy or a related field preferable;
* The most important qualification is Intent & Common Sense.
* Experience: At least 8 years’ experience in the design and implementation of programs, experience of renewable energy systems is an added benefit.
* Network: Good network in the energy or developmental sectors;
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
* Market knowledge: Good understanding of the India rural market and livelihood landscape at state and national level;
* Organisation and management: Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to multi-task effectively and a willingness to take ownership and responsibility for own work. Strong organisation and prioritisation skills with good attention to detail.

**In Addition, The Following Would Be a Bonus**

* Experience of working on energy and infrastructure-related matters including, specifically, climate finance, renewable energy, energy transition and sustainable development; and
* Experience working on energy and infrastructure related projects in Asia.

Please submit your application on or before
**30 October COB.**

It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.*

description:

title: Head – Hotel Projects (Civil)
description:
**Position Title: Head – Projects (Civil)**

**Department: Projects**

**Position Profile**

**Reports to: Director**

**Reportees: Civil Project team, Construction Managers, planning, QA/QC and site execution teams**

**Level: AVP / VP / GM (based on experience and last designation)**

**Direct interface with:**
Architects, structural consultants, PMC, hotel operator/brand, MEP and specialist consultants, QS, Billing & Contracts, Finance, HR, Commercial, Legal, Procurement and statutory authorities

**Next career path: As per organisation structure and performance**

***Position Objective:***

The Head – Projects (Civil) will be responsible for end-to-end civil and structural delivery of a Greenfield luxury five-star hotel, providing single-point leadership for execution from pre-construction, excavation and foundations through construction, completion and final handover. The role is accountable for approved time, cost, quality, safety, statutory compliance and stakeholder coordination.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical and managerial knowledge of hotel construction, civil and structural systems, design management, contracts, QS, BOQs, construction planning, façade, waterproofing, finishes and coordination with MEP, interiors and specialist hospitality systems. The candidate must have personally led five-star hotel projects through completion and handover.

***Qualifications:***

Full-time regular B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering with 25–30 years of post-qualification experience. Must have independently led multiple five-star hotel construction projects, including Greenfield development, from excavation/foundation through completion and final handover. Residential or commercial project experience may be useful but will not substitute for the mandatory five-star hotel construction experience.

***Competencies:***

* Proven leadership in delivery of multiple five-star hotel projects, including Greenfield developments.
* Strong civil and structural engineering knowledge and construction execution capability.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage complex interfaces and critical paths.
* Strong planning, commercial, budgeting, contract and cost-control capabilities.
* Expertise in design review, constructability, quality assurance and safety leadership.
* Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar planning software.
* Strong stakeholder management with hotel operators/brands, consultants and contractors.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; ability to work under pressure.

**Job Description:**

* Assume single-point responsibility for civil and structural delivery against approved scope, time, cost, quality, safety and compliance parameters.
* Develop the project delivery strategy and integrated master plan from pre-construction through completion and handover.
* Lead site mobilisation, excavation, foundations, substructure, superstructure, façade, waterproofing, masonry, finishes and external development.
* Coordinate design management and constructability reviews with architects, structural consultants, façade specialists, interiors teams, MEP consultants, PMC (if any) and hotel operator/brand representatives.
* Review drawings, specifications, BOQs, estimates, tender packages, construction methodologies and value-engineering proposals.
* Recommend selection and appointment of civil contractors, specialist vendors and consultants in coordination with Procurement, QS & Contracts.
* Lead project planning, scheduling, resource deployment, cost planning, cash-flow monitoring and risk management.
* Monitor progress against baseline programme and critical path; identify delays early and implement recovery plans.
* Coordinate civil works with MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire and life safety, ELV (Extra Low Voltage), lifts, kitchen, laundry, interiors, landscape and external utilities.
* Ensure hotel-specific quality benchmarks, mock-ups, sample rooms and approved finish standards are achieved.
* Oversee quality inspections, material testing, method statements, inspection and test plans, and closure of non-conformances.
* Ensure compliance with applicable approvals, statutory conditions, labour requirements, environmental controls and site safety standards.
* Review contractor bills, variations, claims, commitments and forecast final cost with QS & Contracts and Finance.
* Lead progress and performance reviews with contractors and consultants; resolve technical and execution bottlenecks.
* Build, lead and develop the civil project team; define responsibilities, reporting systems and review cadence.
* Maintain project records, drawings, approvals, progress reports, risk registers, change logs and management dashboards.
* Coordinate with authorities and utility agencies for construction-related approvals, inspections and connections.
* Plan civil-side completion, snagging, defect rectification and readiness for integrated testing and commissioning.
* Ensure as-built drawings, warranties, O&M information, quality records and completion dossiers are complete.
* Lead civil-side readiness for hotel operator inspections, phased handover and final project handover.
* Provide periodic management reports covering schedule, budget, risks, decisions required and corrective actions.
* Perform other project-related responsibilities as assigned by management.

title: Brand Management (Middle East Markets)
description:
We are hiring a
**Brand Management Specialist**
for our Middle East markets!

**About the Role**

The Brand Manager makes sure every Lenskart's Middle East product launch & partnership campaign goes live on time, in both UAE and KSA. The role owns the project from brief to launch day, and holds the Creative Lead, Design, Social Media, VM and other teams to their deliverables and deadlines.

It also leads AI-first production of launch assets - brand visuals, campaign videos and 3D product videos are created with AI tools, in line with the creative direction set by the Creative Lead, through THE CONTENT FACTORY workflow.

The role sits in India but works for the Middle East. It needs someone who understands Gulf consumers and retail calendars, and who can run a launch across two markets and several teams without losing a deadline

**Responsibilities**

*Product launches and partnership campaigns*

* Own end-to-end delivery of all Lenskart ME product launches (e.g. Celestia, ONYX, Gilded, seasonal collections) and partnership campaigns, making sure every campaign and its content launch on time and to the highest quality standard
* Build and deliver the launch toolkit for every launch and partnership campaign: key visuals, videos, key messages, social and CRM assets, VM and in-store guidelines, market-specific versions for UAE and KSA
* Build each launch plan from brief to go-live
* Make sure launches go live on time and in sync in both markets, adapting for each market's retail calendar and cultural moments (Saudi National Day, Ramadan, Eid, Riyadh Season)
* Run the launch cadence
* Spot risks early, resolve blockers and escalate when a deadline is at risk

*Cross-functional delivery*

* Coordinate every team that contributes to a launch, holding each to its deliverables and dates: the Creative Lead (creative direction), design, social media, VM, trade and retail, CRM, and partner brands
* Keep one shared launch timeline as the single source of truth for all teams and both markets
* Run THE CONTENT FACTORY workflow (briefing-to-delivery, asset library, templates) so launch assets arrive on time and on brand
* Make sure every brief leaves with clear objectives, deliverables, owners and deadlines
* Protect brand consistency across all launch touchpoints in UAE and KSA

*AI creative production and capability*

* Lead AI-generated production of launch assets: brand visuals, campaign videos and 3D product videos, in line with the creative direction set by the Creative Lead
* Select, test and integrate AI tools (e.g. Higgsfield, Midjourney, Claude) into design and project workflows to improve speed, quality and cost
* Build the team's AI capability through quarterly training and on-the-job support, and track adoption
* Document prompts, workflows and tool set-ups so the capability stays with the team, not one person

*Middle East market grounding*

* Travel to UAE and KSA twice a quarter for market immersion: stores, consumers, competitors and cultural moments
* Share a written insight report within one week of each visit, and show where findings shaped creative decisions
* Work closely with the KSA Creative Lead and KSA Brand & Content Executive to keep creative locally authentic, not translated

**Qualifications**

* 3-6 years in brand management, launch management or marketing project management, ideally in fashion, beauty, eyewear or lifestyle
* Proven experience working on Middle East (GCC) brands or markets: in-house for a brand with GCC operations, or at an agency handling GCC clients
* Strong understanding of Gulf consumers and retail moments
* Hands-on AI creative production: a portfolio showing AI-generated brand visuals, video and 3D product content, using tools such as Higgsfield, Midjourney or similar
* Strong stakeholder management
* Highly organised, comfortable with project management tools and running several launches at once
* Fluent written and spoken English; Arabic is a plus
* Able and willing to travel to UAE and KSA twice a quarter

**Description**
Are you interested in launching the next generation of Amazon sites in India? Do you want to be part of the ongoing growth and expansion of Amazon’s infrastructure? The IN-Engineering Services Team is seeking an experienced Amazon Operator or Program Manager to join the IN-Launch Team to support the expansion of operation sites in India. The Launch Program Manager is a key player in the end-to-end delivery of the complex challenge of launching new buildings, driving improvements and standards to enable new buildings to achieve benchmark rates while ramping to meet network capacity. In this role, you will influence a team comprising of General Managers, Senior Operations Managers, Operation Managers, Change Ops manager, Area Managers, Project Managers, Process SMEs, Design Engineers, Real Estate, RME, CP as well as representatives of various key stakeholder teams including Supply Chain & Transportation, WHS, WFS, L&D, ICQA, EHS, Legal, L&P, ER, Finance and many others. This role calls for an individual who is operationally knowledgeable, structured, confident and professionally and socially adept to earn credibility and trust with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization, keeping an open mind, sense of humor, multi-tasking, ability to manage and deal with constant change, a drive-and-ambition and ability to deal with ambiguity will help you remain innovative in our culture
  
  
In order to be successful in this position, you need to be comfortable interfacing and driving various BU’s launches, including INFC, IXD/RC, DRCC, SDC, SC, AMZL, GSF, QC & 3P launches for respective BU’s. This will be an exciting opportunity for you if you possess a high level of autonomy and integrity while managing a variety of job responsibilities. You will be part of a high functioning team that is interconnected and supportive of each other to help complete multiple, complex and high capital projects simultaneously.
  
  
The individual will be responsible for entire region (IN Network Operate in 3 Regions, “North & East”, “South & Central” and “West”). The role will be based out of 3 regions with up to 50% of time on job travel across states. This is the fusion of strategical as well as tactical during full cycle of launch.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**The Successful Candidate**

* Is structured and organized, to plan the use of resource to meet deadlines.
* Has strong interpersonal skills, to motivate and lead core teams working on launch.
* Has strong communication skills to build relationships and identify with stakeholders across the organization.
* Is able to use their initiative and make decisions under pressure.
* Has the ability to seek opportunities to drive year on year performance and process improvements
* Will compile, manage and report on weekly launch metrics and be responsible for leading many high-profile meetings to align on launch requirements.
* Has the ability to learn fast and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
* Has operational skills and experience.
* Can work closely with core team from operational and construction sites.
* Setup mechanism for tracking overall launch, support function 4M and signage delivery system.
* Drive learnings and adhoc requirements through CM mechanism from respective stakeholders.
* Can work independently to solve problems and drive actions with a variety of stakeholders.
* Monitors and reports on the progress of all launch activity within the site project including significant milestones and any conditions which would affect project schedule.
* Should be able to ask “Why” and request details in regards to the impact of any changes requested by different teams.
* Is capable of taking accountability while providing status, asking for help, and immediately escalating issues and problems as necessary.
* Should be able to coordinate activities while onsite as well as from the office.
* Possesses a broad technical background and has the ability to “roll up their sleeves” and jump in to support, along with Coordinating the activities of different functions and act as the anchor or single point of contact for the launch process

A day in the life
  
  

* End-to-End project coordination, managing multiple stakeholders to ensure all Road to Launch tasks are completed as per program
* Managing Launch calls with regional teams, documenting key actionable and ensure closure of key points.
* Ensuring support function 4M cycle completion as per process.
* Ensuring all function signage cycle completion as per process.
* Ensure 5S marking BOQ closure as per site requirement.
* Coordinate with RE for site selection process as per SLA and POR NBD with SIM mechanism in place.
* Ensure TAX registration process and support seller onboarding process as per Launch tenets.
* Ensuring overall site readiness through thorough composite reviews and effective communication on in-flight changes
* Post launch lessons learned sessions to drive year-on-year improvements
* Managing continuous improvement in 4M, Playbook, Signages and launch mechanism.

* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

title: Project Manager
description:
Organization:
 



  





 FIND accelerates equitable access to reliable diagnosis around the world. We are working to close critical testing gaps that leave people at risk from preventable and treatable illnesses, enable effective disease surveillance, and build sustainable, resilient health systems. In partnership with countries, WHO and other global health agencies, we are driving progress towards global health security and universal health coverage. We are a WHO Collaborating Centre for Laboratory Strengthening and Diagnostic Technology Evaluation. For more information, please visit www.finddx.org
 



  





 Location: New Delhi, India
 



 Work Model: Hybrid (3 days in office and 2 days WFH per week)
 



  





 The ADAPT\-TB project aims to improve the diagnosis of pediatric tuberculosis in India by evaluating the use of non\-invasive, child\-friendly specimens (stool, tongue swabs and urine) along with other routine samples across multiple indigenous molecular diagnostic platforms in the TB diagnostic landscape.
 



  





 The project will be implemented across 11 tertiary care facilities across India in close collaboration with the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP), and stakeholders at the national, state and district levels. The study will generate evidence on diagnostic accuracy and operational feasibility to inform national scale\-up.
 



  





 The Project Manager will provide overall project management support for the implementation of Project ADAPT\-TB, including day\-to\-day coordination with participating sites, monitoring project progress, review of operational and data\-related outputs, and reporting to project leadership and key stakeholders. The incumbent will lead coordination across all project sites, ensure achievement of project milestones and documentation requirements, and support effective implementation in accordance with donor requirements and organizational standards.
 



  





 The specific activities will include but not be limited to:
 



  




* Develop, implement, and maintain project workplans, workflows, monitoring tools, and tracking systems to support effective project execution.
* Coordinate and oversee implementation of project activities across all participating sites, ensuring timely delivery of outputs and outcomes.
* Monitor project progress against established milestones, deliverables, budgets, and timelines, and recommend corrective actions where required.
* Lead coordination with tertiary institutes, state health authorities, manufacturers, research partners, and other key stakeholders to facilitate smooth project implementation.
* Provide technical and operational support to project sites and ensure adherence to approved protocols and implementation plans.
* Facilitate and coordinate regulatory approvals, including HMSC, IEC, and other relevant clearances in collaboration with participating institutions.
* Ensure standardization and quality assurance of project processes, including validation of sample processing techniques and data management procedures.
* Organize and lead project meetings, trainings, workshops, and stakeholder consultations.
* Supervise, mentor, and support project staff, fostering high performance, accountability, and teamwork.
* Ensure timely collection, review, validation, and reporting of project data from all participating sites.
* Manage project resources efficiently and support budget monitoring to maximize project outputs and impact.
* Track and maintain project documentation, records, and compliance requirements in accordance with donor and organizational guidelines.
* Prepare high\-quality project reports, donor updates, presentations, briefs, and other communication materials.
* Serve as the primary focal point for coordination between project leadership, implementation sites, donors, technical experts, and external stakeholders.
* Support donor visits, monitoring missions, audits, external evaluations, and project reviews.
* Identify implementation challenges and proactively develop mitigation strategies to ensure smooth project execution.
* Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by project leadership from time to time.



  





 Experience/Skills required
 



  




* Master’s degree in Public Health, Health Management, or a related discipline; MBBS/BDS preferred.
* 7\-10 years of progressive experience managing large\-scale public health programs and multi\-state projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams, including setting priorities, performance management, mentoring, and capacity building.
* Proven experience working with donor\-funded programs, government stakeholders, implementing partners, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, implementation, monitoring, budgeting, risk management, and donor reporting.
* Experience in TB, diagnostics, surveillance, laboratory systems, or broader health systems strengthening programs is highly desirable.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, coordination, negotiation, and report\-writing skills.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to effectively supervise and guide State Coordinators, technical staff, and project teams across multiple locations.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with virtual training, webinar, and collaboration platforms.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to foster teamwork and drive results in a complex stakeholder environment.
* Willingness to undertake frequent travel across project states and partner locations.



  





 Nature of Appointment:
 



  





 This is a full\-time position with an initial contract term until 31 March 2027, renewable subject to performance and project needs.
 



  





 Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 30th September 2026, including a cover letter outlining your motivation for the role and the following details:
 



  





 \- Current CTC (fixed and variable components, if applicable)
 



 \- Current location and willingness to based in Delhi
 



 \- Notice period and earliest available joining date
 



  





 Applications that do not include the above information may not be considered.
 



  





 But don’t wait until the deadline! We will start screening right away and if we find the right person, we will stop searching.
 



  





 Please note that due to the high volume of applications, ONLY short\-listed candidates will be contacted. FIND is dedicated to building an inclusive workforce where diversity is valued. FIND is an equal opportunity employer. Every qualified applicant will be considered for employment. FIND does not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, age, national origin, marital status, pregnancy, disability status, political ideology, military status, or any other attribute protected by applicable law.

**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global professional services firm providing advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management, and interim leadership services to companies, investors, and government entities. Founded in 1983 as a restructuring boutique, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented solutions that help organizations tackle complex issues, improve operating performance, create value, and accelerate results across six continents. Its mission is to help organizations solve complex business issues and maximize stakeholder value. A\&M’s culture is grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with founding principles of Leadership, Action, and Results. In 2023, A\&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The GCC partners with case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, serving industries including Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center has grown to more than 1,000 professionals.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As Manager, Transformation \& Operations, you will own transformation workstreams and operational initiatives within A\&M’s Corporate Shared Services team in the Gurgaon Global Capability Center. Reporting to the Director of Corporate Shared Services \& Operations, you will convert strategic priorities into executable plans, reliable transitions, improved processes, and reusable operating capability. Your scope will span GCC/GBS transition planning, process design, documentation, business\-case analysis, and operational excellence across functions such as HR, Marketing, and IT. This is a senior execution role for a hands\-on operator with consulting rigor. You will work independently with functional teams, local operations, regional partners, and senior leaders while influencing without direct authority. The role is not a people\-management position or a client\-facing advisory role, although you will mentor junior colleagues and contribute to capability building.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own two to three transformation or operational workstreams from planning through execution, using structured project plans, risk controls, quality reviews, and leadership reporting to deliver agreed outcomes.
* Execute GCC process transitions through detailed plans, handover controls, process documentation, training content, and change support that enable stable adoption by functional and operations teams.
* Design and maintain reusable playbooks, job aids, process libraries, and knowledge assets that codify best practices, improve consistency, and reduce dependency on individual process owners.
* Analyze costs, volumes, productivity, and efficiency metrics to identify improvement opportunities and build financial models, ROI calculations, and business cases for leadership decisions.
* Translate complex operational information into clear leadership updates, recommendations, and implementation priorities that support operating model governance and timely decisions.
* Partner with HR, Marketing, IT, regional teams, and GCC operations to resolve dependencies, influence without direct authority, and maintain momentum across interconnected initiatives.
* Mentor junior team members in consulting\-style problem\-solving, documentation standards, and execution discipline while supporting training plans for new associates.
* Track lessons learned and transition outcomes to strengthen future implementation methods, improve operational readiness, and build scalable capability across the growing GCC.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 10–15 years of experience, including at least 10 years in GCC/GBS transformation, shared services, operations consulting, or project\-delivery\-focused corporate operations roles.
* Strong knowledge of GCC/GBS operating models, shared services best practices, transition planning, process improvement, process documentation, and execution\-level change management.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex workstreams from planning through delivery, with the ability to manage risks, dependencies, deliverable quality, and multiple moving pieces independently.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, including cost, volume, efficiency, financial modelling, business\-case development, and ROI analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create clear documentation, training materials, leadership updates, and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate across functions and geographies, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and present findings effectively to functional leaders and operations teams.
* Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance, with prior consulting firm experience and knowledge of India GCC or multinational shared services environments preferred.



  





**Additional Plus**

 As a Program Associate, you will play a critical role in shaping the overall learner journey and ensuring the seamless execution of our flagship programs.  You will work closely with students, faculty, industry mentors, corporate partners, and internal teams to create an exceptional learning experience that goes far beyond the classroom. **Key Responsibilities** 




**Learner Experience \& Community Building** 



* Act as a key touchpoint for students throughout their learning journey, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience.
* Foster a vibrant and engaging campus culture by driving student participation in clubs, events, competitions, and community initiatives.
* Design and execute initiatives that enhance learner engagement, satisfaction, and overall program experience.
* Regularly gather student feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and work with stakeholders to implement solutions.
* Build strong relationships with learners and create an environment that encourages collaboration, ownership, and professional growth.
* Monitor learner engagement and proactively address concerns to ensure a positive student experience.



**Program Delivery \& Operations Excellence** 



* Support the Program Director in executing academic and non\-academic aspects of the program.
* Coordinate with faculty, industry mentors, and internal teams to ensure smooth delivery of classes, workshops, projects, assessments and events.
* Manage program schedules, communications, logistics, and stakeholder coordination to ensure operational excellence.
* Track key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables to ensure a seamless learner experience.
* Continuously identify process improvements that enhance efficiency, scalability, and program quality.
* Ensure every learner\-facing interaction reflects the high standards of quality and professionalism associated with Digiaccel and Altera.



**Industry Engagement \& Corporate Partnerships** 



* Build and nurture relationships with industry leaders, hiring partners, mentors, and corporate stakeholders.
* Coordinate guest lectures, leadership talks, industry immersions, networking sessions, and experiential learning opportunities.
* Work closely with corporate partners to facilitate live projects, mentorship engagements, and industry collaborations.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the institute's industry ecosystem and enhance learner exposure to real\-world business challenges.
* Represent Digiaccel and Altera professionally while building long\-term partnerships that create value for learners and industry stakeholders.



**Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration** 



* Collaborate closely with Academic Operations, Admissions, Marketing, Career Services, and Leadership teams to deliver a world\-class learner experience.
* Serve as a bridge between students, faculty, mentors, and corporate partners to ensure effective communication and alignment.
* Manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously while balancing competing priorities and timelines.
* Ensure prompt resolution of learner and stakeholder queries through proactive communication and coordination.



**Student Outcomes \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Contribute towards improving learner satisfaction, engagement, and program effectiveness.
* Track key learner experience metrics and provide insights to improve program delivery.
* Analyze feedback, engagement trends, and operational challenges to recommend actionable improvements.
* Support initiatives focused on strengthening learner outcomes, employability, and overall program impact.
* Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and elevate the student experience.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 1\-3\+ years of experience in Program Management, Operations, Community Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Education, Events, or other stakeholder\-facing roles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Excellent organizational and project management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with a proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Comfortable interacting with senior industry leaders, mentors, faculty, and students.
* Passion for education, learner success, and creating exceptional experiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and project management tools.
* A collaborative team player with a growth mindset and high attention to detail.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Make a Tangible Impact** 
 : Your work will directly influence the learning journey, career outcomes, and professional growth of future business leaders.
* **Work at the Intersection of Education \& Industry:** 
 Collaborate with founders, CXOs, industry experts, and leading organizations that are shaping the future of business.
* **High Ownership, High Learning:** 
 Take ownership of critical initiatives from day one and gain exposure to multiple aspects of building and scaling a modern education institution.
* **Build the Future of Management Education:** 
 Be part of a mission\-driven organization that is redefining how business education is delivered in a digital and AI first world.
* **Accelerated Career Growth** 
 : Work in a talent\-dense environment where performance, initiative, and impact are recognized and rewarded with greater responsibility and growth opportunities.



  





**About the Company** 




 Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.
 



  





 Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher\-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.
 



  





 The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%\+ NPS across all programs since inception.
 



  





 Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors.
 



  





 We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.
 



  





 We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

**Job Title: Senior Design Manager** 




**Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India** 




**Experience: Minimum 15 years overall; 7\+ years in leadership** 




**Working Days\- Monday\-Saturday** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Role summary** 




 We are seeking a seasoned Senior Design Manager with deep expertise in SolidWorks and Production line experience in Sheet Metal. You will lead design projects from concept through validation, mentor engineers, enforce design\-for\-manufacturability and cost‑efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in processes and tools. The role requires strong technical judgment, excellent stakeholder management, and hands\-on involvement in complex sheet‑metal product development.
 



  





**Key accountabilities\-** 




**\- Team leadership and people management** 




 \- Recruit, develop, retain, and scale a high\-performing design team (mechanical engineers, CAD leads, drafters).
 



 \- Establish clear role descriptions, career ladders, KPIs, and individual development plans.
 



 \- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, succession planning, and calibration with HR and senior leadership.
 



 \- Promote a culture of ownership, continuous learning, safety, and cross\-functional collaboration.
 



  





**\- Technical ownership and hands\-on design** 




 \- Provide hands\-on SolidWorks leadership for complex sheet‑metal parts and assemblies; create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings.
 



 \- Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries.
 



 \- Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‑built documentation.
 



  





 \-
 **Product development lifecycle \& project leadership** 




 \- Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full\-scale production.
 



 \- Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices).
 



 \- Lead cross\-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; present technical trade\-offs and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders.
 



  





**\- Manufacturability, cost optimization \& supplier engineering** 




 \- Own DFMA for sheet‑metal: material selection, blank size optimization, bend allowances, nesting strategies, common parts, and fastener selection.
 



 \- Collaborate with toolrooms and suppliers on tooling design (dies, progressive tooling, fixtures), vendor capabilities, and lead\-time management.
 



 \- Drive cost\-down initiatives through design simplification, standardization, and volume\-based sourcing strategies.
 



  





**\- Quality, compliance \& reliability** 




 \- Ensure designs meet applicable standards (safety, EMC, environmental) and internal quality requirements.
 



 \- Lead root cause analysis (8D) for field failures involving mechanical design; drive corrective \& preventive actions.
 



 \- Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required.
 



  





**\- Process improvement \& systems** 




 \- Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management.
 



 \- Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model\-based definition (MBD) where applicable.
 



 \- Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
 



  





**\- Stakeholder management \& reporting** 




 \- Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements.
 



 \- Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership.
 



 \- Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings.
 



  





**Deliverables \& success metrics** 




**\- Deliverables** 




 \- Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production.
 



 \- DFMEA, tolerance stack\-ups, verification \& validation plans, prototype test reports.
 



 \- Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials.
 



  





**Required qualifications \& experience (expanded)** 




**\- Education:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; M.Tech/M.S. preferred.
 



**\- Experience:** 
 Minimum 15 years in mechanical/product design with heavy emphasis on sheet‑metal; at least 7 years in a managerial or lead capacity.
 



**\- CAD skills** 
 : Expert\-level SolidWorks (modeling, sheet‑metal module, assemblies, weldments, routing optional), experience with SolidWorks PDM/Manage or equivalent.
 



**\- Manufacturing knowledge:** 
 Thorough understanding of sheet‑metal fabrication processes (laser, plasma, punching, bending, progressive forming), welding, adhesive joining, rivets, fastening, surface treatments, and finish processes.
 



**\- Systems:** 
 Hands\-on experience with PLM/PDM systems, ECO workflows, BOM management, and basic ERP interactions.
 



**\- Process skills** 
 : DFMA, GD\&T, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, root cause analysis tools (8D, RCA), and test plan development.
 



 \-
 **Leadership:** 
 Demonstrated people management, hiring, mentoring, and stakeholder negotiation experience.
 



 \-
 **Communication** 
 : Strong written and verbal English; ability to present technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 \-
 **Mobility:** 
 Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and production sites (as required).
 



  





**Preferred / differentiating skills** 




 \-
 **Certifications:** 
 CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent.
 



 \-
 **Domain experience** 
 : Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense.
 



 \-
 **Simulation:** 
 Experience with sheet‑metal forming simulation (e.g., AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization.
 



 \-
 **Tooling \& fixtures:** 
 Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies.
 



 \-
 **Software:** 
 Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar.
 



 \-
 **Manufacturing exposure:** 
 Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains.
 



 Interested candidates can share their resume at 8750604449\-Harshita Joshi or at payal@metaguise.com
