title: Sr Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.
   

  

 Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.
   

  

 The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 The Trade Desk is helping shape the future of digital advertising, and APAC \& EMEA are the most dynamic places to build that future. As APAC \& EMEA Strategy \& Operations (S\&O) resets from ad\-hoc executor to strategic advisor, we are standing up two accountable pillars: RevOps \& Sales Enablement, and Systems \& XFN Enablement to give the region the scalable frameworks and operating discipline it needs for sustained double\-digit growth.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on operator who thrives on turning systems and process chaos into trusted, self\-serve foundations, someone who is as comfortable rolling up their sleeves in Salesforce (or equivalent platforms) as they are coaching a country manager through change. If you're energised by fixing the plumbing so teams can focus on customers, this is where you'll do some of your best work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Reporting into the APAC Director, Systems \& XFN Enablement, you'll own the execution layer that turns the region's systems foundation from a source of friction into a source of trust. Today, channel management activities (such as, mapping rework and change requests) pull Business Development \& Client Services managers and sellers off customers; you'll close that gap for good.
   

  

  

* Own Salesforce hygiene end\-to\-end, empowering Sales teams with tools for a frictionless \& efficient experience.
* Support systems transformation at regional and global level.
* Run change management and self\-serve training series with managers, including relationship methodology as well as 1:many governance cadences with the Salesforce champion community.
* Operate governance gates for rev\-group creation and maintain a clean audit trail, partnering with Finance, HR and Deal Desk.
* Support the Top Accounts process and outbound account management logic as part of the broader sales enablement agenda and contribute to the redesign of the Ops rhythm (Weekly Revenue Call, Quarterly \& Annual Planning).
* Track and report against success measures (mapping accuracy, backlog, adoption, meetings/FTE, training completion) to demonstrate ROI and free up selling time for GTM teams.
* Identify and build automation for standard workflows, processes and reporting, in partnership with engineering where needed.


**Who You Are**
* 8\-10 years in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, Systems/Salesforce administration or Strategy, ideally in ad tech, SaaS or digital media.
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce or CRM expertise (account/territory mapping, workflow rules, Portfolio Manager App or equivalent tooling); Tableau or Power BI experience is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing durable, self\-serve processes rather than one\-off fixes — you build the reusable rule, not just the one\-time exception.
* Comfortable running change management directly with frontline managers: training, governance cadences, and building trust that the new system works.
* Detail\-obsessed and data\-driven, with the judgement to know when a process needs to flex versus when to hold the governance line.
* A collaborative operator who partners naturally across Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Sales and Engineering to get things done.


**Why this role, why now**
 At TTD, values like Vision, Grit, Agility, Generosity, Openness, and Full\-Heartedness show up in how we work with one another every day. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the markets we serve, and we warmly welcome people from all backgrounds who are excited to help shape what comes next.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
   

  

 Please reach out to us at accommodations@ thetradedesk. com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process.
   

  

 When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

title: Head of Operations
description:
**Note : Please apply only if you have worked in a quick\-commerce or top e\-commerce company** 




  





**Location:** 
 South Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 3–12 years
 



**Preferred Background:** 
 Quick Commerce / E\-commerce / Last\-Mile Logistics / Dark Store Operations
 



**Preferred companies:** 
 Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket, Amazon, Flipkart, Shadowfax, Porter or similar high\-speed operations businesses.
 



  





**About TapStock** 




**TapStock is building a technology\-led procurement and fulfilment platform for the interior, architecture and construction ecosystem.** 




**We are looking for our first Operations hire** 
 to build TapStock’s operating system from scratch across warehouse, inventory, fulfilment, dispatch, delivery and customer experience.
 



 You’ll work directly with the
 **founding and technology teams** 
 .
 



**Mission:** 
 Build operations that can handle
 **10X volume without adding 10X people.** 




  





**What you'll own :** 




**1\. Order Fulfilment** 



* Own Order → Stock → Picking → QC → Packing → Dispatch → Delivery.
* Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve fulfilment speed and accuracy.



**2\. Warehouse \& Inventory** 



* Build processes for receiving, inwarding, storage, picking, QC, packing, dispatch and returns.
* Establish SKU/bin discipline, cycle counting, reconciliation and inventory accuracy.
* Create simple SOPs that teams can execute consistently.



**3\. Last\-Mile Delivery** 



* Design TapStock’s initial delivery model across riders, third\-party partners and mini\-trucks.
* Own route planning, batching, SLAs and delivery costs.
* Optimise for
 **fast delivery at the lowest sustainable cost.**



**4\. Technology \+ Operations** 



* Work closely with the technology team to turn operational problems into scalable product solutions. Example: Wrong item picked → Poor SKU identification → Barcode/QR\-based picking.



 The constant question should be:
 **“Can technology eliminate this manual activity?”** 




**5\. Build the Operating Playbook** 




 Create SOPs covering fulfilment, inventory, delivery, returns, damages, failed deliveries, escalations and emergency orders.
 



  





**Metrics you will Own :** 




**Fulfilment:** 
 Processing time, pick/pack/dispatch time, fulfilment SLA
 



**Inventory:** 
 Accuracy, stock\-outs, picking accuracy, shrinkage, damages
 



**Delivery:** 
 On\-time %, delivery time, failures, cost/delivery, orders/rider
 



**Productivity:** 
 Orders/day, orders/employee, orders/hour, warehouse utilisation
 



  





**What we are looking for :** 



* 3–10 years in Quick Commerce, E\-commerce, Last\-Mile or Dark Store operations.
* Hands\-on experience in high\-speed fulfilment environments.
* Strong understanding of warehouse and last\-mile operations.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and analytical skills.
* Strong execution, ownership and problem\-solving ability.
* Comfortable working directly with technology/product teams.
* Comfortable building processes from scratch in a startup.



  





**Most importantly:** 
 We want someone who has
 **personally solved operational problems on the ground** 
 , not someone who only prepares MIS reports.
 



  





 You should be
 **fast, analytical, hands\-on, process\-driven and technology\-friendly.** 




**You could be in the warehouse at 8 AM, analysing 200 orders at 11 AM and redesigning the workflow with the technology team at 4 PM.** 




  





**Reporting** 




**Reports directly to the Founder / CEO** 
 during the MVP stage and works closely with
 



 Product/Technology, Procurement, Warehouse, Customer Success and Delivery Partners.
 



  





**Compensation** 




**Fixed compensation \+ meaningful performance\-linked component. Final compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability to build scalable operations.** 




  





**Selection Process** 



* Founder Interview
* Operations Case Study
* Ground Operations Assessment
* Final Founder Discussion

title: Junior Live Music & Comedy Event Producer
description:
**Junior Event Producer — Booking \& Live Events** 




 Full\-time \| Louder Studio, Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi
 



  





**About Louder** 




 Louder is a live events and entertainment company promoting art, music, and culture. We work with artists, agents, venues, and brands to create memorable live experiences and build audiences for creative talent — with events, tours, and nightclub nights spanning India, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and other international markets. Our mission is to promote multicultural art and cultural exchange for audiences everywhere.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 You'll identify, develop, and secure talent, and manage the relationships and logistics that turn a booking into a sold\-out show — from first pitch through to post\-event settlement. You'll maintain existing client relationships and act as the link between artists, agents, managers, venues, vendors, and our internal team throughout a show's lifecycle. Much of the role is research, budgeting, negotiation, selling, and building the systems and data that make each show better than the last — while contributing to Louder's programming across Australia, NZ, Singapore, India, and beyond, including our nightclub events. Comfort with AI tools across every function of the role is expected.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Research \& Talent* 



* Research markets, cities, and venues; map artists to the right audiences and evaluate profitability and market potential
* Track emerging talent, indie artists, and pop\-culture trends worth booking
* Analyse international markets, audience presence, and other metrics to gauge opportunity



  





*Booking \& Deal\-Making* 



* Pitch concepts and opportunities to artists, agents, and creative teams
* Support and follow up on artist negotiations — reviewing contract notes carefully and capturing negotiation details
* Secure venue availability and backup holds; negotiate booking terms with venues
* Coordinate and maintain key sales points and rider requirements for artists
* Book diverse, credible lineups aimed at maximising ticket sales



  





*Touring \& Show Planning* 



* Draft event business plans and marketing plans
* Build itineraries, routing plans, and touring strategies; develop and manage event calendars and capacities
* Build comprehensive event budgets, capacity plans, and financial projections



  





*Financials \& Admin* 



* Manage financial arrangements — deposits, settlements, expenditure tracking, and event P\&Ls
* Follow up on third\-party quotes and invoices; manage expense reports and contracts
* Build and maintain systems and templates that make booking, budgeting, and reporting repeatable across shows; run post\-event evaluations to improve future events



  





*Marketing, Ticketing \& Sellouts* 



* Own the marketing for your shows end\-to\-end — announcements, campaigns, and promotion — to ensure every show sells out
* Sell TixMojo, our in\-house ticketing platform, to event organisers
* Pitch tickets and sponsorship via call, email, and SMS/WhatsApp
* Identify and collaborate with influencers, promoters, and industry partners to help sell out shows
* Manage the full grant lifecycle — identifying and pitching for grants, writing proposals, winning them, and carrying them through execution, implementation, and reporting/feedback



  





*Platform \& Data* 



* Lead development of our AI\-powered event management platform, working to automate event management work end\-to\-end
* Maintain and update our talent and market database city by city — tracking which shows, genres, and languages are performing well across all the markets we operate in, not just India



  





  





*On\-Site \& Logistics* 



* Project\-manage end\-to\-end logistics for your portfolio of events — staffing, technical/logistic suppliers, production, and venue operations
* Source quotes from vendors and suppliers, and provide on\-site support during execution



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Minimum 2 years' experience in live music/comedy booking, event production, venue booking, promoting, artist management, or client servicing (as a venue booker, agent, promoter, or promoter/agent assistant — gained professionally, independently, or through grassroots/DIY work)
* Experience across all aspects of producing a show — booking/buying, marketing, production, and settlement



  




* Ability to run a tour end\-to\-end: finding venues, routing, scheduling, and executing across a city or country
* Strong Excel skills and confidence building and tracking event budgets
* Working knowledge of lighting, sound, and AV as used in live events
* Wide knowledge of Indian and international artists, DJs, comedians, and entertainers, with genuine engagement in pop culture and emerging talent
* Comfortable selling and pitching a product or service to clients/organisers
* Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills
* Strong organisational and time\-management skills; able to multitask and manage multiple projects and deadlines at once
* Comfortable working with data — understanding, building, and capturing data to track and improve outcomes
* Genuine interest in music, comedy, pop culture, and live entertainment


- 


 Some travel and work across international time zones may be required.
 



  





 One More Thing
 



 "It's not my job" isn't part of our vocabulary. We stuff envelopes; for a fake shaadi, we sourced every costume and element an Indian baraat needs, then found musicians in another country and briefed them on the songs and instruments so it went off seamlessly. We make mistakes, and learn from them.

 We are specifically looking for a hands\-on Factory / Production Operations professional.

 Dispatch

You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 The Global Network Acquisition (GNA) APAC team leads the planning, design, acquisition and long term scaling of Google's Production networks in Asia. We ensure our network can support the growth of all existing and new products and services in Asia cost efficiently and on\-time.
   

  

 Our responsibility includes securing and building network infrastructure, from colocation space, metro fiber, long haul networks, to submarine capacity/cables and related infrastructure across many countries in Asia.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with internal business and cross\-functional networking technical teams to identify and define tactical and strategic initiatives necessary to meet Google's network infrastructure needs for both expansion and cost optimization across Asia.
* Present network plans for approval by all internal stakeholders. Plan complexity will range from short\-term metro augments to long\-term region\-wide strategies for Google network in Asia.
* Manage the approved network plan with internal contributors such as network negotiators or vendor delivery managers to ensure infrastructure is delivered on\-time.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to define and improve business processes to enable automation, reduce lead time and manage changes. Communicate progress internally and collaborate with network deployment and other technical teams.
* Partner with network negotiators in planning and execution of orders and contracts, and in vendors meetings and industry conferences.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

* Architect high\-fidelity leadership dashboards and quarterly business reviews that quantify IKC velocity, technical maturity, and ROI. You will translate complex engineering metrics into strategic value narratives for global leadership.

* Demonstrated experience managing corporate social media accounts (specifically LinkedIn) with a track record of driving engagement.
* Strong event management background, capable of organizing large\-scale corporate events and celebrations for hundreds of employees.
* Experience in designing or facilitating corporate training and onboarding programs.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple high\-visibility projects simultaneously.
* Must be legally authorized to work in India for any employer without sponsorship.

 What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
   

  

 For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

description:
**About WPP Media**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

**Role Summary And Impact**
 We are seeking a proactive and client\-focused Media Manager to lead offline media planning while supporting integrated media solutions for a portfolio of clients. The role requires strong media fundamentals, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and the ability to collaborate across teams to deliver effective communication solutions that drive client business objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* As the primary point of contact for clients on day\-to\-day planning and campaign requirements.
* Build strong client relationships through proactive communication and maintaining timelines.
* Understand client business objectives, category dynamics, and marketing priorities to develop relevant media solutions.
* Develop/ supervise offline media plans across TV, Print, Radio based on audience insights and campaign objectives.
* Utilize media research tools and consumer data to derive actionable recommendations.
* Work closely with specialist teams to build integrated media solutions incorporating digital, content, partnerships, and innovations where relevant.
* Evaluate sponsorships, content integrations, and property opportunities aligned with client objectives.
* Coordinate with buying, investment, and media partner teams to ensure smooth campaign execution.
* Monitor campaign delivery, troubleshoot issues, and ensure quality control across all deliverables.
* Conduct post\-campaign analyses and present key learnings and recommendations.
* Collaborate with internal teams including Strategy, Investment, Digital, Content, Data \& Analytics, and Creative teams.


**Desired Skills \& Experience**
* 3 \- 6 years of experience in media planning, integrated media roles within a media agency environment.
* Strong understanding of offline media channels, audience measurement tools, and media planning principles.
* Exposure to integrated media planning, content partnerships, and sponsorship opportunities.
* Excellent client management, presentation, and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


**Life At WPP Media \& Benefits**
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Human Centered Change Manager
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 As a Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, you will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with Salesforce customers to optimize platform value realization through the design and implementation of change strategies that prioritize the human aspect of transformative change. Working collaboratively with customers and Salesforce delivery teams, you will drive impactful team dynamics, cultivate awareness, and secure alignment with a unified change vision. Leading essential change management and enablement initiatives, you will establish the groundwork for successful and enduring change adoption, using AI\-enabled delivery practices. Additionally, you will provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to members of the project team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Change Leadership:**
* Partner with customers to develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with organizational goals and Salesforce platform implementation.
* Analyze the human impact of technological changes and develop adaptive strategies to address organizational challenges.


**Proactive Engagement And Team Building**
* Proactively foster high\-impact team dynamics, building awareness and securing buy\-in for shared change objectives.
* Collaborate closely with customers and Salesforce delivery teams to ensure alignment and commitment to the change vision.


**Key Change Management Initiatives**
* Lead critical change management and enablement activities to facilitate successful and sustained change adoption.
* Design and implement tailored training programs for stakeholders at all levels to ensure effective utilization of Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to align user experience design with change management strategies, ensuring user\-centric adoption of Salesforce solutions.


**Oversight And Mentoring**
* Provide oversight, coaching, and mentoring to project team members, guiding them in executing change management strategies effectively.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and development within the project team.
* Facilitate the integration of change management processes into Salesforce.com projects.
* Work closely with Salesforce.com administrators, BAs, Solutions Architects and developers to understand system changes and ensure alignment with change management strategies.
* Support team upskilling in user experience principles to strengthen collaboration with design teams and improve the effectiveness of training, communications, and adoption strategies.


**Qualifications**
* Prosci Certification or equivalent is mandatory, with demonstrated expertise in change management and training within the context of technology implementations. Salesforce experience is highly desirable.
* Background in technology or digital transformation projects, showcasing advanced problem\-solving abilities and analytical acumen.
* Minimum of 5 years of dedicated experience in change management, with a strong foundation in Instructional Design.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Awareness and practical exposure to AI\-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM, Claude) and an Agentic Delivery mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field is required. A Master's degree is considered advantageous.


**Overview**
 The Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, is a pivotal leader who drives transformative change within organizations by prioritizing the human aspect of change and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and Salesforce platform capabilities. If you are a seasoned Change Management Professional with a track record of success in guiding organizations through complex technology implementations, we invite you to apply and contribute to our mission of driving impactful and sustainable change.
   

  

 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

**Purpose \& Overall Relevance For The Organization**
 The Workplaces function is responsible for the end\-to\-end active management of the adidas Real Estate Portfolio including leases and transactions of all properties, as well as the design, construction and operations of adidas offices, showrooms and Distribution Centres. In this role you are responsible for the workplace operations, quality management, development and coordination of workplace services across the adidas India Market Office portfolio. You will ensure safe, compliant, efficient and engaging workplace environments that support business performance, employee experience and the adidas culture.
   

  

 As the Workplace Management lead for India, you will drive operational excellence across multiple locations, ensuring the highest quality standards for workplace services, facilities operations and employee experience. You will lead workplace service delivery, vendor management, local workplace projects, budget management and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring alignment with India HR strategy and priorities, as well as regional and global Workplace standards.
   

  

 This role will set the highest quality standards for all location\-related workplace operations while continuously seeking opportunities to improve service quality, workplace experience, sustainability and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead workplace operations across the adidas India Market Office portfolio, ensuring consistent, compliant and high\-quality service delivery across all locations.
* Plan, organise, monitor and continuously improve workplace operational processes, standards, procedures and service delivery models to achieve maximum customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
* Steer, coordinate and manage all assigned workplace services including hard and soft facilities management, reception, catering, hospitality, security, fleet management, workplace maintenance, cleaning and other workplace support services.
* Develop, optimise and continuously improve assigned workplace services to enhance employee experience, service quality, operational efficiency and sustainability outcomes.
* Act as the primary interface between adidas and assigned external service providers, ensuring strong governance, service performance, compliance and value delivery.
* Lead supplier sourcing, tendering, contract management and vendor performance reviews in partnership with Procurement, including commercial evaluation, supplier selection recommendations, mobilisation and ongoing performance management.
* Develop and manage Workplace operating and capital expenditure budgets, including planning, forecasting, reporting and cost control.
* Lead and support workplace projects, refurbishments and operational improvement initiatives, ensuring delivery against scope, budget, timeline and quality expectations, while partnering with Design \& Delivery teams where appropriate.
* Support space management activities to ensure effective allocation, utilisation and optimisation of workplace space across the portfolio.
* Manage day\-to\-day landlord and property management relationships.
* Help shape the future of Workplaces within India and create a sustainable foundation that supports changing business and employee needs.
* Partner closely with HR and business stakeholders to deliver workplace activations, events and employee experiences that bring the adidas culture to life within the physical workplace and support India HR priorities.
* Translate regional and global Workplace strategies, standards, policies and initiatives into practical and effective solutions for the India market.
* Build strong relationships with senior business leaders and key stakeholders, providing workplace expertise, recommendations and solutions that support business objectives.
* Lead and further develop assigned employees and external resources where applicable, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, service excellence and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with Health \& Safety teams to ensure workplace operations operate in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory and company requirements.
* Maintain compliance with applicable IMS requirements within the area of responsibility.
* Implement and ensure compliance with Workplace policies, governance standards and project management requirements.
* Travel regularly within India to support workplace operations, projects, stakeholder engagement and service quality across the office portfolio.


**Key Relationships**
 adidas employees, Senior Leadership Team, HR, Finance, Procurement, Workplaces regional and global teams, HSEE teams, respective business functions, external suppliers and service providers, landlord and property management partners, external authorities where required.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Service excellence mindset with a strong focus on employee experience
* Proven people management and leadership capabilities
* Strong Workplace Management, Facilities Management or Corporate Real Estate experience within a complex, multi\-site organisation
* Project management experience across workplace, facilities and operational improvement initiatives
* Tender management, supplier selection and vendor governance experience
* Strong negotiation and commercial management skills
* Budget and cost control with demonstrated experience managing OPEX and CAPEX budgets
* Proven ability to review, improve and optimise operational processes, standards and service delivery models
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple functions and seniority levels
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Understanding of workplace compliance, risk management and health and safety requirements
* Experience working within regional and global frameworks while adapting solutions to local business needs
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Very good English skills


**Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications**
* Appropriate qualification in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Corporate Real Estate or a related discipline preferred
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in Workplace Management, Facilities Management, Corporate Real Estate or a related field
* Experience managing a complex, multi\-site portfolio
* Demonstrated experience managing outsourced workplace services and vendor partners
* Proven experience managing workplace operational and capital budgets
* Experience leading workplace projects, refurbishment initiatives and service improvement programmes

* Experience leading people, teams and/or outsourced service providers

title: Scheduling Success Coordinator
description:
****Job Description****
 Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek \-\- so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com
   

  

**Primary Function (the primary purpose of the position):**
 Primary role is to maximize the effectiveness and efficiency of Agilent’s field organization that impacts cost and revenue for the business
   

  

 Focusing on strategic planning to optimize the field service team and meet our customer service commitments. As well as managing the daily operations within a given geography that continuously meets and exceeds the expectations of our internal and external customers by assigning the right service engineering resource, in the right location, at the right time
   

  

 Works in strong partnership with Technical Remote Support Engineers and has direct responsibility of meeting contractual response times and ensuring all Agilent and Partner resources are effectively and efficiently deployed for customer on site attendance
   

  

 Works closely with Sales and Support Organizations, Customer Operations Center, Support Parts Logistics and Authorized Support Providers to ensure timely delivery of services to our customers
   

  

**Desired Skills / Knowledge :**
* Strong planning and organizational skills, and high attention to detail
* Negotiation and persuasion skills
* Resourceful and solutions oriented
* Business collaboration capabilities
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast paced environment
* Proactive attitude and an ability to generate ideas and problem solve
* Driven to achieve a successful experience for the customer, whilst also achieving our internal measures
* Ability to manage a highly pressurized and demanding multitasking environment on a daily basis, responding to sudden changes of priority and to management escalations with immediate solutions
* Strong planning and organizational skills
* Ability to set customer expectations correctly and manage difficult customer situations professionally
* Ability to handle customer onsite requests via telephone, fax/mail, web
* Effective and concise communication skills \- verbal, written and listening (English)
* Ability to work independently and without direct supervision
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
* Knowledge of relevant SAP modules (ECC, CRM, FSM, BCM)
* Responsive to Customer Feedback to continuously improve processes and behaviors
* Compliance and adherence in call management, processes and procedures


****Major Job Duties / Responsibilities****
* Determine and develop approaches to assignments and processes, contribute to continuous improvement efforts \- resources optimization and customer satisfaction are the driving factors.
* Own the confirmation of all onsite service orders within an assigned geography.
* Personally responsible for meeting customer response times, providing quality service, and making sure all field resources are effectively deployed for customer on\-site services.
* Ensure the most cost\-effective Field Service Engineer and/or Authorized Service Provider (“ASP”) is selected for services; rescheduling service where required to meet business objectives.
* Work collaboratively and partner with different departments.
* Lead solutions that meet Agilent and customer’s onsite needs, with the foresight to raise scheduling escalations when required.
* Maintain accurate record of engineer availability and commitments, utilizing our business enterprise tools.
* Proactively manage resource shortages independently or in collaboration with the appropriate leaders.
* Accountable for customer satisfaction and developing customer relationships that promote retention and loyalty, inclusive of Agilent Customer Survey.
* Utilize in\-depth knowledge of Agilent process and procedures, showing ability to follow them with high attention to detail.
* Arrange and plan complex, high impact services with minimal management intervention.
* Ensure all working relationships follow Agilent Technologies Standards of Business Conduct.


**Primary Function for Subject Matter Expert Role (the primary purpose of the position) \- in addition to Core Scheduling functions:**
 The Scheduling Coordinator Subject Matter Expert’s (SME) primary responsibility is to support the scheduling team within a given geography
   

  

 Within the role, the SME will be accountable to assist in building the scheduling organization competency, provide scheduling backup coverage and participate in all scheduling related projects
   

  

 The SME is expected to have deep domain knowledge of all the scheduling processes and tools utilized by the roles within the scheduling organization. They will participate/lead in new employee onboarding training events and conduct continuous best practice sessions for existing employees
   

  

 During their backup coverage responsibility, they will be accountable to the same standards in meeting customer response times, providing quality service and making sure all field resources are effectively deployed for on\-site service calls
   

  

 Their participation in all scheduling related projects allows them to provide scheduling insights that support future tool capabilities, process simplification and any other scheduling improvement initiatives. They are developing their skills to continue building their expertise
   

  

****Desired Skills / Knowledge****
* Demonstrates consistency in approach for all field service management.
* Innovate and inspires others.
* Specialized depth and breadth of expertise in job.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a focus on being able to provide effective and timely communications.
* Strong planning and organizational skills, and high attention to detail.
* Understanding and focus on leading solutions and being resourceful.
* Facilitate team collaboration and approach situations with maturity and diplomacy.
* Highly proactive attitude and an ability to generate ideas and problem solve.


****Major Job Duties / Responsibilities****
* Develops a competency and skill sets in the team so they can perform their jobs effectively and efficiently.
* Owns building their expertise in all job functions under the scheduling umbrella.
* Provides scheduling backup support within a specified geography.
* Communicate changes made to tools and processes; ensure adoption along with manager.
* Assist with training/onboarding new team members.
* Escalates scheduling challenges to management.
* Provides input into and executes on user documentation and training material.
* Responsible testing the scheduling tools that are in development, includes: developing of test cases, evaluating it for accuracy and usability and providing results to the Global Scheduling Architect.
* Point of contact for the scheduling team on system defects.
* Participates in relevant projects, meetings \& workshops.


****Qualifications****
* Academic degree with a technological/ engineering background; alternatively, an equivalent background/ experience in a similar role is desired
* Experience working in customer service and/or project management required
* Minimum 5\+ years’ experience working in customer service or project management
* Professional Certification that supports customer experience


****Additional Details****
 This job has a full time weekly schedule.
   

  

 Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations
   

  

 Agilent Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.
