title: Business Operations / Commercial PMO
description:
BUSINESS OPERATIONS / COMMERCIAL PMO \| GLOBAL LEARNING PRODUCTS
 



  





 This isn't a traditional Product Manager role.
 



  





 I'm looking for someone who enjoys making the machinery behind a growing product business work – commercially, financially and operationally.
 



  





 You'll sit within a global learning and innovation environment, supporting multiple products and programmes as they move from pipeline through approval, delivery, financial management and ultimately project closure.
 



  





 Think:
 



 Pipeline → Project → Budget → Supplier → Delivery → Revenue → Closure
 



  





 You'll be comfortable owning the detail behind that journey – maintaining Salesforce project records, tracking milestones, managing budgets and forecasts, reconciling costs, POs and invoices, coordinating suppliers, supporting SOW/contract processes and producing meaningful business reporting.
 



  





 The interesting part is that this isn't simply administration. As the portfolio scales, you'll help improve the processes, controls and reporting that sit behind it.
 



  





 I'd particularly like to hear from people with 3–5 years' experience across Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance Operations, PMO, Project Controls or consulting operations.
 



  





 You should be genuinely strong with Excel and numbers and comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and workstreams.
 



  





 Experience within learning, professional services, technology, consulting or financial services would be particularly interesting.
 



  





 Gurgaon based \| Global environment
 



  





 If your strength is bringing financial and operational discipline to complex programmes, I'd like to hear from you.
 



  





 That should dramatically reduce the number of generic Product Manager applications because you've explicitly told them “this isn't a traditional Product Manager role.”
 



  





 When applying in 2–3 lines, tell me about a programme where you personally managed BOTH financial tracking (budget/revenue/costs/POs) AND project governance.

 The SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager will lead configuration efforts for the global SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support programs for the EY SAP platform. * Establish program structure, delivery cadence, governance routines, and decision forums for complex global SAP initiatives.
* Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments to support successful outcomes.
* Escalate key risks, resolve delivery blockers, and align decisions across business and technology stakeholders.


**SAP Delivery Leadership**

* Oversee retrofit activities, code synchronization, landscape coordination, and deployment readiness.

**Supervision Responsibilities:**

**Job Requirements:**

 AirBrick is transforming commercial interior design by combining human creativity with advanced artificial intelligence. The company’s multidisciplinary team of interior designers, architects, and AI specialists uses machine learning, data analytics, and computer vision to create functional, aesthetically aligned spaces that enhance productivity, employee satisfaction, and customer experience. AirBrick delivers interactive 3D visualizations, virtual reality walkthroughs, and real\-time design modifications so clients can make confident decisions before implementation. Serving industries such as corporate offices, coworking, hospitality, retail, and healthcare, AirBrick offers scalable, adaptable solutions for projects of varying size and complexity. The organization is focused on creating environments that reflect each client’s brand identity while improving workflow efficiency and space utilization.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Design Team Lead is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gurugram. This role oversees a multidisciplinary design team, guiding the end\-to\-end design process from initial client briefing and concept development through detailed design, review, and delivery. The Design Team Lead will coordinate closely with clients to understand business objectives, translate requirements into design solutions, and present design proposals using AirBrick’s AI\-enabled tools. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include managing project timelines and resources, aligning design output with brand and functional goals, reviewing and refining team members’ work, and collaborating with AI and product teams to incorporate data\-driven insights into design decisions. The role also involves mentoring team members, implementing best practices, and ensuring consistent quality across all commercial interior design projects.

title: Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.

 What You'll Do
   

  

 BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology\-enabled, global organization.
   

  

 Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step\-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high\-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology \& AI deployments to end\-to\-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re\-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
   

  

 We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands\-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward\-thinking design.
   

  

**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**
* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication \& engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end\-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.

* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi\-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You’re Good At**
* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement


*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

 We are looking for an experienced professional to take end\-to\-end ownership of international export execution. This is a high\-responsibility position and is not limited to routine export documentation or logistics coordination.
 



  





**Role Objective** 




 The incumbent will own the complete order\-to\-delivery cycle:
 



***Customer Order → Supplier Confirmation → Production / Material Readiness → Shipment Planning → Freight Negotiation → Container / Isotank Booking → Export Documentation → Customs → Vessel Departure → Shipment Tracking → Customer Communication → Delivery***




 The principal objective is to ensure that APAC consistently delivers the
 **right product, right quantity and right documentation, at the right freight cost, and within the customer’s committed ETA.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Export Order Ownership** 




 ● Take ownership of every confirmed international customer order.
 



 ● Establish a detailed execution plan from order confirmation to delivery.
 



 ● Track production, material readiness, shipment booking, documentation, customs, vessel departure and ETA.
 



 ● Maintain a live order and shipment tracker.
 



 ● Identify risks well in advance and initiate corrective action.
 



**2\. Customer ETA Management** 




 ● Work towards 100% adherence to committed customer ETA.
 



 ● Monitor vessel schedules, transit times, supplier readiness and shipment milestones.
 



 ● Identify potential delays before they affect the customer.
 



 ● Develop alternative logistics plans where necessary.
 



 ● Maintain clear visibility of customer\-required ETA versus actual / revised ETA.
 



**3\. Supplier / Manufacturer Coordination** 




*A critical part of the position — the incumbent is expected to actively drive supplier readiness rather than wait for supplier updates.* 




 ● Coordinate continuously with suppliers / manufacturers across India and Asia.
 



 ● Confirm production schedules and firm up material readiness dates; follow up on production progress.
 



 ● Coordinate QC / testing and COA availability; confirm packaging and dispatch readiness.
 



 ● Ensure material is ready sufficiently before vessel cut\-offs; coordinate pickup / loading.
 



 ● Identify and escalate supplier delays at an early stage.
 



 ● Ensure suppliers understand customer delivery commitments.
 



 4\. Freight Negotiation \& Cost Optimisation
 



 ● Obtain competitive ocean freight quotations and benchmark rates across major trade lanes.
 



 ● Negotiate with shipping lines, carriers, NVOCCs and logistics providers.
 



 ● Analyse freight components and surcharges; monitor PSS, GRI and other freight changes.
 



 ● Develop direct relationships with shipping\-line commercial teams.
 



 ● Identify opportunities for cost reduction and minimise unnecessary intermediary costs.
 



 ● Maintain freight\-rate records and benchmarks.
 



**5\. Direct Shipping\-Line Booking** 




 Where commercially feasible, develop APAC’s capability to book containers and isotanks directly with shipping lines / carriers, covering:
 



 Direct carrier relationship development • Vessel schedule identification • Rate negotiation • Space booking • Container / isotank availability • Booking confirmation • Equipment release • SI / VGM cut\-off management • Gate\-in coordination • Vessel rollover management • Carrier escalation
 



*Experience with isotank shipments and DG cargo will be an advantage.* 




**6\. Customer Communication \& Shipment Visibility** 




 Maintain proactive communication with international customers, providing timely updates on:
 



 Supplier / material readiness • QC / COA status • Expected dispatch • Container / isotank booking • Vessel details • ETD • Port status • Transshipment • Shipment movement • ETA • Any changes or delays • Shipping documents.
 



*The fundamental principle is: NO SURPRISES FOR THE CUSTOMER.* 




 If an ETA is at risk, the customer must be informed proactively along with the reason, revised timeline and corrective action.
 



**7\. Export Documentation** 




 Coordinate preparation and verification of:
 



 Commercial Invoice • Packing List • Certificate of Origin • COA • SDS / MSDS • DG Declaration • Shipping Instructions • VGM • Shipping Bill • Bill of Lading • Customer\-specific documentation • Product / regulatory documents as applicable
 



*Ensure documentation is accurate and completed before applicable cut\-offs.* 




**8\. Customs \& ICEGATE – In\-House Capability** 




 A key objective for APAC is to develop stronger in\-house control over export customs processes. The incumbent will manage direct preparation and filing of Shipping Bills through the ICEGATE portal, wherever applicable:
 



 ● Prepare Shipping Bill data; verify HSN / ITC classification and export details.
 



 ● File Shipping Bills through ICEGATE and monitor filing status.
 



 ● Resolve validation errors / queries and coordinate with Customs.
 



 ● Monitor the process through clearance / LEO and relevant post\-export stages; maintain proper records.
 



 ● Ensure timely filing so customs formalities do not affect vessel cut\-offs or customer ETA.
 



*APAC will continue to use CHA / C\&F agents primarily for physical customs, port and related activities requiring their involvement, while building greater in\-house capability for documentation, electronic filing, tracking and export execution.* 




**9\. CHA / C\&F / Port Coordination** 




 ● Coordinate with CHA / C\&F agents for customs and port activities; ensure timely customs clearance.
 



 ● Monitor Shipping Bill status and LEO; coordinate examination / inspection where required.
 



 ● Ensure containers reach port within cut\-off; resolve customs / port\-related issues promptly.
 



 ● Monitor DG\-related requirements where applicable.
 



**10\. Container \& Isotank Planning** 




 ● Plan container and isotank requirements in advance; ensure equipment availability before material readiness.
 



 ● Coordinate loading and dispatch; monitor equipment release and return requirements.
 



 ● Coordinate DG and special\-handling requirements; avoid last\-minute equipment shortages.
 



**11\. Shipment Risk \& Exception Management** 




 Proactively manage supplier / production / quality\-release delays, container and isotank shortages, vessel cancellations and rollovers, port congestion, customs issues, documentation errors, DG acceptance issues, transshipment delays and freight increases.
 



*Expected approach: Identify → Analyse → Act → Communicate → Resolve → Close* 




**12\. Management Reporting** 




 Maintain an updated shipment dashboard covering:
 



 Customer • PO • Product • Quantity • Supplier • Production status • Material readiness • QC / COA • Container / isotank • Booking • Vessel • ETD • Customer ETA • Current ETA • ETA variance • Documentation • Customs • Gate\-in • Risk status • Next action
 



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




 The position will be measured primarily on outcomes:
 



 100% focus on committed customer ETA • Supplier readiness against agreed dates • On\-time shipment execution • Competitive freight rates \& direct carrier bookings • Container / isotank availability • Timely and accurate documentation • Timely ICEGATE Shipping Bill filing • Zero avoidable documentation\-related shipment delays • Proactive customer communication \& early risk identification • Reduction in emergency 
 



 freight and avoidable demurrage / detention • 100% visibility of active shipments
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 10 – 20 years in export operations / international logistics / supply chain • Chemicals, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals or ingredients experience preferred • Strong knowledge of export documentation \& Indian export procedures • Container shipments experience; DG preferred; isotank an advantage • Strong freight negotiation \& direct dealings with shipping lines • Supplier / manufacturer coordination \& 
 



 strong customer communication • ICEGATE / Shipping Bill filing highly desirable; strong Excel / ERP / CRM • Able to manage multiple international shipments simultaneously
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 Strong ownership • Commercial orientation • Excellent follow\-through • High sense of urgency • Proactive communication • Strong negotiation skills • Problem\-solving ability • Attention to detail • Works independently • Manages pressure \& multiple priorities
 



  





***The mindset we are looking for: “Once APAC accepts a customer order, I own the execution until the shipment reaches the customer within the committed ETA.”***




 If you want to build and own an international export operation rather than merely process documents, this is an excellent opportunity to make an impact.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Mail your resume to aloksrivastava@apacss.com and odes@apacss.com APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| Gurgaon \| www.apacss.com

The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. **Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

**Engineering Manager, Passkeys**
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Passkeys team. You will build the technology taking the world beyond passwords. Bitwarden is a credential provider across browser, desktop, and mobile, and the Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 — creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Junior Founder Executive-D2C -Fmcg
description:
**About the Role** 


 Éprise is looking for a sharp, tech\-savvy Executive Assistant to run the founder's office. This isn't a traditional scheduling\-and\-travel EA role — you'll be the operational nerve center for the founder, owning MIS reporting, building and maintaining company dashboards, and coordinating cross\-functional execution so the founder can focus on strategic priorities.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. Founder's Office \& Coordination** 



* Manage the founder's calendar, priorities, and follow\-ups across all functions.
* Act as the single point of coordination between the founder and department heads (sales, ops, finance, etc.).
* Track action items from meetings and ensure timely closure across teams.
* Prepare briefing notes, agendas, and summaries ahead of key meetings.



**2\. MIS \& Reporting** 



* Build and maintain a company\-wide MIS covering sales, operations, and financial metrics.
* Consolidate data from multiple teams/sources into clean, accurate, decision\-ready reports.
* Design daily/weekly/monthly dashboards tracking key business KPIs.
* Flag anomalies, trends, and risks proactively to the founder.



**3\. Dashboards \& Tools** 



* Own the company dashboard end\-to\-end — structure, data pipelines, and visual presentation.
* Work with Excel/Google Sheets, and ideally BI tools (Power BI, Looker Studio, or similar) to automate reporting.
* Continuously improve reporting systems to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.
* Coordinate with any external tech/dev resources for dashboard or tool builds.



**4\. Business Analysis \& Special Projects** 



* Support the founder on ad hoc analysis — market research, competitor tracking, business case prep.
* Drive special projects assigned by the founder from planning through execution.
* Prepare presentations and reports for investors, board members, or leadership reviews.



**5\. Confidentiality \& Judgment** 



* Handle sensitive business and financial information with discretion.
* Exercise independent judgment on prioritization and escalation.


**Requirements** 
* 2–5 years of experience as an EA, Chief of Staff, business analyst, or MIS executive — ideally in a startup or founder\-facing role.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); familiarity with BI tools is a strong plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* High ownership mindset — comfortable working directly with a founder in a fast\-moving environment.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle ambiguity and multitask across functions.

title: HRIS System Analyst
description:

This role collaborates with global internal customers, peers and various stakeholders to discuss user requirements, problem solve, design, assess available technologies, and develop/ package/ present/ test/ implement solutions. The role will require assisting users with training as well as researching and resolving complex global mailbox requests and actively providing solutions.

**Responsibilities**
* Demonstrated attention to detail and customer service.
* Ability to learn and navigate new systems quickly with a passion for working with systems, data and people.
* Build solid effective working relationships as part of a team and interact with all levels of management.
* Use relevant computer system applications at an advanced level.
* Triage and resolve or escalate global "tickets" timely and effectively.

* Serve as an advisor to solve design challenges by identifying effective workarounds for best end users experience
* Develops advanced level custom reports to extract data from systems, including providing breakouts in excel formatting, pivot tables, or graphs.
* Develop and/or configure custom notifications, help text, custom fields, etc.
* Assesses process/ practices for efficiency and implement recommendations for improvement.
* Support the implementation of solutions that scale and streamline data collection globally.
* Complete reviews with stakeholders to ensure agreement on system data principles. Standardize data parameters, document and revise system design procedures, test procedures, and quality standards. Devise flow charts and diagrams describing logical operational steps of programs.

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to successfully interact with various levels within the organization

* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to manage / achieve consensus
* Strong conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal direct supervision
* Experience working in an Agile environment
* Self\-aware and receptive to learning and change
* Intermediate Excel
* 5 or more years Workday experience
* Proficient in 3 or more additional Workday modules (Learning, Recruiting, Advanced Comp, Talent, etc.) with Global experience.

title: Tender and Quotation Executive
description:
Delhi Electric Company is seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented person to identify opportunities from industrial clients and prepare techno\-commercial quotations. The role involves gathering project requirements, conducting inquiries with manufacturers and suppliers, preparing cost estimates, and submitting quotations for management review.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Visit and communicate with industrial clients to understand their electrical equipment requirements.
 



 Collect detailed inquiries related to:
 


* Power \& Distribution Transformers
* LT Panels
* HT/PT Panels
* Relay \& Protection Panels
* Switchgear and Electrical Switches
* Cable Trays
* Cables and other electrical accessories
* Coordinate with customers to obtain technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, and tender documents.
* Float inquiries to OEMs, manufacturers, and suppliers for pricing and technical details.
* Compare vendor quotations based on technical specifications, pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms.
* Prepare detailed techno\-commercial quotations using company formats.
* Submit quotations to the reporting manager for review and approval before sending them to customers.
* Follow up with suppliers for competitive pricing and timely responses.
* Maintain records of customer inquiries, vendor quotations, and submitted proposals.
* Coordinate with the sales, procurement, and technical teams to ensure accurate and timely quotation submissions.
* Follow up with customers regarding submitted quotations and provide any required clarifications.



  





**Required Skills** 




 Basic knowledge of industrial electrical equipment and power distribution systems.
 


* Familiarity with Transformers, LT/HT/PT Panels, Relay Panels, Switchgear, Cable Trays, and related electrical products.
* Ability to read technical specifications, BOQs, and electrical drawings.
* Good negotiation and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and organizational abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.



 • Ability to manage multiple inquiries and meet deadlines.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in electrical sales, estimation, tendering, or quotation preparation is preferred.

This role is accountable for driving structured planning across supplier qualification, capacity expansion, and operational readiness while maintaining alignment, transparency, and execution discipline across internal and external stakeholders.

* Provide leadership with strategic updates and recommendations on qualification status, supplier readiness, capacity progress, and overall program health.

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

* Proven leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities in complex, cross\-functional environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Proficiency with project management and business tools, including Microsoft Project and PowerPoint.

description:
**Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design.**
 Hey, g'day, namaste, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 The Project Manager is expected to operate from the education department office of the State and provide support for Canva Education initiatives.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Canva Education team in India is a mission\-driven group working to embed creativity, collaboration, and visual communication across classrooms nationwide. We actively partner with state governments, national\-level education bodies, and large private school networks to scale Canva Education as a safe, inclusive, and impactful teaching and learning platform.
   

  

 Our team brings deep expertise across education policy, teacher training, and edtech implementation—aligning Canva’s global mission with India’s priorities such as NEP 2020, foundational learning, multilingual classrooms, and digital equity. Whether it’s a district in rural Tamil Nadu or a private school in Delhi NCR, we’re working to ensure that every educator and student can design and learn with confidence.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you’d be doing in this role**
 We are seeking a passionate and proactive Project Manager to support the implementation and scaling of Canva for Education across Government and private school systems in the Delhi NCR. This role will act as a local anchor for our state\-level initiatives, helping drive teacher adoption, support partnership initiatives, and ensure alignment with educational priorities including the National Education Policy 2020\.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of education, technology, and system change — bringing creativity, collaboration, and equity into classrooms at scale.
   

  

 At the moment, this role is focused on:
   

  

* Coordinate and support the execution of Canva Education programs in partnership with the State Government, SCERTs, teacher training institutions, and local NGOs.
* Serve as a key point of contact for field\-level stakeholders including school administrators, DIETs, CRCs/BRCs, and master trainers.
* Support planning and delivery of training programs for teachers, administrators, and implementation partners.
* Collaborate with internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Community, Data) to ensure smooth implementation and troubleshooting of product rollouts.
* Track and report on adoption metrics, success stories, and program impact at the ground level.
* Coordinate localization of content, resources, and communication to ensure cultural and linguistic relevance.
* Identify risks and implementation challenges early and flag them with mitigation plans.
* Support day\-to\-day coordination with state education departments and facilitate reviews, updates, and planning meetings.


**Qualifications**
**You're probably a match if you**
* Have at least 3 years of experience in the K\-12 education field, especially with government schools , large private schools, or large\-scale programs.
* Experience in coordinating or running edtech programs through NGOs, CSR, EdTech organizations, or government partnerships.
* A strong grasp of the National Education Policy (NEP 2020\), particularly in digital education, foundational learning, and teacher capacity building.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi — both spoken and written.
* Proven ability to work in dynamic, cross\-functional, and remote teams.
* Comfortable juggling multiple stakeholders and timelines.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive with a knack for solving problems.
* Adaptable and creative, comfortable with uncertainty, and eager to learn, grow, and innovate.
* Quickly build trust by showing integrity, credibility, and consistency in every interaction.
* Show grit and resilience — you're resourceful, proactive, and action\-focused.
* Stay humble, open to feedback, and always looking for ways to improve.


**Additional Information**
 Other stuff to know
   

  

 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

**Associate Program Manager\- Customer Experience**
 Wishlink is on a mission to revolutionize the creator economy and redefine how people shop. We're all about providing every user with a highly personalized shopping experience guided by creators, so they can find exactly what they want, in a very short time, while improving their online shopping experience severalfold. We are shaping a new era at the intersection of two of the most prominent aspects of the internet\-
 **e\-commerce and social media** 
 .
   

  

**Team and Investors**
 Wishlink was founded by 3 friends from college, Chandan, Shaurya, and Divyansh, with a shared passion to solve real\-world problems at scale and consume content for hours (XD). We started Wishlink in January 2022 when we discovered products on social media that we wanted to buy but could not (in some cases, actually did)! We are based out of Gurugram. We have recently raised a
 **series B round of $17\.5M backed by leading global investors including Vertex Ventures SE Asia \& India, Fundamentum, and Elevation Capital.**
**Why Join Us?**
**Exciting Problem**
 The way people shop online is changing. Users are tired of spending hours browsing humongous catalogs on eCommerce marketplaces just to find a single piece of apparel they like. They need curation, and they need trusted reviews \- which is what Wishlink is bringing with the help of content creators. Wishlink is at the forefront of this change, enabling users to shop in an easier and more exciting way.
   

  

**Immense Scale**
 In just 3 years of existence, Wishlink is used by over
 **900k users daily** 
 to discover and shop products online. This number has grown over 3x in the last 4 months.
   

  

**Stellar Team**
 Wishlink is all about its people. Our team is young and energetic, come from stellar backgrounds, and are dedicated towards a common goal. Also, we have a LOT of fun!
   

  

**Growth Opportunity**
 We have grown remarkably in the last 4 years and are doing a monthly GMV of over Rs. 300cr. We are working with over 50,000 content creators and 300\+ brands and eCommerce marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, H\&M, Savana (Urbanic), Only, Vero Moda, Libas, Aurelia, Mama Earth, and many more.
   

  

 Wishlink presents an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to and grow within the creator\-enabled eCommerce space, have the chance to work at an emerging consumer\-tech startup and be an integral part of this dynamic journey.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an Associate Program Manager \- Customer Experience to own the CX charter for our creator platform. This role is for someone who thrives on picking up ambiguous problem statements, going deep into data and user feedback, and driving them to closure \- across product, tech, and support.
   

  

 You'll sit at the intersection of platform experience, creator sentiment (NPS/trust), and support\-led product improvements, and you'll be the one setting up the early\-warning systems (alerts) that help the org catch problems before they escalate.
   

  

**What would you be doing?**
* Platform CX (Service \& Journey)\- own and improve the end\-to\-end experience across critical creator journeys \- creator payouts, social login, and brand reconciliation, etc. Identify friction points in these flows and work with product/tech to resolve them.
* Own Creator NPS, Trust \& Effort\- run structured programs to gather creator insights (through quarterly NPS/Creator Pulse, 1:1 interviews, etc), and use these to identify gaps. Break these down into individual, ownable problem statements and drive them to resolution.
* Product Enhancements (Support\-Led)\- mine support tickets and escalations for recurring/systemic issues and convert them into product enhancement requests \- closing the loop between "what support hears" and "what product builds”
* Alerts \& Monitoring\- work closely with tech and product to set up proactive alerting across the platform \- for issues like sign\-up drop\-offs, engagement dips, and cohort\-level behavioral shifts \- so problems are caught early rather than reactively.


**What are we looking for?**
* Bachelor's degree from a Tier\-1 college/ prior experience at a Tier\-1 consumer tech company
* Prior experience as a generalist / founder's office/ strategy ops/ program manager/ product analytics role at a startup \- someone who has owned individual problem statements and worked on 0→ 1 or 1→ 10 initiatives
* Strong data orientation and structured problem\-solving \- must be comfortable moving from raw data to insight to action independently (must have)
* Strong cross\-functional operator \- comfortable working across product, tech, business, and support teams to get things done (must have)
* Familiarity with app usage metrics, product analytics tooling, and mapping customer journeys (good to have)


**Interview Process**
* R0\- detailed screening call by HR
* R1\- Data interpretation \& problem\-solving
* R2\- Problem\-solving (deeper dive)
* R3\- Cross\-functional and culture fit


**Perks And Benefits**
 We are committed to providing the best environment for you to thrive in. To help with this, we have the following benefits available for all our employees.
   

  

* Competitive Salary, Generous ESOPs, and Relocation Bonus
* Learning \& Development Programs with a Dedicated Budget
* Company sponsored newsletters and books
* AI tools Subscription
* Regular Team Outings
* Discounted Health Plans \& Gym Memberships
* Industry insights on growing your social media if you are a (aspiring) creator


**Experience Wishlink**
 Explore our Creator App: iOS \| Android
   

  

 Explore our Shopping App: iOS \| Android
   

  

 LinkedIn Page: Wishlink

title: Senior Associate, PMO
description:
As the global leader in high\-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people\-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well\-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Ciena is the global leader in high\-speed connectivity. We build adaptive networks to support exponential growth in bandwidth demand—empowering our customers, collaborators, and communities to thrive in the AI era.
   

  

 We are seeking a data\-driven and financially savvy PMO Analyst/Senior Analyst with 4–6 years of experience to join the
 **APAC (Asia – Pacific) Services Team** 
 . In this role, you will go beyond administrative PMO tasks to serve as the financial backbone of our projects and spearhead long\-term revenue forecasting for the region. The ideal candidate loves working with numbers, possesses a sharp analytical mind, and deeply understands project accounting, budgeting, and regional financial forecasting. You will collaborate closely with Project Managers and regional leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and most importantly \- on budget.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Long\-Term Revenue Forecasting: Partner with regional leadership and finance teams to develop, maintain, and refine long\-term revenue forecasting models specifically for the APAC region. Track pipeline, contract backlogs/balance and regional revenue trends to provide predictive multi\-year revenue outlooks.
* Project Financial Management: Own the end\-to\-end tracking of project budgets, actual spends, rolling forecasts, and cost\-to\-complete metrics.
* Financial Analysis \& Reporting: Analyse financial variances, identify margin leakages, and provide monthly/quarterly financial health reports and regional forecasting updates to senior leadership.
* Data \& Governance: Build and maintain complex financial models, predictive forecasting dashboards, and trackers (via Excel, Power BI, or PPM tools) to ensure regional data accuracy.
* Resource \& Capacity Tracking: Link resource utilization data to project financials to monitor profitability, burn rates, and their subsequent impact on localized revenue recognition.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify financial risks, pipeline delays, or scope creeps that impact the regional budget or long\-term revenue targets, and work with Project Managers on corrective action plans.
* Process Improvement: Streamline financial reporting templates, predictive forecasting tools, and financial governance processes within the PMO.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 4–6 years of dedicated experience within a PMO setup, with a heavy emphasis on project financial management and revenue forecasting.
* Financial \& Forecasting Acumen: Strong understanding of project financials, including capital vs. operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx), long\-term revenue modelling, revenue recognition principles, and margin analysis. Experience handling financial nuances within the APAC region is a strong plus.
* Advanced Numerical Skills: Medium\-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, advanced financial/predictive modelling, macros) and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
* Tool Experience: Hands\-on experience with ERP/financial systems (e.g. \- Salesforce, Oracle).
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications (Preferred): PMP, CAPM, Prince2, or any relevant financial/analytical certifications are a strong plus.


 At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.
   

  

 Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
   

  

 If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

 We are seeking an experienced transformation leader to drive end\-to\-end vendor lifecycle governance across telco products and services. This role will lead cross\-functional execution across procurement, finance, product, operations, billing, network services, and revenue assurance teams, while embedding AI\-enabled workflows, automation, and data\-driven governance to improve vendor performance, operational efficiency, compliance, cost accuracy, and business outcomes across the telecom ecosystem.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead vendor lifecycle governance from onboarding and contracting through performance management, renewal, rationalization, and exit.
* Drive cross\-functional transformation across P2P, revenue assurance, billing, product, procurement, finance, and operations teams.
* Identify, design, and implement AI\-enabled workflows, automation opportunities, and process improvements across telecom vendor management activities, including contract intelligence, billing validation, anomaly detection, SLA monitoring, and supplier performance analytics.
* Establish operating rhythms, governance forums, KPI dashboards, risk controls, and executive reporting for vendor lifecycle transformation programs.
* Apply telecom domain knowledge across network services, carrier products, usage\-based billing, inventory reconciliation, service assurance, order\-to\-activate workflows, and vendor cost governance.

* 15\+ years of experience in technology, telecom, vendor management, commercial operations, or large\-scale transformation program management.
* Strong understanding of vendor lifecycle processes, supplier governance, contract operations, service performance, billing, and P2P workflows.
* Proven ability to deliver enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives involving multiple business functions, senior stakeholders, and external partners.
* Working knowledge of AI tools, automation platforms, analytics, workflow digitization, process mining, and telecom\-specific AI use cases such as predictive insights, billing exception detection, network service optimization, and intelligent supplier governance.

description:
At AlgoSec, what you do matters!
   

  

 AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,300 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
   

  

 As we continue to expand our cloud and enterprise business globally, we are looking for a customer\-facing Project Manager to join its APAC Project Management team.
   

  

 The Project Manager is responsible for leading enterprise customer deployments from presales through go\-live and stabilization, ensuring successful project execution, customer satisfaction, and achievement of initial business value. The role requires strong stakeholder management, commercial awareness, risk management, and cross\-functional leadership across customers, partners, and internal AlgoSec teams.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to join a profitable, growing cybersecurity company with strong market traction, a collaborative culture, and significant growth potential.
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Project Management Team Leader, APAC
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, India
   

  

 Direct employment
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the overall project lifecycle and customer experience, ensuring successful delivery, customer satisfaction, and achievement of agreed project objectives.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle.
* Accountable for projects from presales engagement and scope definition through deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
* Assist Sales and Solution Engineering teams during presales activities, including scope definition, effort estimation, assumptions, risks, and Statement of Work (SoW) development.

description:
**Position:** 
 Program Manager – Urban Initiative
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation** 




  





**About URBAN Project** 




 India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well\-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services\-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under\-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under\-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest\-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.
 



  





 The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on\-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:
 



  




* **Regional economic and spatial planning:** 
 Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth\-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:** 
 Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:** 
 Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:** 
 Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.



  





 Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better\-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high\-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem\-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral \& written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.
 



  





**Areas of Work:** 




 The Program Manager will:
 


* Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning
* Engage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)
* Develop evidence\-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growth
* Engage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnerships
* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise



  





**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities** 



* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills
* High level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands require
* Ability to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive manner
* Operating style suited to working in a small\-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued



  





**Compensation** 




 Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience
 



  





**Location** 




 New Delhi, India

company: Bennett Coleman & Co. Ltd. (The Times of India)
description:
1. **About the Organisation**



 The Times of India is the flagship publication of Bennett, Coleman \& Co. Ltd. It is the world’s largest English broadsheet daily newspaper and covers a wide range of news interests like political, business, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, etc. TOI is built on the key principle to question conventional wisdom and present a comprehensive perspective to the reader for the news around us. The TOI Editorial function is the driving force behind the generation of content that shapes the reader experience. With a focus on news and analysis, this function constantly endeavours to implement path\-breaking ideas and drive value\-creation innovations.
 



  





**Role: Program Manager \- Big Tech Partnerships** 




  





**2\. Job Description** 




**Revenue, billing and Finance liaison** 



* Raise monthly invoices against partner POs and ROs, and make sure every signed line is billed.
* Track billed versus contracted value across all Big Tech deals, and flag anything that is slipping.
* Follow up on outstanding payments with the partner and with our collections and Finance teams until closure.
* Own the Big Tech payment tracker and the annual forecast.
* Reconcile partner marketing spends across TV, print and digital against the deal, campaign by campaign.
* Coordinate with Finance on POs, credit notes, GST and documentation so invoices are not held up.



**Project implementation and partner coordination** 



* Take every signed contract from signature to delivery list out the deliverables, get owners against each, and close them inside the contractual window.
* Run the implementation calls with the partner's team and with our internal teams (Editorial, Product, Ad Ops), and keep one live status view.
* Verify what has actually gone live before we call a deliverable complete, and keep the evidence on record for the partner.
* Chase the partner for PO release once contracts are signed.
* Escalate early where an internal dependency is going to miss a contractual date.



**Contract and documentation control** 



* Maintain the master record of all Big Tech contracts terms, dates, deliverables, renewal and exit dates.
* Circulate signed contracts, keep the file complete, and be the single reference point for what was agreed.
* Give the Big Tech Head and leadership a clear read on where each contract stands ahead of any partner discussion.



  





**Research and support to new business** 



* Pull together the data we need for partner discussions content, archive, audio\-video, Indic language and audience data.
* Track what other publishers are doing with AI \& Big Tech Companies, and what deal structures they are signing.
* Keep an eye on court proceedings and lawsuits filed by publishers globally.
* Build the decks, whitepapers and one\-pagers used in partner and internal meetings.
* Support new partner conversations (Meta, Microsoft and others) with background research and first\-cut commercial notes.



**3\. Who we are looking for** 




**Must have** 



* 2\+ years of experience in partnership operations, key account management, business operations or a client\-servicing role with commercial ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with billing and collections, raising invoices, working with POs, and following up on payments with clients and with internal Finance.
* Experience running delivery against contractual timelines, with both internal teams and an external client.
* Comfortable with numbers. Can build and maintain revenue trackers, reconciliations and forecasts
* Clean, professional written English.
* Deep understanding of AI tools and prompt engineering
* Graduate; MBA or equivalent preferred.



**Good to have** 



* Exposure to AI tools , media, publishing or digital content businesses.
* Prior work with a large technology or platform client (Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Amazon or similar).
* Experience with contract documentation and commercial terms.
* Ability to build a decent deck without design support.

title: Professional, PDS Projects
description:
**What this job involves:**
 Directing projects every step of the way
   

  

 You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating to final handover to the client. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done in a way that meets JLL’s commercial objectives. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, at the same time detailing all the necessary objectives to get there. While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources and allocate them effectively to finish projects within budget. From onset to completion of the project, you’ll represent our clients, helping them organise and analyse tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers.
   

  

 Building strong teams and business reputation
   

  

 One of your main concerns will be to produce high\-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll need to collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholders, leading from the front while also taking the time to understand their point of view. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects, and seize additional opportunities along the road.
   

  

 Core to our reputation is our strong focus on health \& safety and on sustainability, and you’ll be expected to keep these front\-of\-mind at all times.
   

  

**Sound like you?**
 Our successful Project Managers …
   

  

* Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their perspective.
* Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
* Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
* Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
* Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.


**To apply you need to be:**
 Client\-centric problem solver
   

  

 We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a degree in a relevant field, and/or around five years’ experience in design, construction, project management in interior fit\-out projects for multinational clients. It would be excellent if you have a strong background in all aspects of interior fit\-out management—including management on schedule, quality, cost and risk management, and negotiation, to name a few. Your expertise in surveying a client’s basic needs, completing commercial assessments, and preparing PM proposals will also be put to the test. Your quickness in understanding and dealing with a situation will be indispensable especially in carrying out value engineering, build ability analysis, critical reviews of design and documentation.
   

  

 Business savvy and action\-oriented
   

  

 To excel in this role, you should have a high level of understanding and technical expertise in business. We deliver projects that help our clients succeed as well as help JLL achieve our business and financial goals.
   

  

 Are you well versed in project products, systems, processes, tools and best practices? Can you handle the site operations no matter how complex it may be?
   

  

 Likewise, you should have a great sense of urgency when it comes to solving problems, improving products or services, finding new markets, and implementing new strategies. You are resilient and can deal effectively with competing priorities and tight deadlines. You should know how to negotiate to generate risk\-assessed solutions, and how to handle ambiguities.
   

  

 A great communicator with superb organisational skills
   

  

 Do you have what it takes to lead and motivate your project team members? Are you capable of leading by example and fostering a creative environment? We achieve our biggest success when working together, so clear communication is key, as is collaboration and team work.
   

  

 A structured and organised approach with an eye for detail is also crucial, as is being tech\-savvy. As the digital leader in project management, we use a range of technology platforms to deliver our projects.

**Project Manager – Solar EPC (C\&I Segment)** 




**Location: Golf Course Road Extension, Gurgaon** 




**Experience: 2–5 Years** 




  





**About Us – Hodular One** 




 Hodular One is a clean energy company providing end\-to\-end solar solutions for commercial and industrial clients. We manage the entire process—from design and installation to operations and maintenance—ensuring reliable performance and long\-term savings. Our focus is on helping businesses reduce energy costs while meeting their sustainability goals with ease.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a skilled
 **Solar Project Engineer** 
 to support the execution of
 **Commercial \& Industrial (C\&I) solar EPC projects** 
 . The role involves overseeing the project from feasibility and design to installation and commissioning—while ensuring timely delivery, cost efficiency, safety, and quality compliance. The ideal candidate will have experience in rooftop solar projects, along with strong technical and coordination skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 • Conduct feasibility studies and on\-site assessments for solar PV installations.
 



 • Coordinate with internal and external design teams (civil, structural, and electrical) to develop and optimize system layouts.

 • Manage the permitting process and support documentation for DISCOM, and local authority approvals.
 



 • Prepare Bills of Materials (BOMs), technical specifications, and engineering documentation.
 



 • Collaborate with the procurement team and vendors to ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment.
 



 • Supervise on\-site installation and commissioning activities, ensuring adherence to design, safety, and quality benchmarks.
 



 • Coordinate with contractors, electricians, and key stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.
 



 • Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including as\-built drawings, test reports, and operation manuals.
 



 • Support the preparation and submission of project close\-out documents and regulatory clearances.
